title: Non-Shattering at and Above the Dynamical Temperature in the Spherical Pure p-Spin Model
summary: We consider the notion of shattering introduced by Ben Arous and Jagannath for spherical pure $p$-spin glasses with overlap $q$. For every $p\geq 3$ and $0<β\leqβ_{\mathrm{sh}}(p)$, we rule out shattering whenever $q\leq2^{-1/2}$ or $q>\sqrt{(p-2)/(p-1)}$. The proof combines a deterministic $N+1$ bound for disjoint bands in the first range with a general-$p$ sign law showing that their total marked weight has subdominant free energy in the second. A spherical-code bound and Hölder's inequality give an additional $q$-dependent obstruction; in particular, they rule out every fixed overlap for $0<β\leq\sqrt{\log2}$. For $p=3$, the first two ranges already exhaust every fixed $q\in(0,1)$, so the landscape is not shattered at any $T\geq T_{\mathrm{sh}}$. For $p\geq4$, the cases not covered by our criteria are confined to $2^{-1/2}<q\leq\sqrt{(p-2)/(p-1)}$ and $\sqrt{\log2}<β\leqβ_{\mathrm{sh}}(p)$. In particular, this paper partially resolves Conjecture 1 of the paper above and also suggests new methods to show non-shattering.

AI.tldr: 本文研究球面纯p自旋玻璃中由Ben Arous和Jagannath引入的shattering概念。对于所有p≥3和0<β≤β_sh(p)，作者在两种情况下排除了shattering：q≤2^{-1/2}或q>√((p-2)/(p-1))。对于p=3，这些条件覆盖了所有固定q∈(0,1)，表明在任何T≥T_sh时景观都不会被shatter；对于p≥4，未覆盖的情况局限于特定区间。本文部分解决了原文中的猜想1。
AI.motivation: shattering是自旋玻璃理论中描述自由能景观复杂分解的重要概念。Ben Arous和Jagannath此前提出了关于shattering的猜想，本文旨在通过构造性方法在更广的参数范围内排除shattering，从而深化对球面纯p自旋玻璃中玻璃态结构的理解。
AI.method: 证明结合了三种技术：(1) 对于第一个参数范围(q≤2^{-1/2})，使用确定性的N+1界来排除不相交带中的shattering；(2) 对于第二个参数范围(q>√((p-2)/(p-1)))，提出一般p符号律，证明总标记权重的自由能是次优的；(3) 利用球面码界和Hölder不等式得到额外的依赖于q的障碍，在β≤√log2时排除所有固定重叠参数。
AI.result: 对于p=3，前两个范围已覆盖所有固定q∈(0,1)，因此在任何T≥T_sh时景观都不会被shatter。对于p≥4，未被准则覆盖的情况限制在2^{-1/2}<q≤√((p-2)/(p-1))且√log2<β≤β_sh(p)的区域内。
AI.conclusion: 本文部分解决了原论文中的猜想1，并通过引入N+1界、一般p符号律以及球面码界与Hölder不等式等新方法，为在更广参数范围证明非shattering提供了新工具和途径。

title: Extinction drives emergent metastability in complex ecosystems
summary: Extinction is inevitable; every species eventually dies out, impacting the ecosystem it is part of. Over the past few decades, extensive research stemming from the stability-diversity debate has addressed how species diversity contributes to the stability of large ecosystems. However, conventional stability criteria often rely on deterministic frameworks, overlooking the intrinsic population fluctuations that allow any species to go extinct by chance. In this paper, we incorporate demographic stochasticity into large complex ecosystems with a rule-based model. We demonstrate that such demographic fluctuations rapidly prune the low-abundance species from the ecological community, thereby securing higher systemic stability. By developing a bottom-up theory to characterise the statistics of extinction dynamics, we discover that the fraction of surviving species exhibits an anomalous heavy-tailed decay over time, revealing the emergence of remnant communities with robust metastability. Our results highlight that when demographic fluctuations are accounted for, ecosystems self-stabilise by reducing their diversity even when they are predicted to be chaotic in the deterministic limit.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将种群统计学随机性引入大尺度复杂生态系统模型，发现该随机性会迅速清除低丰度物种，提升系统稳定性，且存活物种比例呈现异常重尾衰减，揭示出具有稳健亚稳态的残余群落；即使系统在确定性极限下被预测为混沌，考虑人口学波动后生态系统通过降低多样性实现自我稳定。
AI.motivation: 传统稳定性判据基于确定性框架，忽视了群体固有的种群波动，而现实中任何物种都可能因随机性而偶然灭绝；作者希望弥补这一空白，考察人口统计学随机性如何影响大尺度生态系统的稳定性与多样性关系。
AI.method: 构建一个基于规则的模型，将人口统计学随机性纳入大尺度复杂生态系统；采用自下而上的理论框架刻画灭绝动力学的统计特征，分析存活物种比例随时间的衰减行为。
AI.result: 研究发现人口学波动会快速剪除低丰度物种，从而提高系统整体稳定性；存活物种比例随时间呈现异常重尾衰减，表明残余群落具有稳健的亚稳态；即使在确定性极限下系统被判定为混沌，考虑人口学波动后生态系统仍能通过减少多样性实现自我稳定化。
AI.conclusion: 人口统计学随机性在生态稳定化中扮演关键角色：生态系统通过自身多样性的降低来换取稳定性，这一机制在确定性理论失效的混沌区域依然有效，为稳定性-多样性辩论提供了新的理论视角。

title: On first-order thermodynamic equilibrium conditions for fluid-fluid and solid-phase interfaces
summary: Starting from the constrained variational formulation of Larché and Cahn for solids in contact with fluids, a unified thermodynamic framework for such systems is developed. Both bulk and interfacial equilibrium conditions arise as stationarity conditions of a single thermodynamic functional. While earlier theory neglects a full treatment of interfacial contributions and therefore cannot describe systems in which surface effects are significant, the present formulation incorporates interfacial thermodynamics directly into the variational principle. The framework is introduced first for fluid-fluid systems to establish the underlying mathematical structure, and is then extended to solid-fluid interfaces. Within this setting, classical equilibrium relations for heterogeneous systems emerge naturally from different classes of admissible variations, providing a common theoretical basis for bulk, interfacial, and configurational thermodynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文从Larché-Cahn约束变分公式出发，发展了一个统一的固体-流体接触系统热力学框架，将界面热力学直接纳入变分原理中，使体相和界面平衡条件均作为单一热力学泛函的平稳条件出现。
AI.motivation: 早期理论忽略了对界面贡献的完整处理，无法描述表面效应显著的系统。需要一个将界面热力学直接纳入变分原理的统一框架，为体相、界面和构型热力学提供共同的理论基础。
AI.method: 从Larché和Cahn的约束变分公式出发，构建统一热力学框架；首先在流体-流体系统中建立基本数学结构，然后扩展至固体-流体界面；通过不同类别的可容许变分自然地推导出经典平衡关系。
AI.result: 体相和界面平衡条件作为单一热力学泛函的平稳条件出现；经典的非均质系统平衡关系从不同类别的可容许变分中自然涌现。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为体相、界面和构型热力学提供了统一的理论基础，能够处理表面效应显著的系统，弥补了早期理论的不足。

title: Learning Unsteady Aneurysm Hemodynamics with Physics-Informed DeepONets
summary: Clinically actionable, patient-specific hemodynamic assessment, specifically wall shear stress, vortex structure and pressure distributions, is critical for determining risky or unfavorable evolution in Abdominal Aortic Aneurysms (AAA). While Physics-Informed Deep Operator Networks (PI-DeepONets) show promising results in complementing established 5 tools such as Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), a persistent architectural challenge remains for complex 3D flows. In this direction, we propose a Modified Multi-Input Multi-Output PI-DeepONets (M3PI-DeepONet) designed for predicting unsteady flows in an idealized AAA geometry. Central to our model is the Aggregated Injection strategy, where latent representations from multiple input branches are fused prior to trunk injection, allowing the coordinate basis to adapt to multiple physical constraints. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first architecture to combine the layer-wise gating mechanism with a multi-branch operator-network topology, yielding an input-adaptive trunk basis. Additionally, we integrate the 3D Navier-Stokes equations as governing physical laws, so the model is trained based on physics-informed residuals, initial and boundary conditions, and only 0.3% of the labeled internal data together with the selected branch-conditioning signals. The M3PI-DeepONet simultaneously predicts unsteady 3D flow velocity and pressure fields with an average relative L2 velocity error below 4% and pressure error around 5% while achieving a conservative retained-cycle inference speedup of approximately 36x compared to reference CFD simulations once the branch inputs used for conditioning are available. This work advances the application of deep learning in cardiovascular disease modeling, marking step toward real-time, non-invasive clinical diagnostics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种改进的多输入多输出物理信息深度算子网络（M3PI-DeepONet），用于预测腹主动脉瘤（AAA）理想化几何中的非定常3D血流动力学。模型采用聚合注入策略和逐层门控机制，融合3D Navier-Stokes物理约束，仅需0.3%标记内部数据即可同时预测速度场和压力场，平均相对L2速度误差低于4%、压力误差约5%，推理速度比CFD快约36倍。
AI.motivation: 临床上需要针对患者的血流动力学评估（壁面剪切应力、涡结构、压力分布）来判断AAA的危险演变，但传统CFD计算成本高昂。虽然PI-DeepONets在补充CFD方面有潜力，但现有架构在处理复杂3D流动时仍面临架构性挑战，亟需一种能高效预测非定常3D血流的算子网络架构。
AI.method: 提出M3PI-DeepONet架构，核心创新包括：（1）聚合注入（Aggregated Injection）策略，将多个输入分支的潜在表示在主干注入前融合，使坐标基适应多种物理约束；（2）首次将逐层门控机制与多分支算子网络拓扑结合，形成输入自适应的主干基；（3）以3D Navier-Stokes方程作为物理约束，结合初边界条件训练，仅使用0.3%标记内部数据及选定的分支条件信号。
AI.result: M3PI-DeepONet同时预测非定常3D血流速度场和压力场，平均相对L2速度误差低于4%，压力误差约5%，在分支输入条件可用时，相对参考CFD仿真获得约36倍的保守保留周期推理加速。
AI.conclusion: 该工作推进了深度学习在心血管疾病建模中的应用，朝着实时、无创的临床诊断方向迈出了重要一步，为复杂3D血流动力学的快速预测提供了新的架构方案。

title: Comment on: Microscopic signatures of an imaginary charge density wave in a kagome metal
summary: In this Comment, exact diagonalization and quantitative analysis show that the reported signatures of loop currents in Ref. [arXiv:2605.05101; https://doi.org/10.1038/s41567-026-03339-8] can instead be explained by crystalline mosaicity and pre-transitional CDW fluctuations. Specifically: (i) the NQR linewidth tracks a standard Curie-Weiss (CW) law with no anomalies; (ii) the Zp-NQR asymmetric lineshapes stem from an angular mosaic spread, reproducing the spin-transition-dependent skewness; and (iii) the reported emergent field ($h_{\rm loc}$) arises from particular fitting constraints and attributing the angular distribution to an internal field rather than mosaicity. Consequently, the data in Ref. [arXiv:2605.05101; https://doi.org/10.1038/s41567-026-03339-8] remain insufficient to establish TRSB due to loop currents or a phase transition at $T^* \sim$ 120 K.

AI.tldr: 本评述通过精确对角化和定量分析表明，Ref. [arXiv:2605.05101] 中报道的环流（loop current）信号实际上可由晶体镶嵌（mosaicity）和预转变CDW涨落解释，而非时间反演对称破缺（TRSB）的证据。数据显示NQR线宽遵循标准Curie-Weiss定律无异常，Zp-NQR不对称线形源于角度镶嵌展宽，所报告的局域场源于拟合约束和将角度分布误归因于内场。因此原始数据不足以确立TRSB或T*~120K相变。
AI.motivation: 对原论文声称在T*~120K观察到由环流导致的TRSB相变提出质疑，检验其数据解释的可靠性，并指出更可能的微观物理机制（晶体镶嵌与CDW涨落）能够自然解释所有观测特征。
AI.method: 采用精确对角化（exact diagonalization）结合定量分析，对比NQR线宽与Curie-Weiss定律的拟合，分析Zp-NQR不对称线形与角度镶嵌展宽的关系，并检验局域场h_loc数值的来源与拟合约束条件的影响。
AI.result: 三点结论：(i) NQR线宽遵循标准CW定律，无任何异常；(ii) Zp-NQR不对称线形的偏斜度可由角度镶嵌展宽自然重现，随自旋跃迁变化；(iii) 所报告的表观局域场源于特定的拟合约束，将角度分布误归为内场效应。原始数据不足以支持TRSB或120K相变。
AI.conclusion: 原论文的信号更可能源于晶体镶嵌性和预转变CDW波动等常规效应，而非环流诱导的TRSB；需要更严格的数据分析和判别性实验才能确立时间反演对称性破缺。

title: Learning Spin Hamiltonians from Terahertz Two-Dimensional Coherent Spectroscopy
summary: Effective Hamiltonians connect microscopic interactions to measurable collective behavior in quantum materials, but determining their parameters directly from experiment remains a challenging inverse problem. We introduce a supervised machine-learning framework that infers Hamiltonian parameters from nonlinear terahertz two-dimensional coherent spectra. A calibrated forward model generates spectra from candidate Hamiltonians, a common preprocessing pipeline maps simulated and experimental spectra into the same representation, and a neural network learns the inverse map from spectral fingerprints to microscopic parameters. We demonstrate the approach for rare-earth orthoferrites using a two-sublattice Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert spin model with exchange, Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interaction, anisotropies, and damping. Synthetic benchmarks show that nonlinear spectra encode parameters beyond those fixed by the linear response, with inference accuracy tracking the physical spectral sensitivity and robustness against noise improved by using multiple inter-pulse delays. Applied to experimental THz-2DCS data from Sm$_{0.4}$Er$_{0.6}$FeO$_3$, the inferred parameters yield physically reasonable forward simulations, while remaining discrepancies identify limitations of the reduced model. These results establish THz-2DCS as a data-rich platform for effective-Hamiltonian inference and model refinement, enabling experimentally driven identification of microscopic interactions while providing a foundation for understanding, predicting, and ultimately controlling the emergent properties of quantum materials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种监督式机器学习框架，从非线性太赫兹二维相干光谱（THz-2DCS）中推断有效哈密顿量参数，并在稀土正铁氧体（Sm₀.₄Er₀.₆FeO₃）上进行了实验验证。
AI.motivation: 有效哈密顿量连接了量子材料中的微观相互作用与宏观集体行为，但直接从实验数据确定其参数是一个具有挑战性的逆问题。
AI.method: 该方法包括三个关键步骤：(1) 构建校准的正向模型，从候选哈密顿量生成光谱（基于双子晶格Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert自旋模型，包含交换、Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用、各向异性和阻尼）；(2) 通过通用的预处理管道将模拟光谱和实验光谱映射到同一表示空间；(3) 训练神经网络学习从光谱指纹到微观参数的非线性逆映射。
AI.result: 合成基准测试表明非线性光谱能编码超越线性响应的参数，推理精度与物理光谱灵敏度一致，多脉冲间延迟方案可提升抗噪鲁棒性。应用于Sm₀.₄Er₀.₆FeO₃的实验THz-2DCS数据时，推断参数产生合理的正向模拟，残余差异揭示了简化模型的局限性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究确立了THz-2DCS作为数据丰富的有效哈密顿量推断和模型改进平台，实现了实验驱动的微观相互作用识别，为理解、预测乃至控制量子材料的涌现性质奠定了基础。

title: A Quantum Optimization Framework for Data-Assimilation-Augmented Parameter Estimation
summary: Parameter estimation is a fundamental challenge in the calibration of ordinary differential equation (ODE) models, where repeated numerical integration can lead to high computational cost. In this work, we investigate whether quantum algorithms can be leveraged to assist parameter estimation in nonlinear dynamical systems. We develop a hybrid classical-quantum framework that reformulates a data-assimilation-augmented parameter estimation problem as a combinatorial optimization task. Model dynamics and data assimilation are enforced entirely on the classical side, while the resulting parameter estimation cost functional is discretized and approximated by a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) surrogate. This surrogate is mapped to an Ising Hamiltonian, and quantum optimizers are used to search for low-energy configurations corresponding to candidate parameter estimates. We apply the framework to SIS and SIR epidemic models, the chaotic Lorenz-63 system, and a high-dimensional two-layer Lorenz-96 system. In this setting, the method is used to recover classical system parameters from partial state observations across steady-state, chaotic, and high-dimensional multiscale dynamical systems. Numerical experiments with synthetic data show that the proposed approach accurately recovers parameters while requiring data-assimilation solves only on a prescribed coarse grid. The framework avoids quantum state tomography, illustrating a viable pathway for integrating quantum optimization into data-driven parameter estimation for nonlinear dynamical systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合经典-量子计算框架，将非线性动力系统的参数估计问题重构为二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）问题，并映射到Ising哈密顿量上，利用量子优化器搜索低能构型以获取候选参数估计。该方法在SIS/SIR流行病模型、Lorenz-63混沌系统和高维Lorenz-96系统上验证，能仅基于粗网格上的数据同化求解准确恢复参数，且无需量子态层析。
AI.motivation: 参数估计是ODE模型标定中的基础性挑战，传统方法需反复数值积分，计算成本高昂。作者旨在探索量子算法能否帮助降低非线性动力系统参数估计的计算负担，并规避量子态层析等实际实现障碍。
AI.method: 框架将数据同化增强的参数估计问题重构为组合优化任务。模型动力学与数据同化在经典端完成，而参数估计代价泛函被离散化并近似为QUBO代理，再映射为Ising哈密顿量，最后由量子优化器搜索低能构型以获得参数估计。整个过程仅在预设粗网格上进行数据同化解算。
AI.result: 在SIS/SIR模型、Lorenz-63混沌系统及双层Lorenz-96高维系统上的合成数据实验中，该方法能准确恢复系统参数，覆盖稳态、混沌及高维多尺度动力学场景，且避免了量子态层析的需求。
AI.conclusion: 该混合量子优化框架为非线性动力系统的数据驱动参数估计提供了一条可行路径，表明量子优化可有效集成到经典计算管线中，同时规避了全量子实现的技术障碍。

title: Far-from-equilibrium topological phase transition in one dimension
summary: We uncover a mechanism for far-from-equilibrium topological phase transitions, via a one-dimensional compact phase model evolving deterministically from random initial conditions. It rests on topology and symmetry rather than on phenomenological postulates: phase compactness permits vortices, and a homogeneous fixed point suppresses their nucleation, with the fixed point itself implied by phase-shift symmetry. The competition between vortex-induced disordering and relaxation toward homogeneity drives a continuous nonequilibrium transition, whose universality class we identify as directed percolation (DP). We demonstrate this by constructing the corresponding effective field theory and numerically confirming DP critical scaling through dynamical-scaling analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了一种远离平衡态的拓扑相变机制，通过一维紧致相位模型从随机初始条件确定性演化实现。该机制基于拓扑与对称性而非唯象假设：相位紧致性允许涡旋存在，而均匀不动点（由相移对称性隐含）抑制涡旋成核。涡旋引起的失序与向均匀态弛豫的竞争驱动了一个连续非平衡相变，其普适类被确定为定向渗透（DP）。作者通过构建对应的有效场论并在数值上以动力学标度分析确认了DP临界标度。
AI.motivation: 探索远离平衡态的拓扑相变是否具有普适的潜在机制，并希望不依赖唯象假设，仅从拓扑与对称性出发来理解这类相变。
AI.method: 构造一维紧致相位模型（随机初始条件、确定性演化），利用相位紧致性产生涡旋，借助相移对称性推出均匀不动点并抑制涡旋成核，构建有效场论，并通过数值动力学标度分析验证相变临界行为。
AI.result: 发现涡旋失序与均匀弛豫的竞争导致连续非平衡相变，其普适类为定向渗透（DP），有效场论预测和数值动力学标度分析均支持DP临界标度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了远离平衡拓扑相变可以由拓扑与对称性而非唯象假设来刻画，其普适类属于定向渗透，为理解这类非平衡相变提供了统一的机制性框架。

title: On the Brittleness of Maximum Likelihood Estimation for Gaussian Process Hyperparameter Optimization
summary: Machine learning (ML) has become an indispensable part of modern engineering design workflows. A crucial step in training an ML model is the selection of the loss function which can be systematically formulated via various techniques such as maximum likelihood estimation (MLE) and cross-validation . While MLE is one of the most popular, effective, and intuitive mechanisms for training ML models, it is brittle: if the assumptions underpinning it are not met, the trained ML model may generalize poorly. This brittleness affects even Gaussian processes (GPs) which are widely used in engineering design and are often (incorrectly) presumed to be very robust to overfitting. In this paper, we fundamentally evaluate the brittleness of MLE in the context of training GPs for probabilistic regression or classification tasks. We compare theoretically grounded metrics against MLE and propose practical solutions. Our extensive studies demonstrate the effectiveness of our solutions in downstream design tasks such as Bayesian optimization and provide a blueprint for practitioners to build accurate and robust GPs that can even outperform tabular foundation models in terms of prediction accuracy, uncertainty quantification, and inference cost. Our contributions are publicly available via GitHub at https://github.com/Bostanabad-Research-Group/GP-vs-TabPFN-vs-GPyTorch.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了最大似然估计（MLE）在训练高斯过程（GP）模型时的脆弱性，提出了基于理论度量的替代训练方案，在概率回归/分类任务及下游贝叶斯优化中展现出优于MLE和表格基础模型的性能。
AI.motivation: MLE是训练ML模型最流行的机制，但其前提假设若不满足会导致模型泛化能力差。即使广泛用于工程设计的GP模型也常被错误地认为对过拟合非常鲁棒，其MLE训练方式的脆弱性未被深入评估。
AI.method: 作者将理论上严谨的度量指标与MLE进行对比，针对GP的概率回归/分类任务系统评估MLE的脆弱性，并提出实用的替代训练方案，通过大量实验在下游设计任务（如贝叶斯优化）中验证。
AI.result: 实验证明所提出的解决方案在贝叶斯优化等下游任务中非常有效，训练的GP在预测精度、不确定性量化和推理成本方面甚至优于表格基础模型（如TabPFN）。
AI.conclusion: 本文为从业者提供了构建准确且鲁棒GP模型的蓝图，证明通过替代MLE的理论度量方法可获得更稳健的GP，同时将代码开源供社区使用。

title: Systematic extinctions in inelastic neutron scattering from molecular spin clusters
summary: Inelastic neutron scattering on a single crystal resolves how the intensity of a magnetic transition of a molecular spin cluster varies with the momentum-transfer vector $\mathbf{Q}$. The point group fixes that dependence completely when a single symmetry species mediates the transition and the local spin operators contain only one occurrence of that species. Functions for such universal $\mathbf{Q}$ dependences have been tabulated. As we show here, even when these conditions are not fulfilled, the point group still fixes, at a given geometry, momentum transfers at which the intensity vanishes for every Hamiltonian that has the symmetry of the cluster. We call such momentum transfers extinctions and derive an equation whose every zero is an extinction, built from the symmetry species of the two levels and from the positions and scattering amplitudes of the magnetic sites. The extinctions follow in closed form in two cases: when each orbit of symmetry-equivalent sites contributes a single occurrence of the mediating species, and when the site phases recur under a subgroup up to one common factor.

AI.tldr: 本文通过非弹性中子散射实验和对单晶中分子自旋簇的分析，推导出一种仅由点群对称性决定的动量转移Q处的强度消失条件（称之为"消光"）。这些消光点在给定几何下对任何具有该簇对称性的哈密顿量都成立，并通过推导一个方程来系统地寻找它们。
AI.motivation: 已有的理论仅在满足特定条件（单一对称物种介导跃迁、局部自旋算子仅含该物种一次）时，才能用点群完全确定磁跃迁强度对动量转移Q的依赖关系。作者希望放宽这些限制，探索在更一般条件下点群对称性能否仍然约束某些物理可观测量——具体而言是有哪些动量转移位置的强度必然为零，从而为实验提供更普适的预测工具。
AI.method: 作者从分子自旋簇的点群对称性出发，基于两个能级的对称物种、磁位点的位置及散射振幅，推导出一个方程，其每个零点都对应一个消光（强度必然为零的动量转移）。他们进一步给出了两种可解析求解消光的具体情形：(1) 每个对称等价位点轨道对中介物种只贡献一次；(2) 在某一子群下，位点相位重现但相差一个公共因子。
AI.result: 即使在已有表格不适用的一般条件下，点群仍能确定特定几何配置下强度必然为零的动量转移（消光）。作者推导出通用的消光方程，并在两种情形下给出了闭合形式的解。
AI.conclusion: 点群对称性对磁跃迁强度的约束比以往认为的更普遍——即使不满足已有理论的严格条件，仍存在由对称性决定的普适消光点。这些结论可用于指导单晶中子散射实验的测量设计，并为解释实验结果提供理论依据。

title: Linear-response time-dependent density-functional theory with local range separation: Core and valence resonances of the neon atom
summary: We investigate range-separated hybrids (RSHs) and locally range-separated hybrids (LRSHs) for linear-response time-dependent density-functional theory (TDDFT) Sternheimer calculations of the photoionization spectrum of the Ne atom. This system constitutes a stringent test for approximate exchange-correlation treatments because it exhibits both valence and core resonances with very different energy scales. Building on previous work employing a simple one-parameter local range-separation function, we assess here a more flexible two-parameter range-separation function designed to improve the high-density limit. We compare photoionization spectra and resonance parameters obtained with RSHs and LRSHs. We find that the LRSH approach with the two-parameter range-separation function provides an overall satisfactory description of the photoionization spectrum, including energies for both valence and core resonances. The lifetimes of the 2s $\rightarrow$ np valence resonances are also reasonably reproduced since their decay does not involve double excitations. In contrast, the lifetimes of the 1s $\rightarrow$ np core resonances are overestimated by orders of magnitude because their Auger decay channels involve double excitations that are absent in adiabatic, single-determinant TDDFT. Obtaining more accurate resonance widths within linear-response range-separated TDDFT would require using multideterminant schemes and/or adding a frequency-dependent response kernel.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了范围分离杂化（RSH）和局域范围分离杂化（LRSH）方法在线性响应含时密度泛函理论（TDDFT）Sternheimer计算中，对Ne原子光电离光谱的描述。通过改进的两参数范围分离函数，LRSH方法能较好地描述价层和核心共振的能量，但核心共振的寿命（Auger衰变涉及双激发）被高估了数个数量级。
AI.motivation: Ne原子同时具有能量尺度差异很大的价层和核心共振，是对交换关联近似处理的严格检验。此前工作使用简单的单参数局域范围分离函数，本文旨在评估更灵活的两参数范围分离函数（改进高密度极限），以提高TDDFT对光电离光谱描述的准确性。
AI.method: 采用线性响应TDDFT Sternheimer方法，比较RSH和LRSH两种近似方案；使用两参数局域范围分离函数改进高密度极限；计算Ne原子光电离光谱和共振参数（包括价层2s→np共振及核心1s→np共振的能量和寿命）。
AI.result: LRSH配合两参数范围分离函数能总体较好地描述光电离光谱，包括价层和核心共振的能量。价层共振寿命因其衰变不涉及双激发而能合理再现；但核心共振的寿命因Auger衰变通道涉及双激发（在绝热单行列式TDDFT中缺失）而被高估数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 要在线性响应范围分离TDDFT中获得更精确的共振宽度，需要采用多行列式方案和/或添加频率依赖的响应核。

title: A scalable edge-pass Purcell filter for high-fidelity readout of superconducting qubits
summary: High-fidelity readout with strong Purcell protection of qubit coherence is essential for scalable superconducting quantum processors, yet the finite passband and sizable footprint of conventional band-pass Purcell filters make them hard to scale. Here we introduce a scalable edge-pass Purcell filter that separates the readout band from the protected qubit band by a single transmission edge, freeing the readout resonators from bandwidth constraint. Depending on whether the transmitting band lies above or below the cutoff, the compact network is realized as a high-pass filter (HPF) or a low-pass filter (LPF). The HPF reaches an average readout fidelity of 99.46(4)% (up to 99.56%) with a 150-ns pulse, and the LPF reaches 99.49(3)% (up to 99.57%) with a 130-ns pulse. The average single-qubit gate fidelities are 99.94% (HPF) and 99.93% (LPF). Relative to the filter-free Purcell limit, the filters substantially extend the qubit lifetime, and the Purcell protection deepens at higher filter order. In addition, an intrinsic dissipation mode of the filter offers a qubit-reset channel. This leads to a compact architecture that unifies fast, high-fidelity readout, Purcell protection, and effective reset within a single filter for large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可扩展的边沿通带Purcell滤波器，通过单一传输边沿将读出频带与受保护的量子比特频带分离，消除了读出谐振器的带宽限制。高通滤波器(HPF)和低通滤波器(LPF)分别实现了99.46%和99.49%的平均读出保真度，单比特门保真度达99.94%，同时提供强Purcell保护和有效的量子比特复位通道。
AI.motivation: 传统带通Purcell滤波器存在有限通带和较大尺寸的问题，难以扩展到大规模超导量子处理器。需要一种既能提供强Purcell保护实现高保真读出，又具有紧凑可扩展性架构的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出边沿通带Purcell滤波器架构，通过单一传输边沿分离读出频带与量子比特保护频带。根据传输频带位于截止频率的上方或下方，分别实现为高通滤波器(HPF)或低通滤波器(LPF)。利用滤波器的固有耗散模式作为量子比特复位通道，实现紧凑的集成架构。
AI.result: HPF在150ns脉冲下达到99.46%(最高99.56%)的平均读出保真度，LPF在130ns脉冲下达到99.49%(最高99.57%)。平均单比特门保真度HPF为99.94%、LPF为99.93%。相比无滤波器的Purcell极限，两种滤波器均显著延长了量子比特寿命，且滤波器阶数越高Purcell保护越强。
AI.conclusion: 该Edge-pass Purcell滤波器在单一紧凑结构中统一实现了快速高保真读出、Purcell保护和有效复位功能，为大规模容错量子计算提供了可扩展的架构方案。

title: Far-from-equilibrium scaling of non-abelian Goldstone modes
summary: We identify a broad class of nonthermal phases generated by the interplay of continuous symmetry breaking and weak nonequilibrium driving. Extending Kardar-Parisi-Zhang (KPZ) physics beyond the single $SO(2)$ chronon associated with periodically broken time translations, we construct nonequilibrium nonlinear sigma models for $SO(2)\times O(N)$ symmetry, describing non-Abelian time crystals with coexisting temporal and internal order. This symmetry structure arises naturally in driven quantum materials, active matter, and optically induced periodic states. For rotating and oscillating phases, we derive the Goldstone theories and show that chronon-$O(N)$ couplings remain finite deep in the ordered regime. One-loop renormalization group analysis reveals a KPZ-like dimensional structure: in $d=1,2$, arbitrarily weak nonequilibrium perturbations destabilize the equilibrium fixed point and generate strongly coupled nonthermal fixed points, realizing emergent equilibrium breaking. By contrast, for $d > 2$, weak perturbations are irrelevant and effective equilibrium is restored. A central result is unconventional weak dynamic scaling in the rotating phase: strongly coupled Goldstone sectors acquire distinct universal dynamical exponents despite belonging to the same order parameter. We characterize this scaling analytically and corroborate it through direct simulations in $1+1$ dimensions. In the oscillating phase, we recover and extend weak-scaling regimes known from drifting polymers. Finally, compactness and topological defects ultimately destroy long-range order but leave experimentally accessible nonthermal scaling windows. Together, these results extend KPZ universality to non-Abelian symmetry breaking.

AI.tldr: 本文识别了一类由连续对称性破缺与弱非平衡驱动相互作用产生的非热相，将KPZ物理从单一SO(2)时间平移破缺推广到SO(2)×O(N)非阿贝尔对称性，构建了描述非阿贝尔时间晶体的非平衡非线性sigma模型，并在旋转与振荡相中推导了Goldstone理论。单圈重整化群分析揭示了KPZ类维度结构：d=1,2时任意弱扰动都会失稳平衡不动点并产生强耦合非热不动点；d>2时弱扰动无关，有效平衡恢复。核心结果是旋转相中非传统弱动态标度：强耦合Goldstone区具有不同的普适动力学指数。振荡相恢复了漂移聚合物中的弱标度区。拓扑缺陷最终破坏长程有序但留下实验可观测的非热标度窗口。
AI.motivation: 将KPZ普适类从单一SO(2)离散时间平移破缺（传统时间晶体）推广到SO(2)×O(N)非阿贝尔对称性破缺的非平衡系统，此类对称性结构出现在驱动量子材料、活性物质和光诱导周期态中。作者旨在理解这类更广泛对称性下非热相的普适行为，特别是不同Goldstone模式间可能存在不同的动态标度指数，以及非平衡驱动的相关性维度依赖。
AI.method: 作者构造了SO(2)×O(N)对称性的非平衡非线性sigma模型；推导了旋转相和振荡相中的Goldstone有效理论；进行单圈重整化群分析以研究平衡不动点的稳定性及非热不动点的出现；通过解析分析和1+1维度的直接数值模拟来验证非传统弱动态标度行为；并分析了拓扑缺陷（涡旋/瞬子）对长程有序的破坏效应。
AI.result: 维度d=1,2时任意弱非平衡扰动都会破坏平衡不动点，产生强耦合非热不动点（涌现平衡性破缺）；d>2时弱扰动无关，有效平衡恢复。旋转相中不同强耦合Goldstone扇区表现出不同的普适动力学指数（非传统弱动态标度），并经数值模拟验证。振荡相恢复并扩展了漂移聚合物中的弱标度区。拓扑缺陷虽破坏长程有序，但留下实验可访问的非热标度窗口。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将KPZ普适类系统性地扩展到非阿贝尔对称性破缺，建立了非阿贝尔时间晶体的动态标度理论框架，揭示了"涌现平衡破缺"与维度相关的非平衡相变结构，并预言了实验中可观测的非热标度行为。

title: Deep Vision in Smart Manufacturing: MODERN Framework for Intelligent Quality Monitoring and Diagnosis
summary: Smart manufacturing processes are often installed with a large number of sensors, imaging devices and computers, which not only enable instant communication across various modules of a production system but also aid in intelligent manufacturing management. In this paper, we introduce MODERN, a deep learning framework for quality monitoring and fault isolation, which integrates these enhanced capabilities into the practice of industrial quality control. Using the architecture of an inception residual neural network, we develop a control chart that monitors the likelihood of a product containing defects. We also propose a faulty region estimator that identifies the defective area using transfer learning. To extend our framework to cases where there are not sufficient training data, we suggest a transfer monitoring technique that requires only a small sample size and a hypothesis testing approach for quantitatively assessing the applicability of our method. Theoretically, we establish the minimax optimal convergence rate for both our defect likelihood estimation and fault diagnosis. Our results lead to a seemingly counter-intuitive managerial implication - it may not always be in a manufacturer's best interests to keep upgrading its monitoring equipment regardless of the cost. Empirically, we demonstrate the superior performance of our method in comparison with a state-of-the-art approach using both simulated experiments and real data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MODERN，一个基于深度学习（初始残差神经网络架构）的工业制造质量监控与故障隔离框架，包括缺陷可能性控制图、利用迁移学习的故障区域估计器，以及适用于小样本场景的迁移监控技术和假设检验方法。理论建立了缺陷似然估计与故障诊断的极小极大最优收敛速率，实证通过模拟和真实数据验证了其优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 智能制造过程安装了大量传感器和成像设备，但如何将这些增强能力有效整合到工业质量控制实践中仍是一个挑战。需要一种深度学习方法来进行质量监控和故障隔离，以充分利用工业大数据。
AI.method: 1) 采用初始残差神经网络架构构建控制图，监控产品含缺陷的可能性；2) 提出基于迁移学习的故障区域估计器来识别缺陷区域；3) 针对训练数据不足的情形，提出仅需小样本量的迁移监控技术；4) 使用假设检验方法定量评估方法适用性；5) 理论上建立极小极大最优收敛速率。
AI.result: 建立了缺陷似然估计和故障诊断的极小极大最优收敛速率；通过模拟实验和真实数据验证，方法优于现有最先进方法；得出反直觉的管理启示——制造商不一定总是应升级监控设备。
AI.conclusion: MODERN框架能够有效整合深度学习能力于工业质量控制，在理论和实证层面均表现出优越性。同时揭示了一个重要的管理洞见：设备升级决策需要考虑成本与收益的平衡，而非一味追求技术更新。

title: Posterior Inference of Hamiltonian Parameters from RIXS Spectroscopy
summary: We present the first application of simulation-based inference to resonant inelastic X-ray scattering spectroscopy. Using truncated marginal neural ratio estimation to efficiently restrict the prior and conditional flow matching as the joint density estimator, we infer full posteriors with a modest simulation budget for two Ni$^{2+}$ compounds---NiPS$_3$ as a representative covalent case and K$_2$NiF$_4$ as a more atomic one. We demonstrate that a vision transformer encoder whose tokenization matches the physical layout of the RIXS map yields better-covered and sharper posteriors than generic image encoders. Applying the validated method to experimental NiPS$_3$ and K$_2$NiF$_4$ data, we recover a joint posterior that reveals parameter correlations invisible to point estimators, and a posterior predictive distribution that closely matches the observed spectrum. The amortized posterior unlocks a class of analyses not previously available to the field such as nuisance-marginalized uncertainty quantification, multi-measurement posterior fusion and active experimental design.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将基于仿真的推断（SBI）应用于共振非弹性X射线散射（RIXS）光谱学，利用截断边际神经比率估计和条件流匹配作为联合密度估计器，在适度的仿真预算下为两种Ni²⁺化合物（NiPS₃和K₂NiF₄）推断完整的后验分布。通过匹配RIXS图谱物理布局的视觉变换器编码器，获得了比通用图像编码器更优的后验覆盖和锐度，并在实验数据上恢复了参数相关性、后验预测分布及多种新的分析能力。
AI.motivation: RIXS光谱学中的参数推断长期以来依赖点估计方法，无法揭示参数间相关性及完整的不确定性；同时仿真成本高昂，需要一种能够高效地从模拟数据中学习参数后验分布的方法。
AI.method: 采用截断边际神经比率估计（truncated marginal neural ratio estimation）高效地约束先验，以条件流匹配（conditional flow matching）作为联合密度估计器；使用视觉变换器（ViT）编码器，并将其tokenization设计与RIXS图谱的物理布局对齐，优于通用图像编码器。
AI.result: 在NiPS₃（共价体系）和K₂NiF₄（原子性体系）上以适度仿真预算获得完整后验。物理解耦的ViT编码器产生覆盖更好且更锐利的后验。在实验数据上恢复出点估计无法揭示的参数相关性，后验预测分布与观测光谱高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: 摊销化后验（amortized posterior）为RIXS领域开辟了新分析范式，包括带干扰参数边缘化的不确定性量化、多测量后验融合以及主动实验设计等此前不可用的能力。

title: Accurate and efficient calculation of atomic forces in solids with non-self-consistent hybrid functionals
summary: Hybrid functionals are routinely employed self-consistently within the generalized Kohn-Sham framework. The evaluation of the nonlocal Fock exchange operator makes hybrid functional calculations computationally expensive, in particular with plane-wave basis sets. Here, we investigate the advantages of non-self-consistent hybrid functional calculations, focusing on the evaluation of atomic forces. The analytical force terms that arise due to non-self-consistency are computed using density functional perturbation theory (DFPT), as implemented within the Quantum ESPRESSO distribution. A non-self-consistent hybrid force calculation thus consists of self-consistent DFPT calculations with a local or semi-local functional and a single evaluation of the Fock exchange operator. The overall computational cost is, thereby, reduced in general, especially for solids that require a dense Brillouin-zone sampling. Moreover, results for structural parameters are barely affected by self-consistency, and vibrational frequencies are typically agreeing within 0.5%, thus making non-self-consistent calculations an interesting alternative.

AI.tldr: 本文研究非自洽杂化泛函计算的可行性，重点考察原子受力的计算。通过DFPT方法在Quantum ESPRESSO中实现非自洽性引起的解析受力项，证明非自洽杂化受力计算仅需局域/半局域泛函的自洽DFPT计算加上一次Fock交换算符评估，可显著降低计算成本，尤其在需要密集布里渊区取样的固体中；结构参数几乎不受自洽性影响，振动频率误差通常在0.5%以内。
AI.motivation: 杂化泛函在广义Kohn-Sham框架中通常自洽使用，但非局域Fock交换算符的评估使计算成本高昂，尤其在平面波基组下。作者旨在探索非自洽杂化泛函计算的优劣，以降低计算复杂度。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函微扰理论（DFPT）计算由于非自洽性产生的解析受力项，实现于Quantum ESPRESSO软件包中。非自洽杂化受力计算流程为：先进行局域或半局域泛函的自洽DFPT计算，再对Fock交换算符做单次评估。
AI.result: 非自洽杂化受力计算在总体上降低了计算成本，特别是对于需要密集布里渊区取样的固体；结构参数基本不受自洽性的影响，振动频率通常与自洽结果吻合在0.5%以内。
AI.conclusion: 非自洽杂化泛函计算是自洽计算的有力替代方案，在保持结构参数和振动频率精度接近的同时显著降低计算成本。

title: Heuristic Lookahead Distillation Protocol Search
summary: Bipartite qubit entanglement distillation is the process of converting noisy ebits into pure ebits using only local operations and classical communication. This is a core operation for quantum repeaters, enabling such crucial tasks as long-distance quantum communication and distributed quantum computing. In this work, we introduce a method for searching for entanglement distillation protocols and, using this technique, distil qubit Werner states at a higher rate than could be achieved using previously discovered protocols. In particular, we demonstrate the advantage of our new distillation strategy by improving the best-known lower bound for the two-way-assisted quantum capacity of the qubit depolarising channel across a wide range of channel parameters, making progress in one of the long-standing problems of quantum information theory.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种搜索纠缠蒸馏协议的新方法，并利用该方法以比以往协议更高的速率蒸馏量子比特Werner态，同时改进了去极化信道双向辅助量子容量的最佳已知下界。
AI.motivation: 纠缠蒸馏是量子中继器的核心操作，对长距离量子通信和分布式量子计算至关重要。然而，寻找高效的蒸馏协议具有挑战性，且去极化信道双向辅助量子容量下界这一量子信息理论长期开放问题需要改进。
AI.method: 作者引入了一种系统化的方法来搜索纠缠蒸馏协议，利用该方法设计了更高效的蒸馏策略，用于处理量子比特Werner态。
AI.result: 新方法实现了比此前已知协议更高的Werner态蒸馏速率，并在广泛的信道参数范围内改善了去极化信道的双向辅助量子容量的最佳已知下界。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了新搜索方法的优势，在量子信息理论的一个长期悬而未决的问题上取得了实质性进展，为未来更高效的纠缠蒸馏协议和量子通信提供了新的途径。

title: Small-world structure of quantum computer hardware
summary: We show that the network of quantum register states of a quantum computer (QC), coupled through residual two-body interactions between qubits, exhibits small-world properties analogous to those of complex networks found in human society. The most probable Erdős number between any two states is about 9, comparable to the six degrees of separation reported by Milgram for social networks. Using the $\mathring{A}$berg criterion, which retains only interactions exceeding the local energy spacing, we construct an effective ($\mathring{A}$berg) network and show that, above a critical coupling strength, this network percolates into a giant component spanning nearly the whole quantum register space. This percolation transition closely matches the onset of quantum chaos and dynamical thermalization established previously via costly exact diagonalization, while our approach extends the accessible system size up to $n_q=30$ qubits.

AI.tldr: 本文研究表明，量子计算机的量子寄存器态网络在残余二体相互作用下表现出类似人类社会复杂网络的小世界特性（最可能Erdős数约9，对应Milgram的六度分隔）。利用Åberg准则构建有效网络，发现超过临界耦合强度后网络发生渗流相变形成巨分量，该相变与量子混沌和动态热化的起始高度吻合，且计算规模可扩展至30个量子比特。
AI.motivation: 先前研究量子混沌和动态热化需要昂贵的精确对角化方法，计算规模受限。作者希望利用网络科学工具，通过构建寄存器态网络来高效探测量子混沌及热化的涌现，并扩展到更大的系统尺寸。
AI.method: 构建量子寄存器态网络，节点为量子态，边由量子比特间残余二体相互作用连接。使用Åberg准则（仅保留超过局域能级间距的相互作用）构建有效（Åberg）网络，通过网络分析（小世界属性、Erdős数、渗流理论）研究网络结构及临界耦合强度下的渗流转变。
AI.result: 量子寄存器态网络展现出小世界属性，最可能Erdős数约9，与社会网络中的六度分隔相当。在临界耦合强度以上，Åberg网络发生渗流转变形成跨越几乎整个量子寄存器空间的巨分量。该渗流转变与先前通过精确对角化确立的量子混沌和动态热化起始点高度吻合，且可将可访问系统尺度扩展至30个量子比特。
AI.conclusion: 网络科学方法（尤其是渗流分析）为研究量子混沌和热化提供了一种高效替代方案，克服了精确对角化的计算瓶颈，揭示量子寄存器态网络结构与量子动力学行为之间的深层联系。

title: Extending Occam's inversion with lasso fusion, overcomplete dictionaries, and isotropic total variation regularisation
summary: Occam's inversion is a robust algorithm to perform nonlinear geophysical inversion. It provides the smoothest model within observation noise, thereby discouraging geological overinterpretation. While Occam originally penalised l2 model roughness, l1 can be used to provide models that are visually sharp. However, l1 regularised geophysical inversion has diverged from the larger body of statistics and imaging literature. For example, l1 regularisation with a difference operator (i.e., total variation) in multiple dimensions has two distinct forms, only one of which is invariant to edge orientation -- a distinction often overlooked in geophysics. In one dimension this reduces to the fused lasso problem in statistics. Within the Occam framework, for l2 data norm and l1 model regularisation, we show that lasso fusion through either synthesis or analysis leads to the same 1D problem. We extend the framework to multiple dimensions and to operators such as wavelet transforms in a dictionary, unravelling the mathematics behind three commonly used solvers for l1 regularised problems. These are coordinate descent, iteratively reweighted least squares (IRLS), and split Bregman. We use them to solve a sequence of problems that are linear (1D regression, 2D deblurring) and nonlinear (1D airborne transient electromagnetics) including a field data example. We recommend coordinate descent for 1D problems, and IRLS over split Bregman for 2D problems, with IRLS requiring up to an order of magnitude fewer least squares solves. We hope this work will further encourage geophysicists to adopt l1 regularised inversion, by presenting its various forms as a familiar Occam's inversion.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了l1正则化的地球物理反演方法，将其统一到Occam反演框架下，阐明了合成与分析、总变差与字典等不同形式之间的数学联系，并对比了坐标下降、IRLS和分裂Bregman三种求解器的性能，为地球物理学家采用l1正则化反演提供了实用指导。
AI.motivation: Occam反演传统上使用l2模型粗糙度惩罚，虽然能提供平滑模型，但不利于识别清晰的地质边界。l1正则化虽然能产生视觉上更锐利的模型，但地球物理领域的l1正则化研究已与统计学和成像文献脱节，例如多维总变差存在两种形式（仅一种具有旋转不变性），这一区别常被忽视。作者希望通过统一框架消除这种割裂。
AI.method: 在Occam框架内，对l2数据范数和l1模型正则化，证明了一维情形下合成（synthesis）和分析（analysis）两种求解方式等价于融合Lasso问题。将框架推广到多维及字典（如小波变换），并解析了三种常用求解器——坐标下降、迭代重加权最小二乘（IRLS）和分裂Bregman——背后的数学原理，随后在1D回归、2D去模糊（线性问题）和1D航空瞬变电磁（非线性问题，含野外数据）上进行了数值验证。
AI.result: 对一维问题推荐坐标下降法；对二维问题推荐IRLS而非分裂Bregman，因为IRLS所需的二乘求解次数可少一个数量级。所有方法均在Occam反演统一框架下实现，并通过线性和非线性问题测试验证。
AI.conclusion: 通过将l1正则化反演的各种形式呈现为熟悉的Occam反演变体，有助于地球物理学家更广泛地采用l1正则化，在保持Occam反演稳健性的同时获得更清晰的地下模型。

title: Anomalous Orbital Reconstruction Controlled by Interorbital Correlations and Hund's Coupling
summary: The microscopic origin of anomalous orbital polarization in a class of low-dimensional correlated oxides remains unresolved due to the competition among crystal-field effects, electronic correlations, and orbital-dependent dimensionality. Using dynamical mean-field theory, we investigate a two orbital Hubbard model with orbital-dependent dimensionality and reveal the mechanism for anomalous orbital polarization through orbital reconstruction beyond the bare crystal-field picture. We identify interorbital Coulomb interaction-induced charge competition as a key microscopic mechanism responsible for the orbital redistribution, which leads first to an orbital-polarized correlated metal and subsequently to an orbital-polarized Mott insulator. We further find that Hund's coupling acts as a filling-dependent regulator of orbital reconstruction. It weakens the correlation-induced orbital redistribution at quarter filling by competing with interorbital charge fluctuations, while at half filling it completely suppresses the orbital-polarized state by stabilizing high-spin orbital-balanced configurations. These results provide a unified picture of correlation driven orbital reconstruction and highlight the relevance of interorbital interactions and Hund's coupling for understanding orbital phenomena in low-dimensional transition-metal oxides.

AI.tldr: 本文通过动力学平均场理论（DMFT）研究二维两轨道Hubbard模型，揭示了低维关联氧化物中反常轨道极化的微观起源：轨道间库仑相互作用引起的电荷竞争是轨道重构（从轨道极化关联金属到轨道极化Mott绝缘体）的关键机制，而Hund耦合作为随填充数变化的调节器，在四分之一填充时抑制、在半填充时完全消除轨道极化态。
AI.motivation: 低维关联氧化物中异常轨道极化的微观起源长期悬而未决，因为晶体场效应、电子关联和轨道依赖维度之间存在竞争，现有理论框架（纯晶体场图像）无法解释实验观测到的反常轨道极化行为。
AI.method: 采用动力学平均场理论（DMFT）研究包含轨道依赖维度的两轨道Hubbard模型，通过分析轨道重构过程，系统考察轨道间库仑相互作用与Hund耦合在不同填充（四分之一填充和半填充）下的作用。
AI.result: （1）识别出轨道间库仑相互作用诱导的电荷竞争是轨道重分配的关键微观机制，该机制先导致轨道极化关联金属态，进而导致轨道极化Mott绝缘态；（2）Hund耦合在四分之一填充下通过与轨道间电荷涨落竞争削弱关联诱导的轨道重构；（3）在半填充下，Hund耦合通过稳定高自旋轨道平衡构型完全抑制轨道极化态。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了关联驱动轨道重构的统一图景，强调轨道间相互作用和Hund耦合对理解低维过渡金属氧化物中轨道现象的关键相关性。

title: Electrostatic Phenomenology Benchmarks for Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials in Electrochemistry: Beyond the Energy-Force Metric
summary: Accurate treatment of long-range interactions in machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) is essential for electrochemical simulations. However, aggregate energy and force errors alone are insufficient to establish an MLIP's physical accuracy since they do not detect qualitative inconsistencies in the model such as the prediction of image-charge attraction, dielectric screening, or charge transfer. We introduce a benchmark suite EPhEct (Electrostatic Phenomena for Electrochemistry) of focused test cases designed to evaluate MLIPs on electrochemically relevant physical phenomena. The tests probe for image-charge attraction at a metal electrode, the splitting between longitudinal and transverse optical phonons as a probe of ionic and electronic screening, the dipole moment of interfacial water, and Fermi-level pinning during ion discharge. These tests establish a qualitative diagnostic routine complementary to aggregate energy-force metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EPhEct基准测试套件，用于评估机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）在电化学模拟中长程相互作用的物理准确性，通过聚焦图像电荷吸引、介电屏蔽、电荷转移等定性物理现象来补充传统聚合能量-力误差指标。
AI.motivation: 机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）在电化学模拟中需精确处理长程相互作用，但仅依靠聚合能量和力的误差无法捕捉模型的定性物理不一致性，如错误预测图像电荷吸引、介电屏蔽或电荷转移等。因此需要一种能够检测这些定性物理现象的评估方法。
AI.method: 作者构建了EPhEct（Electrostatic Phenomena for Electrochemistry）基准测试套件，包含多个聚焦的测试用例：金属电极处的图像电荷吸引、纵/横光学声子分裂（作为离子和电子屏蔽探针）、界面水偶极矩、以及离子放电过程中的费米能级钉扎。这些测试旨在作为补充聚合能量-力指标的定性诊断工具。
AI.result: 该基准测试套件建立了定性的诊断流程，能够检测MLIPs在电化学相关物理现象中的定性错误，与传统聚合能量-力指标形成互补。
AI.conclusion: EPhEct提供了一套聚焦的定性测试用例，用于系统评估MLIPs在电化学环境下长程静电相互作用的物理准确性，弥补了传统聚合误差指标无法捕捉定性物理不一致性的不足。

title: Tracking real-space quantum state breathing through Floquet-projector geometry
summary: Periodic driving of spatially periodic quantum systems generates band structures that are absent in static crystals. We present a quantum geometric theory to characterize the Floquet-Bloch states at stroboscopic times and during micromotion on equal footing. Our framework builds upon time-evolved Floquet projectors that connect static quantum geometry, micromotion-operator geometry, and Floquet topology. To illustrate the formalism, we introduce the Floquet-projector quantum metric, which we employ to characterize the real-space breathing of localized states in a driven chiral-symmetric integrable spin chain. The Floquet-projector quantum metric, integrated over the Brillouin zone, captures the oscillatory variance during micromotion and, at symmetry-selected times, is bounded below by Floquet topological invariants. We further describe how the Floquet projector geometry enables a systematic investigation of micromotion dynamics in periodically driven lattice systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个量子几何理论框架，用于统一刻画周期性驱动量子系统中的Floquet-Bloch态（包括频闪时刻和微运动过程）。该框架基于时间演化的Floquet投影算符，将静态量子几何、微运动算符几何和Floquet拓扑联系起来，并引入了Floquet投影量子度量来表征驱动手性对称可积自旋链中局域态的空间呼吸行为。
AI.motivation: 周期性驱动空间周期量子系统能够产生静态晶体中不存在的能带结构，但目前缺乏一个统一的理论框架来同时描述频闪时刻和微运动过程中的Floquet-Bloch态的几何性质，特别是量子几何与Floquet拓扑之间的深层联系尚未被充分揭示。
AI.method: 论文构建了一个基于时间演化Floquet投影算符的量子几何理论框架，该框架将静态量子几何、微运动算符几何与Floquet拓扑统一起来。具体地，作者引入了Floquet投影量子度量这一新工具，并通过布里渊区积分来刻画局域态在周期性驱动下的空间振荡方差。
AI.result: 研究发现：Floquet投影量子度量在布里渊区上的积分能够捕捉微运动过程中的振荡方差；在对称性选择的特定时刻，该积分被Floquet拓扑不变量所下界限制；该框架为周期性驱动晶格系统中微运动动力学的系统性研究提供了有效途径。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了一个统一的量子几何框架来刻画Floquet系统的几何与拓扑性质，为研究周期性驱动量子系统中微运动动力学的几何根源提供了新的理论工具，特别是在手性对称可积自旋链中展示了其应用价值。

title: Generalizing the multidimensional thermodynamic uncertainty relation to combinations of arbitrary counting variables
summary: Uncertainty relations provide lower bounds for otherwise hidden quantities of a partially accessible Markov network like the mean entropy production rate and the total dynamical activity. The thermodynamic uncertainty relation (TUR) is arguably the most prominent one and involves the precision of a fluctuating net current. One of its major generalizations is the multidimensional TUR (MTUR), which yields a tighter bound by using covariances of a set of observed net currents. We generalize this latter bound to time-dependently driven processes with arbitrary initial state and arbitrary measurement duration. Furthermore, this bound can be used with a set of fluctuating counting observables each of which can be time-antisymmetric, time-symmetric or time-asymmetric, i.e., a net current, a traffic or a flow. We can even allow for coarse-grained observations in which each counting observable could consist of multiple indiscernable observed transitions of the underlying system. Thus, we generalize the MTUR, extensions of the TUR for time-dependent processes based on one current, and an estimator based on one flux or on one traffic in a unifying way. We illustrate this general uncertainty relation with simple examples.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了多维热力学不确定关系（MTUR）的统一推广，适用于时间依赖驱动的马尔可夫网络，支持任意初始状态、任意观测时长、不同类型的计数可观测量（净电流、交通量、流量），甚至允许粗粒化观测中多个不可区分跃迁的合并。
AI.motivation: 热力学不确定关系（TUR）为部分可观测马尔可夫网络中隐藏量（如平均熵产生率、总动力学活性）提供下界。已有的TUR扩展主要针对单一电流，而多维TUR（MTUR）虽能通过多个观测电流的协方差提供更紧的界，但尚未被推广到时间依赖驱动、任意初始状态和任意测量时长的情况。作者希望将这些不同的推广统一起来。
AI.method: 作者将多维TUR推广到时间依赖驱动过程，允许任意初始状态和任意观测时长。该界可适用于一组计数可观测量，每个可观测量可为时间反对称（净电流）、时间对称（交通）或时间非对称（流量）。此外还允许粗粒化观测，即每个计数可观测量可由底层系统的多个不可区分跃迁组成。通过统一框架涵盖了MTUR、基于单电流的时变TUR扩展以及基于单一流量或交通的估计器。
AI.result: 文章给出了统一的广义不确定关系，并通过简单示例加以说明验证。该结果将多种已有的TUR扩展在时间依赖驱动场景下统一为一个更普适的框架。
AI.conclusion: 作者成功构建了一个统一的广义热力学不确定关系框架，同时覆盖净电流、交通量和流量三类计数可观测量，支持时间依赖驱动、粗粒化观测、任意初始条件和观测时长，为部分可观测马尔可夫网络的隐藏量估计提供了更普适且更紧的下界工具。

title: Offline Deep Q* Estimation with Diffusion Models
summary: In offline RL, estimating the optimal action-value function $Q^*$ can be formulated as solving the optimal Bellman equation based solely on offline observations. A fundamental challenge is that the reward function and transition kernel are unknown, so the optimal Bellman operator is not directly observable from data. To address this issue, we propose a novel framework that decouples operator estimation from value function learning. In this approach, we first formulate conditional diffusion models to estimate the reward law and transition kernel, which induces a data-driven approximation of the optimal Bellman operator. We then plug these estimators into the Bellman equation and obtain a deep estimator of $Q^*$ by minimizing the empirical Bellman residual over a neural network function class. Theoretically, we first establish sharp nonasymptotic convergence rates for learning the optimal Bellman operator through an end-to-end analysis of conditional diffusion estimation in total variation distance. We then establish the oracle value-stage rate $\widetilde{\mathcal O}\bigl(n^{-\frac{2β}{d_x+d_a+2β}}\bigr)$ for the excess Bellman residual risk. Finally, under a concentrability condition, we translate this residual bound into an $L^2$ convergence rate of $\widetilde{\mathcal O}\bigl(n^{-\fracβ{d_x+d_a+2β}}\bigr)$ for the resulting deep estimator of $Q^*$, where $d_x$ and $d_a$ denote the dimensions of the state and action spaces, respectively, and $β$ denotes the Hölder smoothness index of $Q^*$. Importantly, our theoretical analysis does not rely on completeness assumptions commonly used in deep RL theory. Extensive numerical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method and its strong empirical performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种解耦算子估计与值函数学习的离线强化学习框架，利用条件扩散模型估计奖励函数和转移核，从而构造最优Bellman算子的数据驱动近似，并据此得到Q*的深度估计器。理论上建立了最优Bellman算子学习的非渐近收敛率、超额Bellman残差风险的oracle率以及Q*估计器的L2收敛率，且不需要深度RL理论中常用的完备性假设。
AI.motivation: 离线强化学习中，最优Q*可通过求解最优Bellman方程得到，但奖励函数和转移核未知导致最优Bellman算子无法从数据中直接观测，这是离线RL的基本挑战。
AI.method: 首先利用条件扩散模型估计奖励定律和转移核，诱导出最优Bellman算子的数据驱动近似；然后将估计器代入Bellman方程，通过在神经网络函数类上最小化经验Bellman残差来获得Q*的深度估计器。
AI.result: 建立了条件扩散估计在总变差距离下学习最优Bellman算子的锐利非渐近收敛率；获得超额Bellman残差风险的oracle率O(n^{-2β/(d_x+d_a+2β)})；在集中性条件下，得到Q*估计器L2收敛率O(n^{-β/(d_x+d_a+2β)})。
AI.conclusion: 该框架避免了深度RL理论中常用的完备性假设，数值实验验证了方法的有效性和强经验性能。

title: Periodicity-driven revision of the phase diagram of the generalized Baxter-Wu model with asymmetric complex couplings
summary: The conventional self-dual lines of the generalized Baxter-Wu (GBW) model with asymmetric complex couplings are known to be $\sinh(2K)=\pm \cos(2φ)$, where $K$ and $φ$ are the real and imaginary parts of the coupling. We demonstrate that these lines are incomplete: the periodicity of the partition function, encoded in the cosine factor of the bundled Boltzmann weight, generates additional self-dual lines $\sinh(2K)=\pm \sin(2φ)$. Guided by the complete set of self-dual candidates, we perform Monte Carlo simulations using brute-force reweighting (Metropolis) and the Wang-Landau methods. Simulations indicate that the self-dual lines at the partition-function minima $φ_{\mathcal{Z}_{\min}}=(2n+1)π/8$ constitute a critical threshold. They are genuine critical boundaries for $|K| \ge \frac{1}{2}\operatorname{arsinh}(\cos(π/4)) \approx 0.32924$, while for smaller $|K|$ they are not. At $φ_{\mathcal{Z}_{\min}}$, the sign problem is most severe and finite-size scaling corrections are largest; the local peak observed below the phase boundary in the temperature scan is thus a finite-size artifact, not a genuine new phase. We further clarify the capability and limitations of the average sign and its derivatives for detecting phase transitions. In particular, the negative peak of the average sign at $φ_{\mathcal{Z}_{\min}}$ does not correspond to a genuine phase transition. We also evaluate the Wang-Landau method, which, despite formally circumventing the sign problem, still faces the exponential barrier.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了广义Baxter-Wu模型自对偶线的不完整性：除了传统已知的四个自对偶线 sinh(2K)=±cos(2φ)，还存在由配分函数周期性衍生的附加自对偶线 sinh(2K)=±sin(2φ)。通过Metropolis重加权和Wang-Landau模拟表明，配分函数最小值处 φ=(2n+1)π/8 构成临界阈值：当 |K|≥0.32924 时为真实临界边界，较小 |K| 时则不是；该处的负号问题最严重，峰值是有限尺寸伪影而非新相。
AI.motivation: 澄清广义Baxter-Wu模型中自对偶线的完整集合，纠正此前仅考虑 sinh(2K)=±cos(2φ) 的不完整认知；明确自对偶线在临界参数区间的真实性质，区分有限尺寸伪影与真实相变，并评估符号问题及其导数在检测相变中的能力与局限。
AI.method: 理论推导基于配分函数配分的周期性（bundled Boltzmann权重中的余弦因子）推导附加自对偶线；数值方法包括暴力重加权（Metropolis）和Wang-Landau两种蒙特卡洛方法，在完整自对偶候选线上进行有限尺寸标度分析，并系统评估平均符号及其导数在相变检测中的作用。
AI.result: 发现附加自对偶线 sinh(2K)=±sin(2φ)；在 φ=(2n+1)π/8 处，当 |K|≥1/2·arsinh(cos(π/4))≈0.32924 时为真实临界边界，较小 |K| 时非临界；该处的负号问题最严重、有限尺寸修正最大；温度扫描中临界边界以下的局部峰是有限尺寸伪影。平均符号的负峰（在 φ_Zmin 处）并不对应真实相变。Wang-Landau虽形式上规避符号问题，仍面临指数壁垒。
AI.conclusion: 完整自对偶线集合应由正弦和余弦两类共同构成；临界性仅在于参数空间中特定区域（|K|≥0.32924）的自对偶线处成立，且须谨慎区分有限尺寸效应与真实相变；平均符号及其导数不能可靠地替代序参量检测相变；Wang-Landau方法并未从根本上解决负号问题的指数困难。

title: Efficient simulation of second-order phase transitions in quantum anharmonic materials
summary: When a crystal undergoes a second-order structural phase transition, such as in ferroelectrics, Peierls, and charge-density waves, the diverging fluctuations of the order parameter lead to the break- down of the standard phonon quasiparticle picture. Simulating these highly anharmonic regimes is notoriously challenging, as methods such as molecular dynamics suffer from a critical slowdown near the transition point, while the harmonic approximation fails dramatically at saddle points of the energy landscape stabilized by quantum or thermal ionic fluctuations. This work introduces a new approach, based on the variational free-energy principle, to predict critical long-range behavior and dynamical spectra in strongly anharmonic systems, even when quantum ionic fluctuations dominate. The proposed framework builds upon the stochastic self- consistent harmonic approximation but reduces its computational scaling with the number of atoms, N, from O(N^6) to O(N^2) and the memory requirement from O(N^4) to O(N). We benchmark the method on the prototypical lead-free metal-halide perovskite CsSnI3, a promising candidate for photovoltaic engineering, simulating its phase stability and Raman spectrum near the phase transition, where the breakdown of the quasiparticle picture becomes evident. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the method by computing the full free-energy Hessian and the critical temperature in a supercell with 1080 atoms. Such simulations would have required tens of thousands of years with the legacy approach; it is now feasible in a few hours on consumer hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于变分自由能原理的新方法，用于预测强非谐系统中的临界长程行为和动力学谱，将随机自洽谐波近似的计算复杂度从O(N^6)降至O(N^2)、内存需求从O(N^4)降至O(N)，并在CsSnI3钙钛矿材料上验证了其高效性。
AI.motivation: 二级结构相变（如铁电、Peierls和电荷密度波）中，序参量的发散涨落导致标准声子准粒子图像失效。分子动力学在临界点附近存在严重的临界慢化问题，而谐波近似在鞍点处完全失效，因此模拟这些强非谐区域极具挑战。
AI.method: 基于变分自由能原理构建新框架，在随机自洽谐波近似（SSCHA）基础之上，通过算法改进将计算复杂度从O(N^6)降至O(N^2)、内存需求从O(N^4)降至O(N)，使量子离子涨落主导的强非谐系统的仿真成为可能。
AI.result: 在1080原子的CsSnI3超胞上计算了完整自由能Hessian矩阵和临界温度，模拟了相变附近的Raman光谱，明确了准粒子图像失效的特征。该计算在传统方法下需数万年，新方法在消费级硬件上仅需数小时即可完成。
AI.conclusion: 该方法使大规模强非谐系统的量子效应模拟从不可行变为现实，为研究铁电体、热电材料等类型的相变和光谱性质提供了高效可行的计算工具。

title: Entanglement Negativity in Noisy Quantum Volume Sampling
summary: The Quantum Volume protocol uses scrambling random circuits to benchmark NISQ computers. Quantum Volume is generally well-regarded as a benchmark for small, noisy, quantum computers because it requires the quantum computer to implement many non-local entangling gates within a square-shaped circuit, which incentivizes high qubit count, long qubit coherence times, and low error rates on all hardware gates. Quantum Volume circuits inherently produce high-entanglement states that are fragile to errors and decoherence. The Quantum Volume benchmark measures an observable called heavy-output-probability (HOP), where an HOP of $0.5$ corresponds to complete loss of coherence, and in the limit of system size an HOP $\approx 0.84$ for a fully coherent quantum processor. Here, we numerically study the tradeoff between depolarizing noise, entanglement as quantified by the bipartite negativity measure, and HOP in quantum volume circuits. Our results contextualize prior small scale quantum volume demonstrations on quantum computers and highlight that under depolarizing noise, due to finite system size effects heavy output probabilities can be greater than $0.5$ while the bipartite negativity entanglement has been destroyed. This implies, although improbable, that a NISQ computer could pass the Quantum Volume benchmark test threshold of $2/3$ while the underlying quantum computation has no global entanglement -- albeit only for small $n$.

AI.tldr: 本文通过数值模拟研究了量子体积（Quantum Volume）协议中退极化噪声、二分负度纠缠度量和重输出概率（HOP）之间的权衡关系，发现由于有限尺寸效应，在纠缠已被破坏的情况下HOP仍可能大于0.5，甚至可能超过2/3的通过阈值，表明NISQ计算机在某些小规模情形下可能通过量子体积基准测试但缺乏全局纠缠。
AI.motivation: 量子体积协议被广泛用作NISQ量子计算机的基准测试，但其测量到的重输出概率（HOP）是否真正反映量子计算机的相干性和纠缠能力尚未被充分验证。本文旨在通过数值研究揭示在退极化噪声影响下，HOP与量子纠缠（以二分负度衡量）之间的关系，并检验量子体积基准测试的可靠性。
AI.method: 作者对量子体积电路进行了数值模拟，研究了三种量之间的权衡关系：退极化噪声参数、以二分负度（bipartite negativity）量化的纠缠程度、以及重输出概率（HOP）。通过有限尺寸系统的数值研究，分析了不同噪声水平下HOP与纠缠状态的变化关系。
AI.result: 研究发现，在退极化噪声下，由于有限系统尺寸效应，HOP可能大于0.5（对应完全失去相干性的阈值），而二分负度纠缠已经被破坏。进一步表明，对于小规模n，NISQ计算机在缺乏全局纠缠的情况下仍有可能通过量子体积基准测试的2/3阈值，尽管概率较低。
AI.conclusion: 量子体积基准测试存在局限性：HOP作为指标可能无法可靠地反映底层量子计算的纠缠特性，尤其在有限尺寸系统中。这一发现对量子体积基准作为NISQ设备性能衡量标准的可信度提出了质疑，并强调了需要结合纠缠度量等额外指标来全面评估量子处理器的能力。

title: Linear response across interaction regimes in two-dimensional ferromagnets
summary: Recent discoveries of two-dimensional (2D) ferromagnets have stimulated intense interest in understanding and controlling their spin transport properties. A central microscopic feature of these systems is that exchange-driven magnon--magnon interactions are strongly momentum dependent: low-momentum magnons interact weakly, while high-momentum ones can scatter strongly and exhibit collective hydrodynamic behavior. Understanding transport in such systems therefore requires a microscopic description capable of capturing ballistic and hydrodynamic regimes on equal footing. The natural framework is the quantum Boltzmann equation (QBE), whose solution is notoriously difficult because of the multidimensional collision integrals. Here, we develop a method based on an efficient representation of distribution functions as sums of Gaussians, which renders the collision integrals tractable. This approach enables accurate solution of the linearized QBE and computation of momentum- and frequency-resolved linear response in 2D ferromagnets across a broad range of temperatures and magnetic fields. In particular, we resolve a temperature-driven crossover from a ballistic regime dominated by weakly interacting low-momentum magnons to a collective hydrodynamic regime governed by strongly interacting high-momentum modes. Applying this method to monolayer CrCl$_3$, we obtain good agreement with recent nitrogen-vacancy-center dephasing experiments that reported anomalous magnetic noise consistent with magnon sound. More broadly, our work establishes a general framework for computing momentum- and frequency-resolved linear response in interacting 2D quantum systems describable within quantum Boltzmann kinetics.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种基于高斯函数表示分布函数的方法，有效求解二维铁磁体中的线性化量子玻尔兹曼方程(QBE)，从而能够统一描述弹道区和流体动力学区的磁振子输运。将该方法应用于单层CrCl3，成功解释了氮-空位(NV)中心退相干实验中观测到的异常磁噪声（磁振子声）。
AI.motivation: 二维铁磁体的交换驱动磁振子-磁振子相互作用具有显著的动量依赖性：低动量磁振子相互作用弱（弹道区），高动量磁振子散射强并表现出集体流体动力学行为。传统上量子玻尔兹曼方程因其多维碰撞积分而难以求解，缺乏能够同时捕捉弹道和流体动力学两种输运机制的微观框架。
AI.method: 提出一种将分布函数表示为高斯函数之和的高效表示方法，使多维碰撞积分变得可处理。基于此方法精确求解线性化量子玻尔兹曼方程，计算二维铁磁体在广泛温度和磁场范围内动量分辨与频率分辨的线性响应。
AI.result: 揭示了由弱相互作用低动量磁振子主导的弹道区到由强相互作用高动量模主导的集体流体动力学区的温度驱动交叉行为。将该方法应用于单层CrCl3，与近期氮-空位中心退相干实验报道的与磁振子声一致的异常磁噪声结果吻合良好。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为在量子玻尔兹曼动力学框架内描述相互作用的二维量子系统，建立了一个通用框架来计算动量分辨与频率分辨的线性响应，具有广泛适用性。

title: Online Inference in Distributional Temporal-Difference Learning
summary: We study online statistical inference for functionals of the return distribution under a fixed policy. The return distribution is estimated by nonparametric distributional temporal-difference learning from a single Markov trajectory. For the Polyak--Ruppert averaged estimator, we prove that its root-$T$ error converges weakly to a centered Gaussian random element in Cramér space. We also prove that, conditionally on the observed trajectory, the root-$T$ difference between the bootstrap and original averages converges weakly to the same Gaussian limit. These results justify bootstrap inference for smooth statistical functionals, including variance, CVaR, expected shortfall, and expectiles. For nonsmooth statistical functionals, we develop a local asymptotic theory for the estimated return CDF over $T^{-1/2}$-neighborhoods of finitely many thresholds, together with its bootstrap analogue. This theory allows us to conduct inference for nonsmooth statistical functionals characterized by CDF equations, including return quantiles.

AI.tldr: 本文研究固定策略下回报分布函数的在线统计推断问题。通过非参数分布时序差分学习从单条马尔可夫轨迹中估计回报分布，证明了Polyak-Ruppert平均估计器的根号T误差在Cramér空间中弱收敛到中心化高斯随机元，并验证了自助法推断的可行性，涵盖平滑统计泛函（方差、CVaR、期望损失、期望分位数）与非平滑统计泛函（回报分位数等）。
AI.motivation: 强化学习中回报分布的统计推断长期缺乏严格的理论基础。已有工作大多仅关注回报的期望值估计，而对回报分布的估计及其上任意泛函的推断（如风险度量）缺乏可行性保证。本文旨在为回报分布泛函的在线统计推断建立完整的渐近理论基础。
AI.method: 采用非参数分布时序差分学习（distributional temporal-difference learning）从单条马尔可夫轨迹估计回报分布。对Polyak-Ruppert平均估计器，证明根号T误差在Cramér空间中弱收敛到高斯随机元；通过自助法论证条件收敛性质；对非平滑泛函，建立局部渐近理论用于处理CDF方程刻画的统计量（如分位数）。
AI.result: 证明了Polyak-Ruppert平均估计器的根号T弱收敛性，以及自助法估计在轨迹条件化下收敛到相同的高斯极限。建立了适用于平滑与非平滑统计泛函（方差、CVaR、期望短损失、期望分位数及回报分位数）的自助推断理论。
AI.conclusion: 本文为强化学习中回报分布的自助法统计推断提供了严格的理论保证，填补了分布强化学习在线推断理论上的空白，使得对风险敏感统计量的不确定性量化成为可能。

title: Observation of in-plane anomalous Nernst effect
summary: The Nernst effect, which enables the conversion of a heat current into a transverse voltage under magnetic field or spin magnetization, holds significant promise for energy harvesting and thermal management in future electronics. However, the conventional Nernst effect is fundamentally constrained by the orthogonality requirement that the applied field or spontaneous magnetization must be perpendicular to the plane defined by the temperature gradient and the induced voltage. Here we report that symmetry-tailored ultrathin films of a prototypical ferromagnetic oxide exhibit anomalous Nernst effect arising from intrinsic coupling to spontaneous in-plane spin magnetization. Systematic magnetothermoelectric measurements under spherical rotations of the magnetic field reveal that a pronounced Nernst signal, comparable in magnitude to the out-of-plane response, emerges robustly associated with out-of-plane orbital magnetization. Our findings demonstrate that the anomalous Nernst effect is no longer limited by the orthogonality condition, opening new opportunities for more flexible designs of magnetothermoelectric materials and devices.

AI.tldr: 本文报道在对称性裁剪的铁磁氧化物超薄膜中，反常能斯特效应可源于自发面内自旋磁化的本征耦合，突破了传统能斯特效应中磁场（或磁化）必须垂直于温度梯度与感应电压所成平面的正交性限制。系统的球面旋转磁热电测量表明，面外轨道磁化能够产生与面外响应相当幅度的显著能斯特信号，为磁热电材料与器件的柔性设计开辟了新途径。
AI.motivation: 传统能斯特效应受正交性条件约束，即外加磁场或自发磁化必须垂直于由温度梯度和感应电压所定义的平面，这从根本上限制了能斯特效应在能量收集和热管理中的应用灵活性与器件设计自由度。
AI.method: 采用对称性裁剪的典型铁磁氧化物超薄膜，进行系统的磁热电测量，通过在球面旋转（spherical rotations）外加磁场，全面表征能斯特信号对磁场方向的依赖关系，并分析面内自旋磁化与面外轨道磁化对反常能斯特效应的贡献。
AI.result: 实验发现，即使在磁场（或自发磁化）位于面内的条件下，体系仍表现出显著的反常能斯特信号，其幅度与面外响应相当。该信号被证明与面外轨道磁化的内禀耦合密切相关，说明反常能斯特效应可以在不满足传统正交性条件下稳健产生。
AI.conclusion: 本研究证明了反常能斯特效应不再受限于正交性条件，打破了传统能斯特效应的几何约束，为未来磁热电材料与器件的柔性化、多维化设计提供了新的物理基础与实验依据。

title: Coupling-Aware Vanka Smoothing for Multigrid Preconditioning of the Implicit Immersed Boundary Equations
summary: The immersed boundary (IB) method models fluid--structure interaction using the natural Lagrangian and Eulerian formulations of structural mechanics and fluid dynamics, respectively, but explicit time discretization of the IB force imposes a stiffness-dependent upper bound on the time-step size. Treating these forces implicitly removes this restriction, but the resulting coupled linear systems become increasingly difficult to solve as the structural stiffness increases. Algebraically eliminating the Lagrangian degrees of freedom yields a reduced Eulerian velocity--pressure IB system. Here we introduce a coupling-aware Vanka (CAV) smoothing strategy to enable effective multigrid preconditioning of this system. CAV patches are built as unions of standard pressure-centered Vanka patches, with the graph of the Eulerian elasticity matrix determining which patches are combined. Under grid refinement, CAV patch sizes remain bounded, and the computational cost of each multigrid cycle thereby grows linearly with the number of Eulerian degrees of freedom. Tests using target-point, membrane, and beam force laws show that CAV-preconditioned FGMRES reduces the relative residual by ten orders of magnitude in $9--15$ iterations, with little growth under grid refinement. In a nonlinear benchmark modeling flow past a flexible fiber, the average number of FGMRES iterations per Newton solve increases only from $8.6$ to $9.5$ as the Eulerian grid is refined from $32\times32$ to $256\times256$ cells. To our knowledge, CAV provides the first robust multigrid strategy for time-dependent implicit IB formulations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"耦合感知Vanka"(CAV)平滑策略，用于对隐式浸没边界(IB)方法中约化后的欧拉速度-压力系统进行有效的多重网格预处理。CAV补丁由标准压力中心Vanka补丁的并集构成，其组合方式由欧拉弹性矩阵的图决定。在网格细化下CAV补丁大小有界，每个多重网格循环的计算代价随欧拉自由度线性增长。实验表明CAV预处理的FGMRES在9-15次迭代内将相对残差降低10个数量级，且在网格细化下增长很小，是首个针对时间依赖隐式IB公式的稳健多重网格策略。
AI.motivation: 隐式处理浸没边界力可以消除显式时间离散化中由结构刚度决定的时间步长上限，但由此产生的耦合线性系统随结构刚度增加而越来越难求解。代数消去拉格朗日自由度后得到约化的欧拉速度-压力IB系统，然而该系统缺乏有效的求解策略，需要稳健的预处理方法。
AI.method: 提出耦合感知Vanka(CAV)平滑策略：CAV补丁以标准压力中心Vanka补丁的并集形式构建，利用欧拉弹性矩阵的图结构决定哪些补丁需要组合在一起。CAV补丁大小在网格细化下有界，从而保证每个多重网格循环的计算成本与欧拉自由度数量呈线性增长。
AI.result: 使用目标点、膜和梁三种力模型测试，CAV预处理的FGMRES在9-15次迭代内将相对残差降低10个数量级，且随网格细化增长很小。在柔性纤维绕流的非线性基准测试中，欧拉网格从32×32细化到256×256时，每次Newton迭代的FGMRES平均迭代次数仅从8.6增加到9.5。
AI.conclusion: CAV是第一个针对时间依赖隐式IB公式的稳健多重网格策略，在网格细化下保持近最优的收敛性能与线性计算复杂度，为高刚度浸没边界问题的隐式求解提供了有效的手段。

title: Open system probes of renormalization group flow
summary: Open system probes can provide an efficient means to characterize quantum many-body systems by employing them as engineered environments. The key idea is to map long-range spatial correlations of the environment onto dynamical correlations in the evolution of a simple quantum probe. Using the example of a qubit coupled to a transverse-field Ising model, we show how the non-Markovian rate or spectral flow can be used to identify stable and unstable fixed points, infer scaling dimensions of relevant fields, and deduce the renormalization group flow induced by deformations around any fixed point.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用开放系统探针（如一个量子比特）耦合到量子多体环境（如横场伊辛模型），通过探针的非马尔可夫速率或谱流来表征环境的量子多体性质，包括识别不动点、推断相关场的标度维度以及推导重整化群流。
AI.motivation: 传统上表征量子多体系统需要复杂的直接测量手段。本文旨在探索一种更高效的替代方案：通过将量子多体系统作为工程化环境，将环境的长程空间关联映射到单个简单量子探针的动力学关联上，从而利用探针演化实现高效表征。
AI.method: 以耦合到横场伊辛模型的单量子比特为探针，研究其开放系统演化。通过分析探针的非马尔可夫速率或谱流，建立其与量子临界系统中稳定/不稳定不动点、相关场标度维度以及重整化群流之间的对应关系。
AI.result: 证明了非马尔可夫速率或谱流可以成功用于识别系统的稳定与不稳定不动点，推断相关场的标度维度，并推导出围绕任意不动点变形所诱导的重整化群流。
AI.conclusion: 开放系统探针提供了一种高效表征量子多体系统的手段，通过将环境的空间关联映射为探针的时间演化关联，可以从单探针动力学中提取关键的量子临界信息，为量子多体系统表征开辟了新途径。

title: Lee-Yang paradigm of phase transition in eigenstate thermalized systems
summary: As phase transitions in isolated quantum systems remain elusive, here we show how a thermodynamic-like phase transition, falling into the Lee-Yang paradigm, can arise in systems displaying eigenstate thermalization. Specifically, we show that in holographic conformal field theories, the eigenstate expectation of the auto-correlation function can be mapped to the partition function ${\cal Z}_{gauge}(z)$ of a virtual interacting instanton gas, with the conformal mapping of the imaginary time: $z=1-e^{-τ}$ and the central charge $c$ mimicking the instanton fugacity and volume, respectively. We find that akin to the Lee-Yang paradigm, for $c\to\infty$ a pair of complex conjugate zeros of ${\cal Z}_{gauge}(z)$ move to the real axis located at the famous forbidden singularity. Passing through the singularity the system transits from the low- to high-fugacity phase, accompanied by dramatic changes in scaling behaviors of the free energy and dominant microscopic configurations. Our findings indicate that physics of phase transitions from eigenstate thermalization is very rich.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了在全息共形场论中，即使系统展现出特征态热化，仍可出现符合Lee-Yang范式的热力学型相变。特征态的关联函数期望值可映射为虚拟瞬时子气体的配分函数，在中心荷c→∞时，一对共轭复零点移动至实轴上的禁止奇点处，系统由此经历低到高逸度的相变。
AI.motivation: 孤立量子系统中的相变长期以来难以实现和观测，本文旨在证明即使在展现特征态热化的系统中，也能出现符合Lee-Yang范式的类热力学相变，从而说明特征态热化与相变物理之间并不矛盾，且可能蕴含丰富的物理现象。
AI.method: 通过全息对应，将全息共形场论中特征态期望的自关联函数映射为虚拟相互作用瞬时子气体的配分函数Z_gauge(z)，其中虚时经共形变换z=1-e^{-τ}，中心荷c分别扮演瞬时子逸度和体积的角色。利用Lee-Yang相变理论分析配分函数的零点分布，研究极端大中心荷极限下的相变行为。
AI.result: 在c→∞极限下，配分函数的一对复共轭零点移动至实轴上的著名禁止奇点处。系统穿越该奇点时发生从低逸度相到高逸度相的转变，伴随自由能标度行为和主导微观构型的剧烈变化，与Lee-Yang范式高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: 特征态热化系统的相变物理非常丰富，全息CFT中的这个例子表明，即使系统展现特征态热化，仍可容纳Lee-Yang类型的类热力学相变，为孤立量子系统中的相变研究提供了新的视角和范式。

title: L-FNO: Lorentzian Fourier Neural Operator for Stochastic Event Dynamics
comment: 21 pages, 5 figures (9 pages for the main text)
summary: Modern operational systems face uncertainty even in routine conditions, where rare, bursty, and self-exciting events emerge from both exogenous covariates and endogenous event dynamics. Standard neural operators are typically trained as regression-style function-to-function models rather than conditional-intensity estimators, limiting their suitability for sparse event regimes. We introduce the Lorentzian Fourier Neural Operator (L-FNO), a stochastic neural operator that combines an FNO-style covariate path, Lorentzian spectral kernels for history-dependent excitation, and a likelihood-based training objective. We evaluate L-FNO on eight synthetic point-process benchmarks and three real-world datasets covering disease outbreak prediction and semiconductor fault or defect detection. L-FNO improves event likelihood, calibration diagnostics, and rare-event detection over regression- and likelihood-based neural operator baselines. These results show that structured spectral memory and likelihood-based learning provide effective inductive biases for neural operator models of stochastic event dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Lorentzian傅里叶神经算子（L-FNO），一种将FNO风格的协变量路径、Lorentzian谱核（用于历史依赖激发）与基于似然的训练目标相结合的随机神经算子，用于对含稀少、突发、自激事件的条件强度进行建模，并在合成与真实数据集上优于回归和基于似然的神经算子基线。
AI.motivation: 现代运行系统在常规条件下也面临不确定性，稀有突发且自激的事件由外生协变量和内生事件动态共同产生。标准神经算子通常被训练为回归式函数映射模型而非条件强度估计器，限制了其在稀疏事件场景中的适用性。
AI.method: L-FNO是一种随机神经算子，包含三个关键组件：(1) FNO风格的协变量路径，用于编码外生协变量信息；(2) Lorentzian谱核，用于建模历史依赖的激发效应（即自激事件动态）；(3) 基于似然的训练目标，用于估计条件强度函数。
AI.result: L-FNO在八个合成点过程基准和三个真实数据集（涵盖疾病暴发预测和半导体故障/缺陷检测）上进行了评估。结果表明L-FNO在事件似然、校准诊断和罕见事件检测方面均优于回归式和基于似然的神经算子基线。
AI.conclusion: 结构化谱记忆和基于似然的学习为神经算子模型建模随机事件动态提供了有效的归纳偏置，表明L-FNO在运行系统的高不确定性和稀疏事件场景下具有实际应用价值。

title: Quantum Geometric Kondo Cloud
summary: A magnetic impurity embedded in a metal is collectively screened by Fermi-surface quasiparticles into a many-body spin-singlet ground state, forming a Kondo cloud of size $ξ_{\rm K}\sim\hbar v_F/(k_B T_{\rm K})$. This kinematic picture collapses in flat bands, where $v_F=0$ and the hierarchy of dispersive energy shells is absent. Here we show that the missing organizing principle is quantum geometry. A magnetic impurity coupled to an isolated flat band selects a single active bath mode: a coherent superposition of flat-band Bloch states weighted by the hybridization factor $v(\mathbf{k})$, while all orthogonal flat-band modes remain dark. The resulting flat-band Kondo problem is a quantum geometric molecule, with an algebraic Kondo scale set by the total projected hybridization strength rather than a logarithmic-renormalization scale. In real space, the impurity-bath spin correlation defines a quantum geometric Kondo cloud. Its cloud-size tensor admits a gauge-invariant decomposition into a hybridization-weighted quantum metric, a dressed Berry-connection covariance, and a positive hybridization-gradient term, yielding the lower bound $ξ_{\rm K}^2\geq \sum_{\mathbf{k}}ρ(\mathbf{k}){\rm Tr}\,g(\mathbf{k})$, where $ρ(\mathbf{k})=|v(\mathbf{k})|^2/\sum_{\mathbf{k}}|v(\mathbf{k})|^2$. Our result reveals that, in flat bands, Kondo screening is governed by the quantum geometry and interference structure of the impurity-selected Bloch wave packet, rather than Fermi-surface kinematics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究平带中磁性杂质与量子几何的关联，发现平带Kondo问题中缺失的组织原则是量子几何而非费米面动力学。杂质选择的单个活动bath模式是由杂化因子v(k)加权的平带Bloch态相干叠加，形成的flat-band Kondo问题是"量子几何分子"，Kondo尺度由总投影杂化强度决定而非对数重整化尺度。Kondo云的尺寸张量可规范不变地分解为杂化加权的量子度量、dressed Berry联络协方差和正定的杂化梯度项，满足下界ξ²_K≥Σρ(k)Tr g(k)。
AI.motivation: 在传统金属中，Kondo屏蔽由费米面准粒子集体形成自旋单重态基态，Kondo云大小由ξ_K~ħv_F/(k_BT_K)决定。然而在平带中v_F=0，色散能壳的层级结构消失，传统运动学图像失效，缺少一个组织原则来理解平带中的Kondo物理。
AI.method: 作者提出量子几何作为平带Kondo问题的组织原则。具体方法包括：(1) 证明耦合到孤立平带的磁性杂质只选择一个活动bath模式——由杂化因子v(k)加权的平带Bloch态相干叠加，其余正交模保持暗态；(2) 将平带Kondo问题映射为一个量子几何分子模型，Kondo尺度由总投影杂化强度决定；(3) 在实空间中定义量子几何Kondo云，其尺寸张量可分解为三个规范不变部分：杂化加权的量子度量、dressed Berry联络协方差和正定的杂化梯度项；(4) 由此推导出Kondo云尺寸的下界不等式。
AI.result: 发现平带Kondo屏蔽由量子几何和杂质选择的Bloch波包的干涉结构主导，而非费米面运动学。Kondo尺度呈代数形式（非对数重整化），由总投影杂化强度设定。Kondo云尺寸张量具有规范不变的分解，并满足下界ξ²_K≥Σ_kρ(k)Tr g(k)，其中g(k)为量子度量。
AI.conclusion: 在平带中，Kondo屏蔽的物理本质从费米面运动学转变量子几何：杂质对波包的干涉选择结构决定了Kondo耦合的强度与空间分布，量子度量给出了Kondo云尺寸的基本下界。这为理解平带系统中的强关联多体物理提供了新的几何视角。

title: Quantifying internal variability in large-ensemble climate data with the Wasserstein distance
summary: Quantifying forced and internal variability in climate data is fundamental to detecting the climate change signal and assessing uncertainty in climate projections. We propose a metric that quantifies the relative magnitude of internal variability in single-model initial-condition large ensembles (SMILEs). We measure forced and internal variability by two 1-Wasserstein distances, a form of optimal transport cost. The proposed metric is the distance for internal variability divided by the sum of the two. Computing this ratio requires only sorting the samples and differencing the resulting quantiles, with no additional parameters. The metric reflects the entire distribution shape and applies to non-Gaussian variables, because the 1-Wasserstein distance quantifies the difference between any two probability distributions. We validate the metric with synthetic climate data from Gaussian, uniform, and lognormal distributions. Unlike the two existing metrics, the proposed metric gives stable estimates irrespective of the distribution shape and the presence of outliers, provided that the ensemble has about 40 members or more. We then apply the proposed and existing metrics to the 2 m air temperature and total precipitation of the Community Earth System Model Large Ensemble (CESM-LE) under two different forcing scenarios. All the metrics indicate that the relative contribution of internal variability decreases as the forcing increases, but the proposed metric shows this response most clearly. The 1-Wasserstein distance thus provides a simple and useful tool for analyzing large-ensemble datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于1-Wasserstein距离（最优传输成本的一种形式）的新指标，用于量化单模型大集合（SMILEs）中内部变率相对于强迫变率的相对大小，该指标仅需排序和分位数差分即可计算，适用于非高斯分布，且在有约40个以上成员时对分布形状和异常值具有稳健性。
AI.motivation: 在气候数据中量化强迫变率与内部变率对于检测气候变化信号和评估气候预估的不确定性至关重要，但现有指标可能对分布形状或异常值敏感，缺乏稳健且通用的度量方法。
AI.method: 提出用两个1-Wasserstein距离分别度量强迫变率和内部变率，所提指标定义为内部变率距离除以两者之和；该计算仅需对样本排序并对分位数求差，无需额外参数；通过高斯、均匀和对数正态合成数据验证，并与两种现有指标对比，然后应用于CESM-LE的2米气温和总降水数据。
AI.result: 合成数据验证表明，在集合成员数约40个或以上时，所提指标对分布形状和异常值给出稳定估计，优于现有两个指标；在CESM-LE应用中，所有指标都显示强迫增强时内部变率的相对贡献下降，但所提指标对这一响应的反映最为清晰。
AI.conclusion: 1-Wasserstein距离为分析大集合数据集提供了简单而有效的工具，所提指标能够稳健地量化内部变率的相对大小，适用于非高斯变量，具有广泛的应用前景。

title: Efficient Hamiltonian Truncation: Fast Matrix Construction and Quantum Krylov Diagonalization
summary: Hamiltonian truncation offers a nonperturbative route to quantum field theory, yet its accuracy is limited by the rapid expansion of the truncated Hilbert space, which drives up computational cost. We tackle this bottleneck with a hybrid strategy that pairs classical and quantum algorithms: 1) we develop an efficient basis-generation scheme built on integer partitions; 2) we speed up the construction of the sparse Hamiltonian matrix using symmetry-aware algorithms; and 3) we explore quantum Krylov diagonalization as a route to the low-lying spectrum. Benchmarking against the free massive scalar and $φ^4$ theories in two spacetime dimensions, we achieve substantial gains in the computational efficiency of Hamiltonian truncation and chart a path toward future quantum implementations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合经典与量子算法的混合策略来解决哈密顿截断方法中截断希尔伯特空间快速膨胀导致的计算成本瓶颈问题。该策略包含三部分：基于整数划分的高效基组生成方案、利用对称性加速稀疏哈密顿矩阵构建的算法，以及探索量子Krylov对角化求解低能谱。在二维时空下的自由有质量标量场和φ^4理论的基准测试中，显著提升了哈密顿截断的计算效率，并为未来的量子实现开辟了路径。
AI.motivation: 哈密顿截断是量子场论的非微扰求解方法，但其精度受限于截断希尔伯特空间的快速膨胀，导致计算成本急剧上升。作者旨在克服这一瓶颈，通过结合经典与量子算法来提升计算效率，并为未来量子计算实现铺路。
AI.method: 作者提出三管齐下的混合策略：(1) 基于整数划分构建高效的基组生成方案；(2) 利用对称性感知算法加速稀疏哈密顿矩阵的构建；(3) 探索量子Krylov对角化方法求解低能谱。基准测试针对二维时空下的自由有质量标量场和φ^4理论。
AI.result: 在自由有质量标量场和φ^4理论（二维时空）的基准测试中，该方法在哈密顿截断的计算效率上取得了实质性提升。
AI.conclusion: 该混合经典-量子策略显著提高了哈密顿截断方法的计算效率，并为未来在量子硬件上实现相关量子场论计算描绘了可行路径。

title: Phase transition from eigenstate thermalization: forbidden singularity and instanton proliferation via AGT correspondence
summary: In theoretical physics, finding connections between problems that appear in distinct contexts is an important way to leapfrog progresses, often by illuminating deep aspects that may otherwise seem obscure. In this paper, we consider in 2d CFTs the phenomenon of forbidden singularities in auto-correlation functions -- a key signature of eigenstate thermalization. We show that they correspond to phase transitions in the context of eigenstates. The connection is made explicit by utilizing the AGT correspondence, which relates eigenstate auto-correlations to the Nekrasov partition functions describing an instanton gas of the $\mathcal{N}=2$ SUSY gauge theories. We show that by taking the counter-part of the heavy-light limit, two phases emerge for the instanton gas. They are dominated by configurations represented by string-like Young tableaux with distinct structures and thermodynamic properties, which bare resemblance to the confined and the deconfined phases. A phase transition occurs as instantons proliferate from one side, in a manner that mimics the Lee-Yang theory. We work out the critical fugacity and find it corresponding exactly to the forbidden singularity.

AI.tldr: 本文利用AGT对应将2D CFT中本征态自关联函数的禁区奇点与N=2 SUSY规范理论瞬子气体的相变联系起来，证明禁区奇点恰好对应Lee-Yang型相变的临界逸度。
AI.motivation: 在2D CFT中发现本征态热化（ETH）的关键特征——自关联函数中的禁区奇点，并希望通过与不同物理语境（瞬子气体/规范理论）建立联系来揭示其深层结构。
AI.method: 利用AGT对应将本征态自关联函数映射为N=2超对称规范理论的Nekrasov配分函数（描述瞬子气体）；在重-轻极限的对应情形下分析瞬子气体的两相结构，并用Lee-Yang理论处理相变，推导临界逸度并对应禁区奇点。
AI.result: 发现瞬子气体存在两相，分别由具有不同结构和热力学性质的弦状Young图构型主导，类似禁闭相与退禁闭相。当瞬子从一侧增殖时发生相变，其临界逸度精确等于禁区奇点。
AI.conclusion: 禁区奇点在Eigenstate热化的语境下对应于一个真实的相变现象，这一发现建立了ETH现象与规范理论瞬子气体相变之间的深刻联系。

title: Robust XGBoosting for Regression
summary: XGBoost is a very popular and powerful method for prediction. It iteratively fits simple decision trees to the residuals of the previous step. An efficient and scalable implementation is available. The standard loss function for XGBoost is the quadratic loss, but a Huber loss can also be used. In this paper, we study the robustness of XGBoost and show that its performance can be affected by vertical outliers and leverage points. To address this, we explore alternative loss functions, based on M-, S-, and τ -estimators from robust regression. Our results indicate that a two-step procedure, referred to as MM-XGBoost, provides the best trade-off between robustness and prediction accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了XGBoost的鲁棒性问题，发现其性能会受到垂直离群点和杠杆点的影响。为解决这一问题，作者探索了基于稳健回归中M估计、S估计和τ估计的替代损失函数，并提出了一种称为MM-XGBoost的两步估计方法，在鲁棒性和预测精度之间取得了最佳平衡。
AI.motivation: XGBoost作为一种广泛使用的预测方法，其标准损失函数（二次损失）和Huber损失在面对垂直离群点和杠杆点时性能会受到影响。现有研究缺乏对XGBoost在存在异常数据情况下鲁棒性的系统分析，因此需要探索更稳健的损失函数来增强其对异常值的抵抗力。
AI.method: 作者系统研究了XGBoost对垂直离群点和杠杆点的敏感性，并从稳健回归领域中引入了基于M估计、S估计和τ估计的替代损失函数。其中特别提出了一种两步骤方法MM-XGBoost，该方法结合了稳健初始化（高崩溃点估计）和后续的高效估计步骤，以兼顾鲁棒性和预测准确性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，在各类替代损失函数中，MM-XGBoost方法在鲁棒性与预测精度之间提供了最佳的权衡，能够有效抵御垂直离群点和杠杆点对XGBoost性能的负面影响。
AI.conclusion: MM-XGBoost是一种有效的稳健提升方法，为在实际数据中可能包含异常值的场景下使用XGBoost提供了更可靠的替代方案。

title: Topological phases and quantum criticality from $SU(2)$ Chern-Simons-matter theories
summary: Motivated by recent numerical studies where various $SU(2)$ Chern-Simons-matter theories emerge, we analytically study topological phases and quantum criticality in two-dimensional systems described by such theories. First, we classify $SU(2)_k$ topological orders in all lattice spin systems with a $p4\times SO(3)$ symmetry, where $k$ is an arbitrary nonzero integer. We find that for each odd $k$, the topological order can emerge in systems with an arbitrary Lieb-Schultz-Mattis (LSM) anomaly, and the symmetry cannot permute anyons. If the system has a nontrivial (respectively, trivial) LSM anomaly, then there is exactly one (respectively, nine) symmetry-enriched topological (SET) phases. On the other hand, $SU(2)_k$ topological order with any even $k$ can only emerge in systems with a trivial LSM anomaly. If $k\notin\{6, 10, 14, \cdots\}$, the symmetry cannot permute anyons, and there are 16 SET phases. If $k\in\{6, 10, 14, \cdots\}$, there are 4 different ways how the symmetry can permute anyons, and there are 64 SET phases. Next, we analyze the $SU(2)_k$ Chern-Simons theories coupled to $N_f$ flavors of gapless matter fields that can be either bosonic or fermionic. For both types of theories, we consider a joint large-$N_f$ and large-$k$ limit with $N_f/k$ fixed, and compute the scaling dimensions of the bilinear operators of the bosons or fermions to the order of $1/N_f$. These results sharpen our understanding of these emergent exotic topological phases and quantum criticality, and provide useful guidance to explore them further.

AI.tldr: 本文从解析角度研究了二维系统中SU(2) Chern-Simons-matter理论的拓扑相和量子临界性。具体包括：对具有p4×SO(3)对称性的晶格自旋系统进行SU(2)_k拓扑序分类（k为任意非零整数），依据k的奇偶性和Lieb-Schultz-Mattis (LSM)反常来枚举SET相的数量；同时分析了SU(2)_k Chern-Simons理论与N_f种无质量玻色子或费米子物质场耦合的理论，在联合大N_f和大k极限下计算了双线性算子的标度维度。
AI.motivation: 近期的数值研究显示各种SU(2) Chern-Simons-matter理论会在二维系统中涌现，但缺乏系统性的解析理解，作者旨在从解析角度对这些涌现的拓扑相和量子临界点进行完整分类和定量刻画。
AI.method: 第一部分利用对称性分类方法，结合LSM反常和p4×SO(3)对称性约束，对SU(2)_k拓扑序的所有可能SET相进行分类统计。第二部分采取联合大N_f和大k极限（N_f/k固定），对SU(2)_k Chern-Simons理论与玻色子或费米子物质场耦合的理论计算到1/N_f阶的双线性算子的标度维度。
AI.result: 分类结果：奇数k时拓扑序可在任意LSM反常系统中涌现且对称性不能置换任意子（非平凡/平凡LSM分别对应1/9个SET相）；偶数k时只能在平凡LSM涌现，其中k∉{6,10,14,...}时有16个SET相，k∈{6,10,14,...}时有4种任意子置换方式和64个SET相。此外，计算了两种类型物质场模型中双线性算子至1/N_f阶的标度维度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作从解析层面系统地刻画了SU(2) Chern-Simons-matter理论在二维系统中的涌现现象，为理解这些奇异的拓扑相和量子临界性提供了更精确的理论基础，并为后续研究提供了实用指导。
