title: GPU implementation of mixed quantum-classical Liouville molecular dynamics without momentum jump
summary: We implemented on GPU a mixed quantum-classical Liouville molecular dynamics simulation based on a momentum-jump-free theory. The trajectory spawning that was previously implemented on CPU for sampling enhancement was eliminated to avoid the overhead of thread divergence and dynamic memory allocation on the GPU. This achieved a speedup of an order of magnitude compared to the CPU computation with spawning, as well as a linear scaling with respect to the number of sampling trajectories.

AI.tldr: 本文在GPU上实现了基于无动量跳跃理论的混合量子-经典Liouville分子动力学模拟。通过去除CPU版本中用于采样增强的轨迹衍生(spawning)机制，避免了GPU上的线程分支和动态内存分配开销，实现了相比CPU计算快一个数量级的加速，并获得了关于采样轨迹数量的线性扩展性。
AI.motivation: 传统基于CPU的混合量子-经典Liouville分子动力学模拟中，轨迹衍生(spawning)采样增强方法虽然有效，但在GPU并行环境中会引入线程分叉(thread divergence)和动态内存分配的开销，严重限制GPU的计算性能。作者旨在通过去除该机制来充分利用GPU的并行计算能力，实现模拟的大幅加速。
AI.method: 作者在GPU上实现了基于无动量跳跃(momentum-jump-free)理论的混合量子-经典Liouville分子动力学模拟。核心策略是去除CPU实现中原有的轨迹衍生(spawning)采样增强步骤，因为该步骤会在GPU上导致线程分叉和动态内存分配问题。通过这一简化，使模拟能够高效地映射到GPU的SIMD并行架构上，实现线性扩展的轨迹采样。
AI.result: 相较于此前的CPU计算（含轨迹衍生），GPU实现取得了约一个数量级（order of magnitude）的加速。同时，随着采样轨迹数量的增加，计算时间呈线性扩展，展现出良好的并行扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 在GPU上运行混合量子-经典Liouville分子动力学模拟时，去除轨迹衍生机制虽然牺牲了采样增强功能，但显著避免了GPU并行架构中的线程分叉和动态内存分配瓶颈，从而实现了数量级的加速和良好的线性扩展性。这表明针对GPU架构重新设计算法策略（而非简单移植CPU代码）对于充分发挥GPU算力至关重要。

title: Scalable Test of Genuine Multipartite Entanglement via Partially Randomized Measurements
summary: Certifying genuine multipartite entanglement in quantum systems can require a number of measurements that grows exponentially with the system size. Here we introduce a criterion based on correlation-tensor subsector lengths restricted to local measurement planes and show that it can be evaluated using partially randomized measurements without an explicit exponential dependence on the number of qubits. We derive the corresponding bounds for $k$-separable states and illustrate the criterion using representative families of multipartite entangled states. Finally, we demonstrate the practical applicability of the method on an ion-trap quantum computer by certifying genuine five-partite entanglement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于关联张量子扇区长度的判据来认证真正的多体纠缠，该判据可通过部分随机化测量进行评估，避免了随量子比特数呈指数增长的测量需求，并在离子阱量子计算机上成功认证了真正的五体纠缠。
AI.motivation: 在量子系统中认证真正的多体纠缠通常需要随系统规模指数增长的测量数量，这对实际量子系统的纠缠验证构成了重大挑战。作者旨在开发一种新的判据，能够在不引入显式指数依赖的情况下高效认证多体纠缠。
AI.method: 提出一种基于限制在局域测量平面上的关联张量子扇区长度的新判据。该判据利用部分随机化测量进行评估，避免了显式的指数依赖。推导了k-可分离态的相应上界，并使用代表性多体纠缠态族进行说明。
AI.result: 该判据可高效评估，并在离子阱量子计算平台上成功演示了真正的五体纠缠认证，证明了该方法的实际可行性。
AI.conclusion: 基于关联张量子扇区长度的判据为多体纠缠认证提供了一种高效且实用的方案，大幅降低了测量复杂度，并在真实量子硬件上得到了验证。

title: Nonorthogonal-state erasure as the resource behind apparent second-law violations
summary: Perfect deterministic distinguishing of nonorthogonal quantum states is forbidden by the linear and unitary structure of quantum mechanics. It has often been assumed that, if such distinguishing were available, it would be the resource enabling work extraction from a single heat bath. We show that this expectation identifies the wrong thermodynamic operation and prove such hypothetical operation increases, rather than decreases, the joint entropy of system and detector. The entropy-decreasing resource is instead the inverse operation, which we call nonorthogonal-state erasure. Reanalyzing a Peres-type Szilard engine, we show that the apparent extracted work $W_{\mathrm{ext}}=0.2766k_{\mathrm{B}}T$ for an equal mixture of an atomic ensemble with spin state $\left|\uparrow\right\rangle $ and $\left|\rightarrow\right\rangle $. Thus the apparent second-law violation is supplied not by nonorthogonal-state distinguishing, but by a nonorthogonal quantum state erasure.

AI.tldr: 本文证明完美确定性区分非正交量子态并非导致单热库提取功的热力学操作，真正导致熵减的资源是逆操作——非正交态擦除。作者重新分析Peres型Szilard引擎，指出表观提取功0.2766k_BT并非来自态区分，而是来自非正交态擦除。
AI.motivation: 长期以来人们假设如果能够完美区分非正交量子态，这将是从单一热库提取功所需的资源。作者意图纠正这一错误认识，指出正确的熵减操作是逆操作（态擦除），而非态区分本身。
AI.method: 作者从量子力学的线性与幺正结构出发，证明非正交态区分操作实际上会增加系统与探测器的联合熵，而非降低熵。随后定义逆操作——非正交态擦除——作为真正的熵减资源，并重新分析Peres型Szilard引擎进行验证。
AI.result: 对于由自旋态|↑⟩和|→⟩等比例混合的原子系综，表观提取功为W_ext=0.2766k_BT。该表观第二定律违背并非由非正交态区分提供，而是由非正交量子态擦除所提供。
AI.conclusion: 非正交态区分不是热力学上有用的操作，它反而增加联合熵；真正能实现单热库功提取的是非正交态擦除这一逆操作。Peres型Szilard引擎的表观功提取应由态擦除来解释。

title: Data-driven techniques for translational neuroscience and personalized neuro-health
summary: Neurodegenexrative diseases such as Alzheimer's disease and Parkinson's disease are diagnosed most reliably only after substantial, often irreversible, neuronal loss has already occurred, creating an urgent need for quantitative tools that can detect subtle, early, and individual-specific brain changes from neuroimaging data. This review surveys a broad and rapidly evolving toolkit of data-driven techniques for translational neuroscience and personalized neuro-health, organized around four complementary methodological pillars. Throughout, we emphasize how these methodologically diverse approaches converge on a common translational goal: personalized, mechanistically grounded, and clinically actionable models of individual brain health, and we close by discussing the principal open statistical, computational, and clinical challenges that remain.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了用于转化神经科学与个性化神经健康的数据驱动技术工具包，围绕四大互补方法论支柱展开，强调这些方法如何汇聚于个性化、机制可解释且临床可操作的个体脑健康模型的共同转化目标，并讨论了主要的开放统计、计算和临床挑战。
AI.motivation: 神经退行性疾病（如阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病）只有在大量且往往不可逆的神经元损失发生后才能被最可靠地诊断，因此迫切需要能够从神经影像数据中检测细微、早期且个体特异性脑部变化的定量工具。
AI.method: 本文是一篇综述性论文，系统调查了广泛且快速演进的数据驱动技术工具包，围绕四个互补的方法论支柱进行组织，涵盖了从神经影像数据中提取个体化信息的多种技术方法。
AI.result: 综述表明，尽管方法论上具有多样性，这些方法共同汇聚于一个统一的转化目标：构建个性化、机制上有据可依且临床可操作的个体脑健康模型。
AI.conclusion: 文章指出该领域仍面临统计、计算和临床三方面的主要开放性挑战，为未来研究指明了方向。

title: Tuning crystal-fields by He-irradiation and orbital Widom line in SrVO$_3$ films
summary: Helium-ion irradiation of epitaxial SrVO$_3$/SrTiO$_3$ films causes a metal-insulator transition, so far attributed to a Mott localization driven by a reduced kinetic energy. Using density-functional theory plus dynamical mean-field theory, we show that the driving mechanism is instead the crystal-field splitting generated by the irradiation-induced tetragonal expansion, not the interaction-to-bandwidth ratio. The resulting $c$-axis vs. temperature phase diagram mirrors that of the one-band Hubbard model, but its critical end-point spawns an orbital Widom line, rooted in an anomalous compressibility of orbital, rather than charge occupation. At an effectively quarter filling, superexchange-like processes favor orbital over magnetic long-range order. Our results semi-quantitatively reproduce the fluence-dependent spectral gaps and transition thresholds reported experimentally, establishing ion implantation as a route to chemically expand correlated materials.

AI.tldr: 通过DFT+DMFT计算，本文揭示了氦离子辐照SrVO3/SrTiO3薄膜的金属-绝缘体转变机制并非此前认为的Mott局域化（由动能减小驱动），而是辐照诱导的四方膨胀所产生的晶体场劈裂所致。相图镜像一维Hubbard模型，其临界端点衍生出轨道Widom线，源于轨道占据（而非电荷占据）的异常压缩率。在半填充有效态下，超交换过程偏好轨道长程有序而非磁有序。计算结果半定量复现了实验报道的能隙和转变阈值，确立了离子注入作为化学膨胀相关材料的途径。
AI.motivation: 此前实验发现氦离子辐照SrVO3/SrTiO3薄膜会引发金属-绝缘体转变，但被错误地归因于动能降低导致的Mott局域化。作者希望通过第一性原理计算厘清真正的物理驱动机制，并解释实验中观测到的谱学特征，从而为相关氧化物材料的性质调控提供理论指导。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论结合动力学平均场理论（DFT+DMFT）对辐照后的SrVO3/SrTiO3薄膜进行电子结构计算，系统地分析辐照引起的晶格四方膨胀对晶体场劈裂、相互作用强度与带宽比值以及轨道占据的影响，构建c轴方向与温度的关系相图，并与单带Hubbard模型进行对比。
AI.result: 研究表明，辐照诱导的四方膨胀导致的晶体场劈裂才是金属-绝缘体转变的主导机制，而非相互作用强度与带宽之比（U/W）。相图与单带Hubbard模型类似，但在临界端点处出现了轨道Widom线，其物理根源是轨道占据而非电荷占据的异常压缩率。在有效四分之一填充下，超交换类过程更为偏好轨道长程有序而非磁长程有序。计算结果半定量地复现了实验观测到的随辐照通量变化的谱学能隙与转变阈值。
AI.conclusion: 离子注入/辐照可作为化学膨胀相关材料（如SrVO3）的有效调控手段，其金属-绝缘体转变的本质是晶格应变驱动的晶体场效应，而非传统的Mott物理。该工作为理解辐照诱导的相变提供了新的理论框架，并指出了轨道自由度在相关电子体系相变中的核心作用。

title: Designing robust molecular spins for quantum technologies with theoretical chemistry
summary: Molecular spins represent a versatile platform for quantum information science, with the potential to offer chemically tunable, addressable qubits. However, achieving this requires understanding and mitigating quantum decoherence. This Chapter provides a theoretical overview of current state-of-the-art chemical theory connecting ab initio electronic structure with open quantum system dynamics to guide the rational design of long-lived molecular qubits. Beginning at the electronic level, multi-reference and relativistic electronic structure methods to parameterize effective spin Hamiltonians are discussed, with a primary focus on accurately capturing $g$-tensors, zero-field splitting, and hyperfine interactions. These parameters feed into models of spin-phonon and spin-spin coupling to quantify $T_1$ and $T_2$ relaxation across various environmental regimes. This Chapter evaluates a hierarchy of dynamical methods, ranging from factorization to matrix product state approaches, balancing computational cost against accuracy and generalizability. Ultimately, mapping these theoretical models to molecular architecture can establish design principles, such as isotopic substitution and spatial spin delocalization, to understand and extend coherence lifetimes.

AI.tldr: 本文概述了分子自旋量子比特的最新化学理论进展，涵盖从从头算电子结构到开放量子系统动力学的完整理论链条，旨在通过理解量子退相干机制来指导长寿命分子量子比特的理性设计。
AI.motivation: 分子自旋是量子信息科学中极具潜力的平台，具有化学可调性和可寻址性等优势，但实现这一潜力需要深入理解并抑制量子退相干，此前缺乏从电子结构到量子动力学的系统性理论框架。
AI.method: 论文采用多层次的综合理论方法：从多参考和相对论电子结构方法出发参数化有效自旋哈密顿量（包括g张量、零场劈裂和超精细相互作用），然后通过自旋-声子和自旋-自旋耦合模型量化T1和T2弛豫，并评估从因子化到矩阵乘积态方法的动态方法层级，最后将理论模型映射到分子架构以建立设计原则。
AI.result: 该综述建立了从电子结构到相干动力学的完整理论框架，评估了不同动力学方法（从因子化到矩阵乘积态）在计算成本、精度和通用性之间的权衡，并提出了如同位素取代和空间自旋离域化等具体的设计原则来延长相干寿命。
AI.conclusion: 通过将理论模型与分子架构相关联，可以建立理性设计原则（如同位素取代和空间自旋离域）来理解和延长相干寿命，为长寿命分子量子比特的设计提供了系统化的理论指导。

title: Entanglement spectrum ordering and flavor polarization in the two-flavor Schwinger model at vacuum angle $θ= π$
comment: 21 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to $\textit{Chinese Physics C}$
summary: Entanglement spectra in gauge theories can encode both symmetry breaking and the organization of gauge sectors. In the two-flavor Schwinger model at vacuum angle $θ=π$, we find that the joint Schmidt distribution $p_{Q_A,F_A}$, labeled by the subsystem gauge charge $Q_A$ and flavor imbalance $F_A$, reveals a cut-dependent gauge-sector hierarchy and a mass-induced flavor asymmetry: changing the staggered cut reorganizes the gauge-charge distribution $p_{Q_A}$, while mass imbalance breaks the $F_A\leftrightarrow-F_A$ symmetry of the conditional flavor distribution $p_{F_A|Q_A}$. Defining the combined weight $W_F^{(q)}=p_{q,+1}+p_{q,-1}$ and conditional polarization $\mathcal P_F^{(q)}=(p_{q,+1}-p_{q,-1})/W_F^{(q)}$, we find that changing the cut reverses the weight hierarchy, $W_F^{(-1)}>W_F^{(+1)}$ at unit-cell boundaries but $W_F^{(+1)}>W_F^{(-1)}$ at intra-cell cuts, while mass imbalance drives $\mathcal P_F^{(q)}$ away from zero with a $q$-dependent cut response. Symmetry resolution therefore separates gauge-sector ordering, sector weight, and flavor polarization that are mixed in the globally ordered entanglement spectrum.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在真空角θ=π处双味Schwinger模型中的纠缠谱，发现联合Schmidt分布p_{Q_A,F_A}揭示了依赖于切割方式的规范扇区层级和质量诱导的味道不对称性。通过定义综合权重W_F^{(q)}和条件极化P_F^{(q)}，作者发现改变切割方式会反转权重的层级顺序，而质量不平衡会驱动条件极化偏离零。
AI.motivation: 理解规范理论中纠缠谱如何编码对称性破缺和规范扇区的组织结构。全局纠缠谱中混合了多种信息，需要对称性分辨的联合分布来分离规范扇区排序、扇区权重和味道极化等不同维度的物理内容。
AI.method: 在双味Schwinger模型(θ=π)中，计算以子系统规范电荷Q_A和味道不平衡F_A标记的联合Schmidt分布p_{Q_A,F_A}。定义综合权重W_F^{(q)}=p_{q,+1}+p_{q,-1}和条件极化P_F^{(q)}=(p_{q,+1}-p_{q,-1})/W_F^{(q)}两个量来刻画规范扇区层级与味道不对称性，并通过改变交错切割方式(old staggered cut vs intra-cell cut)和大规模不平衡来系统研究这些量的响应。
AI.result: 改变切割方式会重新组织p_{Q_A}分布（切割依赖的规范扇区层级）；质量不平衡破坏条件味道分布p_{F_A|Q_A}的F_A↔-F_A对称性。具体地，在单元胞边界切割处W_F^{(-1)}>W_F^{(+1)}，而在单元胞内切割处权重层级反转W_F^{(+1)}>W_F^{(-1)}。质量不平衡驱动P_F^{(q)}偏离零，且该响应依赖于规范电荷q。
AI.conclusion: 对称性分辨能够有效分离全局有序纠缠谱中混合的规范扇区排序、扇区权重与味道极化等不同物理成分，为在规范理论中利用纠缠谱研究对称性破缺和组织结构提供了更精细的工具。

title: Separating Spatial and Clinical Risk with Node-Splitting SVM Survival Trees
comment: 37 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables, submitted to Spatial Statistics
summary: Recovering geographic variation in survival requires separating spatial risk from patients' clinical characteristics, a problem complicated by prognostic covariates that are themselves spatially structured. We develop a nonparametric two-stage method for this separation. A clinical survival tree fit to the covariates alone supplies leaf Nelson-Aalen cumulative hazard residuals, transferring the censored survival structure to a clinically adjusted scale without imposing a functional form on the clinical hazard, and a second tree fit to these residuals on the coordinates recovers the spatial structure. Both stages are kernel dipole-splitting survival trees, so the resulting spatial risk map is piecewise constant, with sharp, possibly curved boundaries. We establish when the residuals recover the spatial signal: under a multiplicative frailty and an exogeneity condition, they are free of the clinical covariates given location and stochastically ordered by the frailty. An expansion of the frailty Laplace exponent quantifies their approximate exponentiality and identifies the leading remainder. These results assume consistency of the first stage rather than a model class, so the construction extends to other survival estimators. On the LeukSurv leukemia data the method agrees with a Bayesian Gaussian random field frailty about where risk is elevated while resolving sharp adjacencies the smooth surface averages away, and an unadjusted spatial analysis misattributes clinical variation to location. Simulations with known zones, including a sweep through graded violations of exogeneity, locate the point at which the two contributions cease to be separately identifiable, with the smooth benchmark degrading in parallel as that point is approached.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种非参数两阶段方法，用于从患者临床特征中分离出地理空间对生存风险的影响。第一阶段用临床生存树拟合协变量得到Nelson-Aalen残差，第二阶段用另一棵核偶极分裂生存树对这些残差进行空间拟合，从而得到分片常数、边界锐利且可能弯曲的空间风险图。方法在理论上证明了在乘性脆弱和exogeneity条件下残差能恢复空间信号，并在LeukSurv白血病数据和模拟实验中验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 恢复生存率的地理空间变异需要将空间风险与患者临床特征分离开来，但预后协变量本身也具有空间结构，使得这一分离问题变得复杂。现有方法（如贝叶斯高斯随机场脆弱模型）虽能识别风险区域但会平滑掉锐利的空间边界，而未经调整的空间分析则会将临床变异错误归因于地理位置。
AI.method: 采用两阶段非参数方法：(1) 第一阶段，用仅含协变量的临床生存树拟合数据，提取叶节点的Nelson-Aalen累积风险残差，将删失生存结构转移到临床调整后的尺度，且不施加临床风险函数形式；(2) 第二阶段，用另一棵以坐标为输入的核偶极分裂生存树拟合这些残差，恢复空间结构。两阶段均使用核偶极分裂生存树，使空间风险图为分片常数并具有锐利、可能弯曲的边界。理论分析基于乘性脆弱和exogeneity条件，通过脆弱Laplace指数的展开量化残差的近似指数性。
AI.result: 在LeukSurv白血病数据上，该方法与贝叶斯高斯随机场脆弱模型在风险升高区域的位置上一致，但能解析出平滑表面平均掉的锐利相邻区域；未经调整的空间分析则错误地将临床变异归因于位置。模拟实验包含已知区域以及逐步违反exogeneity条件的扫描，确定了两种贡献不再可分离识别的临界点，且平滑基准方法在该点附近性能同步退化。
AI.conclusion: 两阶段方法能有效从临床特征中分离出空间生存风险，其关键在于第一阶段只要求一致性而非特定模型类，因此可推广到其他生存估计器。该方法在理论和实证上都优于传统平滑空间模型，尤其擅长解析锐利的空间边界，并明确界定了空间与临床贡献可分离识别的条件边界。

title: A Fixed Universal Determinant is Variationally Complete for Continuum Fermions
summary: How many Slater determinants does an accurate variational description of interacting fermions require? Exact expansions in a finite basis need combinatorially many, and state-of-the-art fermionic neural quantum states stack growing numbers of them. We prove that, in the norms that govern variational calculations, at most two are needed, independently of the number of particles and of the target accuracy. A single universal Slater determinant-specified in advance, independent of both the system and the state-multiplied by a smooth bosonic wave function approximates any fermionic wave function in up to three spatial dimensions in the first-order Sobolev norm, which controls the variational energy. Reaching the second-order Sobolev norm-for Coulomb interactions, the domain of the Hamiltonian, which bounds the variance of the local energy at the core of variational Monte Carlo-requires at most one additional fixed determinant, and only in three dimensions. Antisymmetry therefore costs at most two universal determinants and no expressiveness: generalized Slater-Jastrow neural quantum states are variationally complete.

AI.tldr: 本文证明在变分计算相关的范数下，任何费米子波函数最多只需两个Slater行列式即可精确描述，与粒子数和目标精度无关。一个预先指定的通用Slater行列式乘以光滑玻色子波函数，可在三维及以下空间中逼近任意费米子波函数（一阶Sobolev范数，控制变分能）；要达到二阶Sobolev范数（对Coulomb相互作用即哈密顿量的定义域，控制变分蒙特卡洛局部能量方差），三维情形最多只需额外的单一固定行列式。因此反对称性最多只需两个通用行列式，广义Slater-Jastrow神经量子态是变分完备的。
AI.motivation: 精确描述相互作用费米子需要多少Slater行列式是一个基础性问题。精确展开需要组合数量的行列式，而最先进的费米子神经量子态也堆叠越来越多的行列式。作者希望从根本上消除这一计算瓶颈，探索变分意义下是否只需极少数行列式即可实现完备逼近。
AI.method: 作者在Sobolev范数框架下进行严格数学证明。首先证明一阶Sobolev范数（控制变分能量）下，一个预先指定的通用Slater行列式与光滑玻色子波函数（类似Jastrow因子）之积可逼近任意费米子波函数。随后证明要达到二阶Sobolev范数（Coulomb相互作用下哈密顿量的定义域，控制局部能量方差），在三维情形最多需增加一个固定Slater行列式。该分析将反对称性"外包"给固定行列式，余下部分由光滑函数处理。
AI.result: 证明得到以下关键结论：(1) 对抗称性成本至多为两个通用行列式；(2) 一阶Sobolev范数（变分能）下单个通用行列式即足够，适用于维度d≤3；(3) 二阶Sobolev范数（变分蒙特卡洛方差）下需一个额外固定行列式，仅限三维情形。这揭示了广义Slater-Jastrow形式的神经量子态具有变分完备性。
AI.conclusion: 反对称性在变分意义上仅需极少的固定Slater行列式（最多两个）即可完全实现，不影响表达能力。此结果从理论上支持了广义Slater-Jastrow神经量子态作为变分完备的费米子描述框架，为设计更高效、更具扩展性的费米子量子蒙特卡洛方法提供了严格的数学基础。

title: Certified coherent, informative, and non-entanglement-breaking fixed points of future-referential quantum feedback
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures. Ancillary files include a machine-verified interval certificate (Arb/python-flint, 256-bit ball arithmetic), an independent second-stack audit (mpmath), and all research code. Submitted to Foundations of Physics
summary: We study quantum processes in which information extracted from a forward simulation is returned as input to an earlier internal time of the simulated dynamics: externally the protocol is an ordinary causally ordered circuit, but internally it is future-referential. Contracting a process tensor with a leakage instrument and a controller induces a completely positive trace-preserving map on a message register, and we classify its fixed points by five operational properties: stability, informativeness, feedability, coherence, and preservation of quantum correlations. Four results separate notions that informal discussions of "information from the future" often conflate. A two-parameter unitary-dilation family yields a closed-form, globally attractive, coherent fixed point (Proposition 1), yet is entanglement breaking whenever future records are perfectly distinguishable (Lemma 1). Releasing that orthogonality, a four-parameter partial-swap family admits a nonempty open non-entanglement-breaking region (Proposition 2), with an explicit Choi partial-transpose neighborhood of half-width $0.0163π$ (Proposition 3). Combining outward-rounded interval enclosures with perturbation bounds tracking the channel and its stationary-state drift, we certify an explicit parameter square of half-width $0.0013π$ on which the feedback channel is simultaneously strictly contractive (margin $\ge 0.237$), coherent ($\ge 0.416$), informative about the designated future variable ($\ge 0.172$ bits), and non-entanglement-breaking (NPT margin $\ge 0.188$) (Proposition 4). Direct evaluation shows all four properties persisting over a region an order of magnitude larger, so the certified square is a proof of principle rather than a phase boundary. All enclosures and margins are confirmed by a machine-verified ball-arithmetic certificate, and the complete code and certificate accompany the paper.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一种“未来引用”量子过程：从正向模拟中提取的信息被反馈到该模拟动力学更早的内部时刻。外部视角这是一个普通因果有序电路，内部却具有未来指向性。通过将过程张量与泄漏仪器和控制器收缩，可诱导消息寄存器上的完全正迹保持映射，作者用五个操作性性质（稳定性、信息量、可反馈性、相干性、量子关联保持）对其不动点进行分类，并用四个命题将常被混淆的概念分离，辅以机器验证的区间算术证书。
AI.motivation: 非正式讨论中“来自未来的信息”往往混淆了多种相互独立的概念（如相干性、信息量、可反馈性、纠缠保持等）。作者希望严格区分这些性质，并通过构造性例子说明它们之间的微妙关系，特别是证明“可反馈的未来记录”与“纠缠破坏”并非必然同时成立。
AI.method: 通过将过程张量（process tensor）与泄漏仪器（leakage instrument）和控制器（controller）收缩，构造消息寄存器上的完全正迹保持（CPTP）映射。引入五个操作性性质对不动点分类。构造两类参数化酉膨胀族与部分交换族：两参数酉膨胀族给出闭式全局吸引相干不动点；四参数部分交换族放开正交性条件。结合外向舍入区间包络与扰动界（追踪信道及稳态漂移），利用机器验证的球算术（ball-arithmetic）证书对参数区域进行严格认证。
AI.result: 四个主要结果：（1）两参数酉膨胀族存在闭式、全局吸引、相干的不动点，但在未来记录完全可区分时纠缠破坏（Lemma 1）；（2）四参数部分交换族存在非空的非纠缠破坏开区域（Proposition 2）；（3）给出显式的 Choi 部分转置邻域半宽 0.0163π（Proposition 3）；（4）在参数方片半宽 0.0013π 内，反馈信道同时严格收缩（margin ≥ 0.237）、相干（≥ 0.416）、关于目标未来变量信息量 ≥ 0.172 比特、非纠缠破坏（NPT margin ≥ 0.188）（Proposition 4）。直接数值评估显示四种性质在大一个数量级的区域持续成立，认证方片仅是可行性证明而非相界。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过严格的构造与机器验证，系统地分离了“信息来自未来”讨论中被混淆的多种操作性概念，证明存在一个非空的参数区域，其中反馈信道可以同时具备严格收缩性、相干性、信息性和非纠缠破坏性。该方法论为量子因果序与未来反馈协议提供了精确的可验证定量框架。

title: Information Spreading in Diffusion Models from Effective Field Theory
comment: This work was previously presented at the Scientific Methods for Understanding Deep Learning Workshop at ICLR 2026. 14 pages + appendices. Code available at: https://github.com/NavonilNeogi/MutualInfoEFTDiffusionModels
summary: We study score-matching diffusion models with a convolutional architecture. We argue that the inductive bias of locality means that the machinery of effective field theory from physics can be usefully applied to describe the denoising dynamics. We apply this formalism first to a simple toy example which permits an analytical description, and thereafter to MNIST, and show that in both cases, the mutual information between two points grows in a manner predicted by a simple effective field theory of Brownian motion.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了卷积架构的得分匹配扩散模型，提出利用物理学中的有效场论框架来描述其去噪动力学，并在玩具模型和MNIST数据集上验证了该理论预测。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型的卷积架构具有局部性归纳偏置，作者认为这种局部性使得物理学中的有效场论工具可以适用于描述其去噪动力学，从而提供理论层面的深入理解。
AI.method: 作者将有效场论形式主义应用于卷积扩散模型，在可解析描述的简单玩具模型上推导理论预测，进而在MNIST数据集上验证，考察两点间互信息随时间的演化规律。
AI.result: 在玩具模型和MNIST两个案例中，两点之间的互信息增长方式均与简单有效场论所预测的布朗运动行为一致，验证了该理论框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 有效场论为理解卷积扩散模型的去噪动力学提供了有力的理论工具，局部性归纳偏置使得该物理视角在该类模型中具有普适适用性。

title: Generalization Error Estimation for Primal--Dual Algorithms in Non-Smooth Regression
summary: This paper studies trajectory-wise estimation of generalization error for primal--dual algorithms in non-smooth regression. Motivating examples include \(\ell_1\)-penalized least absolute deviations regression and square-root Lasso regression, where the data-fitting loss is non-differentiable and existing risk estimators for gradient-type optimization paths do not apply directly. We develop a general recursive framework that includes the Chambolle--Pock algorithm and related primal--dual splitting methods. We estimate risk by correcting each in-sample fitted value with a weighted combination of past dual iterates. The ideal weights are Stein derivative contractions and depend on the design covariance. We construct replacement weights from observable derivative contractions of the fitted-signal trajectory, yielding a covariance-free, data-driven correction. For high-dimensional Gaussian designs and fixed finite iteration horizon, we prove finite-sample guarantees for both estimators. For square-root ridge, we further establish a matched-Gaussian universality result beyond Gaussian designs. Numerical experiments show that the proposed estimators accurately track the out-of-sample risk along finite optimization paths.

AI.tldr: 本文研究非光滑回归中原对偶算法沿轨迹的泛化误差估计，提出了一个包含Chambolle--Pock算法的递归框架，通过用过去对偶迭代的加权组合修正样本内拟合值来估计风险，构造了无协方差的数据驱动修正权重，并在高斯设计下给出了有限样本保证。
AI.motivation: 非光滑回归（如ℓ1惩罚最小绝对偏差回归和平方根Lasso）中数据拟合损失不可微，现有的基于梯度型优化路径的风险估计器无法直接适用，因此需要针对原对偶算法的轨迹级泛化误差估计方法。
AI.method: 建立包含Chambolle--Pock算法及相关原对偶分裂方法的通用递归框架；用可观测的拟合信号轨迹的导数收缩构造替代权重，替代理论上依赖Stein导数收缩和设计协方差的理想权重，从而实现无协方差的数据驱动修正；对平方根岭回归进一步建立匹配高斯普适性结果。
AI.result: 在高维高斯设计和固定有限迭代次数下，证明了两种估计器的有限样本保证；对平方根岭回归建立了超越高斯设计的匹配高斯普适性结果；数值实验表明所提估计器能准确追踪有限优化路径上的样本外风险。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的轨迹级风险估计方法有效解决了非光滑损失下原对偶路径的泛化误差估计问题，兼具理论保证与实际可行性。

title: Universal Signature of Hundness and Its Quantification
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures in main, 6 figures in supplementary material
summary: Hund's coupling $J$ induces fundamentally different correlation effects from Hubbard $U$. This leads to a violation of the Brinkman--Rice scenario and the emergence of a Janus-faced phase owing to its low-energy effectiveness, in which band renormalization is confined below a characteristic energy scale. We propose a quantitative framework to capture low-energy effectiveness through two correlation factors: $z_L$ for low-energy quasiparticle renormalization and $z_H$ for high-energy charge fluctuations, newly introduced in this study. The discrepancy between $z_L$ and $z_H$ reflects the Hund character of the correlation. By establishing a one-to-one correspondence between correlation factors and the spin and charge susceptibilities, we identify the spin-degree-of-freedom effectiveness as the microscopic origin of low-energy effectiveness. Our framework, validated across multiorbital models and real materials, provides a universal and quantitative measure of Hundness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种定量描述Hund耦合低能有效性的理论框架，通过两个关联因子z_L（低能准粒子重整化）和z_H（高能电荷涨落）来刻画Hund关联特征，并建立了关联因子与自旋/电荷磁化率之间的一一对应关系，从而在多轨道模型和真实材料中提供了衡量"Hundness"的普适量化标准。
AI.motivation: Hund耦合J与Hubbard U在物理上诱导了本质不同的关联效应，导致Brinkman-Rice图像失效，并出现具有Janus双面特征的相——其中能带重整化被限制在某个特征能量尺度以下。已有框架无法定量捕捉这种低能有效性，迫切需要一个新的量化框架来刻画Hund关联的本质。
AI.method: 作者提出了一个定量框架，通过两个关联因子来捕捉低能有效性：(1) z_L用于描述低能准粒子重整化；(2) z_H（新引入）用于描述高能电荷涨落。z_L与z_H的差异反映了Hund关联的特征。进一步建立关联因子与自旋和电荷磁化率之间的一一对应关系，从而识别出自旋自由度有效性是低能有效性的微观起源。
AI.result: 该框架在多轨道模型和真实材料中均得到验证，能够提供一种普适且定量的Hundness度量。z_L与z_H的分离成功捕捉了Hund耦合导致的Janus-faced相特征，并揭示了其微观机制。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为理解Hund耦合与Hubbard U的本质上不同关联效应提供了定量工具，所提出的框架作为一种普适的Hundness度量，可用于多轨道关联电子体系和真实材料的系统性研究。

title: Entanglement asymmetry characterization of the Chiral Anomaly
summary: Shao et al. recently showed that the 1+1D staggered fermion Hamiltonian admits a whole algebra of lattice operators that flow to the same axial charge in the thermodynamic limit (TL). On the lattice the principal axial charge does not commute with the vector charge, although their commutator is expected to vanish in the TL, providing a lattice realization of the chiral anomaly. We investigate the effect of this anomaly on the ground state(s) using the entanglement asymmetry. Unexpectedly, the asymmetry remains nonzero in the TL, despite the vanishing of the commutator, and exhibits a novel scaling behavior.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了1+1维交错费米子哈密顿量中手征反常对纠缠不对称性的影响，发现尽管对易子在热力学极限下趋近于零，纠缠不对称性仍保持非零，并表现出新奇的标度行为。
AI.motivation: Shao等人最近证明1+1维交错费米子哈密顿量具有一整族在热力学极限下流向相同轴荷的格点算符代数。在格点上，主轴荷与矢量荷不对易，尽管它们的对易子预期在热力学极限下消失，这提供了手征反常的格点实现。作者希望利用纠缠不对称性研究这一反常对基态的影响，以深入理解反常在格点系统中的表现。
AI.method: 利用纠缠不对称性这一工具，通过计算基态中轴电荷与矢量电荷之间的对称性破缺程度，来分析手征反常对基态的影响。重点考察纠缠不对称性在热力学极限下的行为及其标度规律。
AI.result: 出乎意料地发现，尽管对易子在热力学极限下趋于零，纠缠不对称性在热力学极限下仍保持非零，并且展现出一种新颖的标度行为。
AI.conclusion: 手征反常在格点上对基态纠缠结构有深远影响：即使对易子消失，纠缠不对称性仍不消失，表明异常在热力学极限下依然具有物理可观测效应，且其标度行为与常规情况不同，揭示了反常在格点体系中更丰富的物理内涵。

title: Quantum Snapshots Reveal a Compact Conformal Boundary Mode
summary: A projective measurement of a many-body state produces a microscopic snapshot, usually viewed as random classical data. We show that partial occupation snapshots of the critical XX chain contain a universal angle with a precise conformal meaning. Dividing the ring into two measured and two unmeasured arcs, we assign geometry-dependent conformal side weights to the observed occupations and obtain a compact variable $δ_L$. At every finite size, $δ_L$ is fixed by the measured sites alone; the particular complete-configuration lift $X_L$ used in the proof additionally depends on unobserved particles. This angle is an exact microscopic compact coordinate whose scaling-limit law is that of the relative Dirichlet phase of the associated conformal quadrilateral---the boundary coordinate conjugate to charge in continuum post-measurement descriptions. Exact free-fermion determinants yield all of its Fourier moments. We prove that the lift becomes Gaussian with variance $2h(ζ)$, where $h(ζ)$ is the rectangle modulus, and hence $\langle e^{\ii qδ_L}\rangle\to e^{-h(ζ)q^2}$. Thus raw quantum snapshots realize the heat kernel on a circle and provide an outcome-level microscopic foundation for the compact zero-mode sector of Born averages over fluctuating conformal boundary conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究临界XX自旋链部分占据快照（partial occupation snapshots）中隐含的共形角度。将该环分为两个测量弧和两个未测量弧后，测量得到的占据构型定义了与几何相关的共形权重参数δ_L，其缩放极限服从共形四边形相对Dirichlet相位分布。该角度是精确的微观紧致坐标，其傅里叶矩由精确自由费米子行列式给出，且证明其提升服从方差为2h(ζ)的高斯分布，最终⟨e^{iqδ_L}⟩→e^{-h(ζ)q²}。因此，量子快照在圆上实现了热核，为Born平均中涨落共形边界条件的紧致零模扇区提供了结果层面的微观基础。
AI.motivation: 理解多体量子态投影测量产生的经典数据中是否包含普适的、具有精确共形意义的可观测信息，并建立微观量子快照与连续统共形场论中紧致零模（compact zero-mode）之间的联系。
AI.method: 采用精确自由费米子行列式方法计算δ_L的所有傅里叶矩；将环划分为两个测量弧与两个未测量弧并赋以共形侧权重；利用完整构型提升X_L构造紧致变量δ_L，通过费米子行列式证明其缩放极限的高斯性。
AI.result: 证明δ_L在任意有限尺寸下仅由被测位点决定；其缩放极限服从相对Dirichlet相位分布，即共形四边形边界坐标共轭于电荷的量；傅里叶矩精确由自由费米子行列式给出；提升X_L在缩放极限下为方差2h(ζ)的高斯分布，从而⟨e^{iqδ_L}⟩→e^{-h(ζ)q²}。
AI.conclusion: 原始量子快照以结果层面（outcome-level）实现了圆上的热核，为Born平均上涨落共形边界条件的紧致零模扇区提供了微观基础，揭示了随机量子测量数据中蕴含的普适共形几何结构。

title: High-dimensional nonparametric changepoint detection via low-rank degree-two density projection
summary: Detecting distributional changes in high dimension is difficult when neither the pre-change nor post-change density is parametrically specified. We introduce a representation-based approach that retains all degree-at-most-two density information while replacing density estimation by matrix mean estimation. For observations in $[-1,1]^d$, a symmetric feature matrix $H_2(X)\in\R^{(d+1)\times(d+1)}$ is constructed so that $M(f)=\E_f H_2(X)$ is an isometric encoding of the degree-two orthogonal projection of the density. We scan matrix CUSUMs after rank-$r$ truncation, exploiting the low rank of the projected jump rather than sparsity of individual coordinates. The resulting \LRD{} estimator has a tent-shaped population objective and a nonasymptotic operator-norm analysis whose leading stochastic term scales as $\sqrt{rd\log(nd)}$. For multiple changes, we give a seeded narrowest-over-threshold procedure and prove exact recovery by an induction that preserves an isolating interval for every undetected change. A cross-fitted scalar refinement learns the changing low-rank direction on one fold and localizes on the other, attaining $\widetilde O_{\Pp}(κ^{-2})$ error; a matching Le Cam lower bound shows optimality up to logarithms. A geometrically $β$-mixing extension follows from a dependent matrix Bernstein inequality. Experiments with ambient dimension up to $200$, a three-change $d=100$ sequence, and a $128$-feature human-activity benchmark show that the method remains computationally practical and accurately detects pure dependence changes that are invisible to mean CUSUMs.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于表示（representation-based）的高维分布变化检测方法，通过对特征矩阵进行低秩CUSUM扫描，在无需参数化密度假设的情况下检测高维分布变化。该方法利用密度二阶正交投影的低秩特性，通过矩阵均值估计替代密度估计，实现了非渐近的算子范数分析和多变化点的精确恢复，并在理论上达到Le Cam下界意义下的最优性。
AI.motivation: 高维分布变化检测在前后密度均未参数化指定时非常困难，现有的CUSUM方法通常依赖稀疏性假设或需要参数化密度的模型。作者希望构建一种无需密度估计、不依赖坐标稀疏性、能捕捉纯依赖结构变化（均值不变的）的通用方法，同时保证统计和计算上的可行性。
AI.method: 构建对称特征矩阵H2(X)，使得M(f)=E_f H2(X)是对密度二阶正交投影的等距编码。对矩阵CUSUM进行秩r截断后扫描，利用投影跳跃的低秩性而非坐标稀疏性。提出LRD估计器（具有帐篷形总体目标函数与非渐近算子范数分析）；对多变化点给出seeded narrowest-over-threshold过程，通过归纳法保持未检测变化点的隔离区间；通过交叉拟合的标量精细化方法在训练折学习变化方向、在验证折定位，达到ÕP(κ^{-2})误差；并基于依赖矩阵Bernstein不等式推广到几何β-混合序列。
AI.result: 主导随机项以sqrt(rd log(nd))缩放；交叉拟合精化达到ÕP(κ^{-2})定位误差，并与Le Cam下界匹配（至多相差对数因子）。在环境维度高达200、d=100的三变化点序列及128特征的人类活动基准实验中，方法保持计算可行性，并能准确检测纯依赖结构变化（这些变化对均值CUSUM不可见）。
AI.conclusion: 通过矩阵表示和低秩结构利用，该方法在非参数高维分布变化检测中同时实现了理论最优性和实际可行性，特别擅长检测均值变化CUSUM无法捕捉的纯依赖结构变化，并支持多变化点场景与混合依赖数据的推广。

title: Chiral spin liquid and chiral antiferromagnetism in half-filled moiré Hubbard model: possible applications to twisted bilayer TMDs
summary: Twisted transition metal dichalcogenides offer an exceptionally tunable moiré platform for studying correlation physics beyond conventional condensed matter systems. In particular, the intriguing interplay between the displacement field and the twist angle remains to be fully resolved. In this paper, we use large-scale density matrix renormalization group simulations to study the minimal moiré Hubbard model on a triangular lattice at half-filling, where the displacement field effect is captured by a spin-dependent staggered flux. We find that the displacement field significantly enriches the triangular Hubbard phase diagram in several qualitative ways. It rapidly destabilizes the chiral spin liquid phase beyond a narrow weak-field regime, induces pronounced chiral correlations in the strong-coupling $120^\circ$-antiferromagnetic phase, and stabilizes incommensurate spin-density wave phases at weaker coupling. We further find signatures of a continuous transition between the chiral spin liquid and chiral antiferromagnetic phases at a finite displacement field, potentially driven by spinon condensation. Our results uncover rich displacement-field-driven many-body physics and provide useful guidance for future experiments in moiré superlattice systems.

AI.tldr: 本文利用大规模密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）模拟，研究了三角晶格半填充最小moiré Hubbard模型中位移场与转角耦合的物理效应。研究发现位移场（由自旋依赖的交错通量刻画）会快速破坏手性自旋液体相、在强耦合120°反铁磁相中诱导明显的手性关联，并在弱耦合下稳定非公度自旋密度波相，同时发现了手性自旋液体与手性反铁磁相之间潜在的、由旋子凝聚驱动的连续相变。
AI.motivation: 扭曲过渡金属硫化物（TMD）提供了高度可调的moiré平台来研究超越常规凝聚态体系的关联物理，但位移场与转角之间的相互作用尚未被完全理解，需要系统研究。
AI.method: 采用大规模密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）模拟，研究三角晶格半填充的moiré Hubbard模型，其中位移场效应通过自旋依赖的交错通量来刻画。
AI.result: 位移场显著丰富了三角Hubbard相图：(1) 在极窄弱场区间内迅速破坏手性自旋液体相；(2) 在强耦合120°反铁磁相中诱导明显的手性关联；(3) 在弱耦合区稳定非公度自旋密度波相；(4) 在有限位移场下发现手性自旋液体与手性反铁磁相之间可能的连续相变（可能由旋子凝聚驱动）。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明位移场驱动了丰富的多体物理现象，为moiré超晶格系统的未来实验提供了有价值的理论指导。

title: Fast classical simulation of `Fast, accurate, high-resolution simulation of large-scale Fermi-Hubbard models on a digital quantum processor'
summary: We study the Néel quench dynamics of a 1D Fermi-Hubbard model which has recently been simulated on quantum hardware. We demonstrate that the set of 7260 observable trajectories measured in the quantum experiment can be obtained more quickly and accurately through classical tensor network simulation using modest computation. Our result relies on transverse tensor network contraction, where a bond dimension of 32 is already sufficient to reproduce the quantum experiment. We further extend the converged observable trajectories to longer times than in the hardware simulation and in other recent classical simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了1D费米-哈伯德模型的Néel淬火动力学，证明通过经典张量网络模拟（横向张量网络收缩，键维数32即可）可以比量子硬件更快、更准确地获得7260条可观测轨迹，并将收敛的轨迹外推至比硬件模拟和其他经典模拟更长的时间。
AI.motivation: 近年来1D费米-哈伯德模型的Néel淬火动力学已在量子硬件上得到模拟，但量子硬件模拟存在噪声、时间限制等问题。作者希望验证经典张量网络方法能否以更高效率和准确性复现（甚至超越）量子硬件的实验结果，从而为这类问题提供更可靠、可扩展的经典计算方案。
AI.method: 采用经典张量网络模拟方法，核心是横向张量网络收缩（transverse tensor network contraction）技术，使用键维数（bond dimension）为32的张量网络来复现量子硬件实验中测量的7260条可观测轨迹。
AI.result: 仅需键维数32的张量网络收缩即可准确复现量子硬件实验的全部7260条可观测轨迹，且计算速度更快、精度更高；同时，该方法能将收敛的可观测轨迹扩展到比硬件模拟和其他近期经典模拟更长的时间范围。
AI.conclusion: 经典张量网络模拟（特别是横向张量网络收缩）是模拟1D费米-哈伯德模型Néel淬火动力学的强有力工具，不仅能够高效准确地复现量子硬件结果，还具备更优的时间外推能力，表明在该问题上经典方法仍具有显著的竞争力。

title: Universal Thermodynamic Interatomic Potentials for Crystalline Materials
summary: Free energies govern solid-state phase stability, yet computational materials discovery still relies largely on ground-state energies because free energy calculations require ensemble averages. We introduce the thermodynamic interatomic potential (TIP), which extends an interatomic potential from its static energy to a thermodynamically consistent Gibbs free energy model, with thermodynamic responses following from temperature and pressure by automatic differentiation. We implement TIP[UMA] using the universal potential UMA, train it on free energies from quasi-harmonic to molecular dynamics fidelity, and calibrate it to higher-resolution calculations or experiment. From a single evaluation, it returns the equation of state of a crystal and locates phase transitions among competing branches, including dynamically stabilized phases. Fine-tuning extends the model to alloy solubility limits and miscibility gaps. TIP makes the free energy as accessible as the potential energy, opening finite-temperature phase stability to high-throughput discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出热力学原子间势（TIP），将传统原子间势从静态能量扩展为热力学一致的吉布斯自由能模型，通过自动微分获得热力学响应，使自由能计算与势能一样便捷，从而将有限温度相稳定性引入高通量材料发现。
AI.motivation: 自由能决定固相稳定性，但计算材料发现仍主要依赖基态能量，因为自由能计算需要系综平均，计算成本高、流程复杂，阻碍了有限温度下相稳定性的高通量筛选。
AI.method: 提出TIP框架，将原子间势从静态能量扩展为热力学一致的吉布斯自由能模型；基于通用势UMA实现TIP[UMA]，在从准谐近似到分子动力学的多层级自由能数据上训练，并标定到更高精度计算或实验；通过温度与压力的自动微分获得热力学响应；单个评估即可得到晶体状态方程并定位相变。
AI.result: TIP[UMA]可从单次评估返回晶体状态方程、定位竞争分支间的相变（包括动态稳定相）；微调可扩展到合金溶解度极限和混溶间隙预测。
AI.conclusion: TIP使自由能计算变得与势能计算同样简便，将有限温度相稳定性开放给高通量材料发现，为该领域提供了新的基础工具。

title: QUASAR: Lowering the Loss Floor of Quantization-Aware Training with Loss-Aware Reconstruction
summary: As large language model inference shifts toward lower precision, post-training quantization (PTQ) becomes increasingly brittle, making quantization-aware training (QAT) essential for preserving model quality. However, QAT computes the loss and surrogate gradients using a lossy reconstruction of latent full-precision weights, while applying updates to the latent weights themselves. This mismatch can lead to suboptimal training trajectories and a higher loss floor. Second-order PTQ methods mitigate a similar gap by minimizing loss-aware reconstruction error, but doing it once for a frozen model can take hours; repeating this process throughout QAT as the weights evolve is impractical. We introduce QUASAR, a QAT method that continuously performs lightweight, loss-aware reconstruction in the training loop to lower the loss floor and improve the resulting low-bit model. At each training step, QUASAR uses the exponential moving average of squared gradients as online saliency estimates, searches over a small set of clipping ranges, and fits affine dequantizers via saliency-weighted least squares. Our analysis shows that the loss-aware reconstruction error is the only reconstruction-dependent term in the QAT convergence bound and controls the loss of the final quantized model, establishing QUASAR's objective as a principled optimization target. QUASAR modifies only the training procedure and supports standard deployment formats, including integer quantization and NVFP4, with no inference-time changes or overhead. Across Qwen3 and Llama-3.1, QUASAR achieves the lowest held-out KL divergence among competitive QAT methods at 2, 3, and 4 bits, reducing KL by at least 10% at 3 and 4 bits and by 29% at 2 bits. At 2 bits, it improves average accuracy across eight tasks by 3.5-4.3 percentage points over strong QAT and PTQ baselines.

AI.tldr: QUASAR是一种量化感知训练（QAT）方法，通过在训练循环中持续进行轻量级、损失感知的权重重建来降低损失下限并提升低比特模型质量。它利用梯度平方的指数移动平均值作为在线显著性估计，搜索少量裁剪范围，并通过显著性加权最小二乘拟合仿射反量化器。在Qwen3和Llama-3.1上，QUASAR在2/3/4比特下取得了最低的KL散度，2比特时在八项任务上平均准确率提升3.5-4.3个百分点。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型推理向低精度方向发展，后训练量化（PTQ）变得越来越脆弱，量化感知训练（QAT）对保持模型质量至关重要。然而，传统QAT存在核心矛盾：损失和代理梯度是基于有损重建的全精度权重计算的，而更新却施加在潜在权重上，这种不匹配导致训练轨迹次优、损失下限更高。虽然二阶PTQ方法通过损失感知重建误差最小化缓解了类似问题，但此类方法仅对冻结模型运行一次就可能耗费数小时，在权重不断演化的QAT过程中重复此过程是不切实际的。
AI.method: QUASAR在每一步训练中执行三项核心操作：1) 使用梯度平方的指数移动平均（EMA）作为在线显著性估计；2) 在一个小的裁剪范围集合中搜索最优范围；3) 通过显著性加权最小二乘法拟合仿射反量化器。理论分析表明，损失感知重建误差是QAT收敛界中唯一与重建相关的项，且控制着最终量化模型的损失，从而确立了QUASAR目标的原理性优化地位。QUASAR仅修改训练过程，支持包括整数量化和NVFP4在内的标准部署格式，推理时无任何改动或开销。
AI.result: 在Qwen3和Llama-3.1模型上，QUASAR在2、3、4比特下均取得所有竞争性QAT方法中最低的留出集KL散度：3和4比特下KL至少降低10%，2比特下降低29%。在2比特设置中，相比强QAT和PTQ基线，QUASAR在八个任务上平均准确率提升3.5-4.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: QUASAR通过将轻量级损失感知重建融入QAT训练循环，有效解决了传统QAT中损失计算与权重更新之间的不匹配问题，降低了损失下限并显著提升了低比特量化模型的性能。该方法具备理论保障、部署无缝兼容以及显著的实证优势，是面向低精度LLM推理的实用高效QAT方案。

title: Thermal effect on the anomaly-induced electromechanical response in gapped graphene
summary: Mechanical deformation of gapped graphene can act on Dirac quasiparticles as an emergent gauge field. When this deformation field couples to the same current as the electromagnetic field, the parity anomaly produces a mixed electromechanical Chern-Simons response: a phonon electric field drives a transverse electrical current, and a phonon magnetic field binds charge. Previous zero-temperature results predict a sharp change in the response when the chemical potential crosses the band edge. We show that finite temperature replaces this sharp feature by a universal smooth crossover controlled only by the ratios of temperature, gap, and chemical potential. The response remains almost quantized in the insulating regime, is rounded over a gate window of order temperature near the band edge, and approaches the doped Berry-curvature result with a controlled Sommerfeld correction. We apply the result to two experimentally useful drives: a traveling flexural wave, which produces a transverse second-harmonic current, and a dynamic phonon mixed with a static ripple, which produces a fundamental-frequency signal. The same gate-temperature line shape controls both signals. This gives a direct way to separate the anomaly-induced current from ordinary electromechanical backgrounds and to extract the effective gap and electronic temperature in graphene devices.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有能隙石墨烯中声子与电子耦合产生的混合电力学Chern-Simons响应在有限温度下的行为。零温结果显示当化学势穿过带边时响应发生突变，而本文证明有限温度将该尖锐特征替换为仅由温度、能隙和化学势之比控制的普适光滑交叉。响应在绝缘区间保持近似量子化，在带边附近被温度量级的栅压窗口圆滑化，并在掺杂区趋近Berry曲率结果并伴随受控的Sommerfeld修正。该结果适用于行波挠曲波（产生横向二次谐波电流）和动态声子与静态波纹混合（产生基频信号），两者具有相同的栅-温线形，可用于分离反常诱导电流与普通电力学背景，并提取石墨烯器件的有效能隙和电子温度。
AI.motivation: 零温研究预测化学势穿过带边时混合电力学Chern-Simons响应出现尖锐突变，但实际实验在有限温度下进行。理解这一响应如何随温度演化对于实验探测并由寻常背景中分离反常信号至关重要。
AI.method: 通过解析计算有限温度下混合电力学Chern-Simons响应的温度依赖，分析其三参数（温度、能隙、化学势）标度行为，并针对两种实验可行的驱动场景（行波挠曲波产生二次谐波、动态声子与静态波纹混合产生基频）推导响应线形。
AI.result: 有限温度将零温的突变替换为普适光滑交叉，由温度/能隙/化学势的比值唯一控制。绝缘区响应保持近似量子化，带边附近以温度量级的窗口圆滑过渡，掺杂区趋近Berry曲率结果并带Sommerfeld修正。两种实验驱动产生的信号共享同一栅-温线形。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了有限温度下奇偶反常诱导的混合电力学响应的普适标度行为，提供了一种直接分离反常电流与普通电力学背景的方法，并可以从实验线形中提取石墨烯器件的有效能隙和电子温度。

title: Resource-efficient quantum eigenvalue transform with commutator scaling
summary: We develop quantum algorithms for estimating properties of general matrix functions of Hermitian matrices, with applications to phase estimation, Green's function evaluation, and estimating measurement distributions of time-evolved states. The resulting methods exhibit commutator scaling in matrix parameters similar to that usually found for product formulae, lower circuit depth in other parameters, and require only a single ancillary qubit. Our central primitive consists of classically postprocessing randomly chosen product formulae circuits, which mathematically corresponds to an approximation of a Richardson extrapolation. Within our framework, we introduce a protocol for approximating the measurement distributions of quantum states, extending beyond standard observable estimation. We also provide tightened gate complexity bounds for practically relevant systems, including those with k-local interactions, long-tailed matrix ensembles, and conserved quantities. Finally, numerical experiments confirm that our method can achieve significantly shallower circuit depths than standard product formulae in certain parameter regimes, and highlight the potential of their heuristic application.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于估计厄米矩阵一般矩阵函数性质的量子算法，利用经典后处理随机选择的乘积公式电路（数学上对应Richardson外推的近似），仅需单个辅助比特，具有交换子缩放、更低电路深度等优势，并扩展到量子态测量分布估计，数值实验验证了其在某些参数区域显著优于标准乘积公式。
AI.motivation: 量子计算中需要高效估计矩阵函数性质（如相位估计、Green's function、含时演化态的测量分布），但现有方法（如乘积公式）电路深度较高，且通常局限于标准可观测量的期望值估计，缺乏对测量分布层面的估计能力。
AI.method: 核心原语是对随机选择的乘积公式电路进行经典后处理，数学上等价于Richardson外推的近似。该方法仅需单个辅助量子比特，在矩阵参数上展现出与乘积公式类似的交换子缩放，同时在其他参数上具有更低的电路深度。此外还引入了超越标准可观测量估计的量子态测量分布近似协议，并给出了k-局域相互作用、长尾矩阵系综和守恒量等实际系统的紧致门复杂度界。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，在特定参数区域中该方法能达到比标准乘积公式显著更浅的电路深度，并展示了启发式应用的潜力。同时为k-局域相互作用、长尾矩阵系综和守恒量系统提供了更紧的门复杂度界限。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供了一种灵活的框架，在保持交换子缩放的条件下降低电路深度，并扩展了量子算法的适用范围至测量分布估计，具有实际应用潜力。

title: When Does More Correct Data Hurt? Insertion-Stability and the Limits of Dimension-Based Theory
summary:
Adding data known to be correct ought to be safe. Not always. Larsen, Pabbaraju and Shetty model the failure with a monotone adversary, which reads an i.i.d. training sample and may append as many further examples as it likes, provided the target hypothesis labels them all. Mehrotra has since settled the cost, showing that for classes of VC dimension d >= 2 no learner can guarantee expected error better than Theta((d/n)log(en/d)), a logarithmic factor above the clean PAC rate.
  Because that rate is a worst case over all classes, it says nothing about which classes actually suffer the penalty, and the answer turns on the learner. We call a learner insertion-stable if feeding it more correctly labeled examples can only shrink the region where it errs. Such learners are immune to the adversary, since on any given sample the risk after insertions never exceeds the risk on the clean part alone, however much is added and however cleverly it is chosen. High- probability guarantees carry over unchanged, and because Closure is insertion-stable every intersection-closed class keeps its clean rate of E[Err] <= (21d+34)/n.
  Immunity is not something the classical dimensions can predict. Two classes can agree on VCdim = Ldim = 2 and still split, one at Theta(1/n) and the other at Theta(log(en)/n), while intervals have unbounded Littlestone dimension and are immune anyway. On Mehrotra's hard class we prove more than the failure of a single algorithm, showing that no monotone permutation-invariant compression scheme of any finite size attains the clean rate.
  The question is therefore not whether a class is hard, nor whether a learner is good, but whether the two suit each other. Given an insertion-stable learner that is optimal on clean data, correct additions are free, and without one the cost belongs to the class, so changing the learner will not avoid it.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"插入稳定学习器"的概念：当学习器只会因更多正确标注的数据而减少错误区域时，它就能免疫单调对抗者（monotone adversary）的插入攻击。论文证明插入稳定学习器在高概率保证下完全免疫，且闭合类（intersection-closed classes）因Closure算法保持最优清洁率；但经典维度（VC维、Littlestone维）无法预测这种免疫性，两个同样VCdim=Ldim=2的类可分别处于Theta(1/n)和Theta(log(en)/n)的差异。在Mehrotra的困难类上，没有任何有限大小的单调置换不变压缩方案能达到清洁率。
AI.motivation: 先前工作（Larsen等人）用单调对抗者建模了"加入正确数据反而伤害学习器"的现象，Mehrotra证明了最坏情况下的代价是Theta((d/n)log(en/d))，比清洁PAC率多一个对数因子。但该最坏情况分析无法回答哪些具体类别实际上承受这种惩罚、哪些学习器免疫，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 定义"插入稳定学习器"：训练样本加入更多正确标注的例子后，学习器的错误区域只能缩小、不能扩大。由此证明这类学习器天然免疫单调对抗者。利用这一框架：(1) 证明Closure算法是插入稳定的，因此所有交集闭合类保持E[Err] <= (21d+34)/n的清洁率；(2) 构造两个VC维和Littlestone维均为2的类别，展示免疫性差异；(3) 对Mehrotra困难类证明其缺乏任何有限大小的单调置换不变压缩方案。
AI.result: 插入稳定学习器对单调对抗者完全免疫，高概率保证可无变化继承。交集闭合类通过Closure保持清洁率。免疫性不可由VC维、Littlestone维等经典维度刻画——两个维数完全相同的类别可一个为Theta(1/n)、另一个为Theta(log(en)/n)，而区间类虽有无限Littlestone维却仍免疫。Mehrotra困难类上任何有限大小的单调置换不变压缩方案都无法达到清洁率。
AI.conclusion: 问题的本质不是类别本身难不难，也不是学习器好不好，而是二者是否匹配。拥有干净数据上最优的插入稳定学习器时，正确数据的加入是无代价的；反之，代价归属于类别本身，更换学习器也无法规避。这重新定义了鲁棒学习的理论框架：将对抗鲁棒性问题转化为学习器-类别适配性问题。

title: Microscopic investigation of spin dynamics in the single-chain magnet Sr4Mn2CoO9
summary: One-dimensional single-chain magnets offer a unique platform for studying the interplay of crystal-field effects, exchange interactions, and lattice dynamics. Here, we investigate spin excitations in Sr4Mn2CoO9 using inelastic neutron scattering (INS) and theoretical modelling. INS reveals two low-energy magnetic excitations at 4 and 7 meV from Mn-Co-Mn spin chains, alongside higher-energy crystal-electric-field (CEF) excitations from two crystallographically inequivalent Co2+ sites. Interestingly, these spin excitations persist at room temperature, demonstrating dynamic magnetic correlations in the absence of long-range order. Furthermore, the crystal-field modelling, based on Stevens operator formalism, reproduces well the CEF spectra, establishing Ising-like Kramers ground-state doublets with strong uniaxial magnetic anisotropy for both Co2+ ions. In addition, the spin wave simulation using SpinW reproduces the spin excitation spectrum and reveals microscopic exchange interactions in two non-interacting Mn-Co-Mn spin chains. Finally, machine-learning lattice-dynamics calculations confirm the phonon spectrum and spin-phonon coupling. By projecting the exchange Hamiltonian onto CEF ground-state doublets, we estimate exchange-induced splittings matching the observed excitations. Thus, our results elucidate low-energy spin dynamics arising from combined crystal-field anisotropy and exchange interactions, with the persistent low-energy excitation providing a microscopic pathway for thermally activated spin relaxation. Furthermore, this work delivers a unified microscopic understanding of the interplay between crystal-field effects, magnetic exchange, and lattice dynamics in Sr4Mn2CoO9, advancing insights into spin dynamics in low-dimensional transition-metal oxides.

AI.tldr: 本文通过非弹性中子散射(INS)和理论建模，研究了Sr4Mn2CoO9中一维Mn-Co-Mn自旋链的自旋激发，发现4和7 meV的低能磁激发及更高能的晶场(CEF)激发，并揭示了室温下持续存在的动态磁关联、Ising型Kramers基态双峰、微观交换相互作用、声子谱与自旋-声子耦合，为理解低温维过渡金属氧化物中的自旋动力学提供了统一的微观图像。
AI.motivation: 一维单链磁体为研究晶场效应、交换相互作用和晶格动力学之间的相互作用提供了独特平台，理解其低能自旋动力学对于揭示热激活自旋弛豫的微观机制至关重要。
AI.method: 采用非弹性中子散射(INS)实验测量自旋激发谱；基于Stevens算符形式进行晶场建模以描述Co2+离子的能级结构；使用SpinW软件进行自旋波模拟以提取微观交换相互作用；利用机器学习辅助的晶格动力学计算验证声子谱和自旋-声子耦合；将交换哈密顿量投影到晶场基态双峰上估算交换诱导劈裂。
AI.result: INS观测量4和7 meV的低能磁激发以及来自两个不等价Co2+位点的更高能CEF激发；这些自旋激发在室温下持续存在，表明无长程有序下存在动态磁关联。晶场建模成功重现CEF谱，确认两个Co2+离子均为强单轴各向异性的Ising型Kramers基态双峰。SpinW模拟重现自旋激发谱并揭示两条非相互作用Mn-Co-Mn自旋链中的微观交换相互作用。机器学习晶格动力学计算确认了声子谱和自旋-声子耦合。交换诱导劈裂与观测激发一致。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了Sr4Mn2CoO9中晶场效应、磁交换和晶格动力学相互作用的统一微观理解，阐明了晶场各向异性与交换相互作用协同产生的低能自旋动力学，为低温维过渡金属氧化物中的自旋动力学研究提供了深入见解。

title: de Broglie-Bohm Dynamics with Schrödinger Source Fields: A Framework for Subquantum Theory
summary: We extend de Broglie--Bohm (dBB) pilot-wave theory by introducing a complex source field into the Schrödinger equation and examining its effects on quantum equilibrium and nonequilibrium dynamics. In dBB theory, the physical particle distribution P, rather than the Born density $|ψ|^2$, carries the ensemble probability, so a source term may modify the pilot wave without violating conservation of total particle probability. We derive the source-modified Hamilton--Jacobi and continuity equations, the transport equation for the nonequilibrium ratio $f=P/|ψ|^2$, and an exact entropy-production formula. Three applications follow. First, suitably designed sources can drive exponential relaxation toward quantum equilibrium. Second, the entropy-production rate admits a Prigogine-type bilinear form, providing a basis for a subquantum thermodynamics with entropy-producing and entropy-extracting regimes. Third, a tuned source can exactly cancel the Bohmian quantum potential, yielding classical particle trajectories while the guiding wave retains nontrivial structure and the nonequilibrium ratio remains conserved. The resulting framework provides a unified setting for studying source-driven quantum nonequilibrium, entropy exchange, and classicalization, and motivates further investigation of the physical and ontological status of the source field.

AI.tldr: 本文通过向薛定谔方程引入复源场来扩展de Broglie-Bohm导引波理论，系统地研究了其对量子平衡与非平衡动力学的影响，推导了源修正的Hamilton-Jacobi方程、连续性方程、非平衡比输运方程及精确熵产生公式，并展示了三个应用：驱动指数驰豫到量子平衡、建立Prigogine型双线性熵产生的亚量子热力学、以及精确抵消Bohm量子势实现经典化轨迹。
AI.motivation: 在标准de Broglie-Bohm理论中，物理粒子分布P（而非Born密度|ψ|²）承载系综概率，这一自由度允许在不违反总粒子概率守恒的前提下修改导引波。作者旨在利用这一特性引入源场，为研究量子非平衡动力学、熵交换和经典化现象提供一个统一的理论框架。
AI.method: 方法上，作者将复源项直接加入薛定谔方程，并基于dBB理论中粒子分布P与Born密度分离的核心假设（即允许非平衡态f=P/|ψ|²≠1），推导出源修正的Hamilton-Jacobi方程和连续性方程，进而导出非平衡比的输运方程以及精确的熵产生公式。通过设计特定形式的源函数，分别实现三种物理情境：指数驰豫到量子平衡、Prigogine型双线性熵产生热力学、以及量子势的精确抵消实现经典轨迹。
AI.result: 研究取得了三项主要结果：(1) 适当设计的源可以使系统指数驰豫至量子平衡；(2) 熵产生率具有Prigogine型双线性形式，支持熵产生与熵提取两种热力学体制；(3) 调谐的源能精确抵消Bohm量子势，使粒子沿经典轨迹运动，同时导引波仍保留非平凡结构且非平衡比保持守恒。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为源驱动的量子非平衡、熵交换和经典化现象提供了统一的描述平台，并明确指出源场的物理与本体论地位是一个值得深入研究的开放问题。

title: Forecast Collapse in Time-Series Foundation Models
summary: When forecasting hourly returns for 1,000 US equities, we observe an unexpected phenomenon: predictions become nearly flat and show poor stock ranking, as measured by cross-sectional correlation. We call this forecast collapse. Surprisingly, the phenomenon largely disappears when forecasting trading volume under the same setting. We investigate forecast collapse across time-series foundation models (TSFMs), twelve deep-learning forecasting models, and 97 public benchmark configurations, and find that it is closely tied to target predictability. We identify two distinct reasons behind it: low predictability limits the amplitude of calibrated point forecasts, while per-series objectives leave cross-series structure unidentified. These findings reveal a calibration-ranking tradeoff: optimizing squared error leads to flat predictions, whereas directly optimizing cross-sectional correlation improves ranking but can inflate forecast amplitude by more than an order of magnitude. To address this tradeoff, we introduce CalibRank, a simple objective that balances calibration and ranking. On Finance1K, CalibRank nearly triples cross-sectional correlation while keeping amplitude close to the target, and improves correlation on all tested models. Our results reveal a blind spot in conventional time-series evaluation: per-series metrics can hide failures in cross-series structure needed by downstream decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文发现时间序列预测中的"预测坍缩"现象：预测1000只美国股票的小时收益率时，预测结果近乎平坦且股票排序能力差（横截面相关性低）。该现象与目标可预测性密切相关，源于两个方面：低可预测性限制校准点预测的幅度，以及逐序列目标函数无法识别横截面结构。作者提出CalibRank目标函数，在保持预测幅度接近真实值的同时，将横截面相关性提升近三倍。
AI.motivation: 传统时间序列评估只关注逐序列指标，忽略了跨序列结构（如股票之间的横截面排序关系），导致在实际决策（如投资组合构建）中关键信息的缺失。作者旨在揭示这一盲区，并解决预测坍缩这一此前未被识别的现象。
AI.method: 作者在1000只美国股票的小时收益率预测场景下，系统性地在时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）、12种深度学习预测模型和97个公开基准配置上调查预测坍缩现象。通过对比收益率与交易量预测的差异定位现象与目标可预测性的关联，并识别出两个原因：低可预测性限制校准点预测幅度、逐序列目标缺失横截面结构。进而提出CalibRank目标函数以同时优化校准与排序。
AI.result: 在Finance1K数据集上，CalibRank将横截面相关性提升近三倍，同时保持预测幅度接近目标值；在所有测试模型上均提升了横截面相关性。此外，研究表明直接优化横截面相关性虽能提升排序但会放大预测幅度超过一个数量级，验证了校准-排序权衡的存在。
AI.conclusion: 常规时间序列评估存在盲点：逐序列指标可能掩盖下游决策所需的跨序列结构失败。这要求评估体系需要同时考虑校准与排序两方面，CalibRank为此提供了一个简单有效的平衡方案。

title: Dispersive-phonon-driven room-temperature Ni1+-Ni2+ polaron hopping in spin-charge coupled rutile niobate
summary: Understanding how lattice dynamics mediate polaron hopping is essential for designing multifunctional correlated oxides. Here, we demonstrate room-temperature dispersive phonon excitations and elucidate the Ni1+-Ni2+ polaron-hopping mechanism and the presence of rare spin-charge-phonon coupling even in a magnetically short-range-ordered state in rutile niobate, a rare room-temperature magnetodielectric system. We reveal room-temperature dispersive phonon excitations using inelastic neutron scattering (INS), complemented by machine-learning-based phonon calculations, to establish the microscopic origin of the polaron-hopping mechanism. Experimental evidence of dispersive phonon-driven polaron hopping is scarce. INS measurements show significant dispersive phonon excitations at 21, 33, and 47 meV, implying collective lattice dynamics that enable delocalized polaron propagation via coupled charge-spin-phonon interactions. Dispersive phonons couple to charge carriers and promote correlated NiO6 lattice distortions, facilitating delocalized polaron hopping. Low-energy magnetic excitations at 4 and 8 meV indicate the presence of local short-range magnetic correlations or spin-orbit-coupling-induced anisotropy in deformed NiO6 octahedra, which are thoroughly discussed. Machine-learning phonon calculations replicate the experimentally observed phonon excitations and demonstrate lattice instability, which is compatible with dynamic local distortions caused by polaron production. These findings provide microscopic evidence for a coupled charge-spin-phonon mechanism that mediates polaron hopping in rutile oxide systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过非弹性中子散射（INS）和机器学习声子计算，在室温金红石铌酸盐中揭示了色散声子激发，阐明了Ni1+-Ni2+极化子跳跃机制，并证实了即使在磁短程有序态下也存在罕见的自旋-电荷-声子耦合，为耦合电荷-自旋-声子机制介导极化子跳跃提供了微观证据。
AI.motivation: 理解晶格动力学如何介导极化子跳跃对设计多功能关联氧化物至关重要，但实验上关于色散声子驱动的极化子跳跃证据十分匮乏。
AI.method: 采用非弹性中子散射（INS）实验测量室温色散声子激发，并结合基于机器学习的声子计算方法进行互补验证，系统分析声子、磁激发与极化子跳跃之间的耦合关系。
AI.result: INS测量显示21、33和47 meV处存在显著的色散声子激发，表明集体晶格动力学促进离域极化子传播；4和8 meV处的低能磁激发指示局域短程磁关联或自旋轨道耦合导致的各向异性。机器学习声子计算成功复现实验声子激发并展示晶格不稳定性，与极化子产生的动态局域畸变相吻合。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为金红石氧化物中耦合电荷-自旋-声子机制介导极化子跳跃提供了微观证据，深化了对室温多功能关联氧化物中极化子输运机制的理解。

title: Robust Quantum Extremal Numbers
summary:
Absolutely maximally entangled states require every reduction of at most half of the parties to be maximally mixed, a condition that is both rigid and often impossible for qubit systems. Previous work introduced the quantum extremal number, which maximizes the number of exactly maximally mixed half-body marginals, and determined the exact value Qex(8,4)=56. The present work develops a robust extension of this extremal problem. For a subsystem $A$, the marginal maximal-mixing defect is defined by \[ D_A=2^{|A|}\operatorname{Tr}(ρ_A^2)-1 =2^{|A|}\left\|ρ_A-\frac{I_A}{2^{|A|}}\right\|_2^2, \] and $Q_{\mathrm{ex},\varepsilon}^{D}(n,k)$ is defined as the maximum number of $k$-body marginals satisfying $D_A\leq\varepsilon$ in an $n$-qubit pure state. This counting problem differs from approximate $k$-uniformity, which requires all $k$-body marginals to obey a common error bound.
  For pure states on $4m$ qubits, the following local stability inequality is established: \[ \sum_{i\in T}D_{T\setminus\{i\}}\geq1 \qquad (|T|=2m+1). \] It follows that, whenever $\varepsilon<1/(2m+1)$, the hypergraph of $\varepsilon$-good $2m$-subsets is $K_{2m+1}^{(2m)}$-free. Combined with the known exact eight-qubit construction, this yields the stability plateau \[ Q_{\mathrm{ex},\varepsilon}^{D}(8,4)=56, \qquad 0\leq\varepsilon<\frac15. \] For odd systems of $2k+1$ qubits, the exact forbidden hypergraph $H_k$ is used to derive explicit finite-error stability radii. In particular, $Q_{\mathrm{ex},\varepsilon}^{D}(9,4)\leq120$ for $0\leq\varepsilon<1/17$. These results turn exact quantum Turán obstructions into quantitative robustness statements and identify intervals on which quantum extremal numbers are stable under imperfect marginal mixedness.

AI.tldr: 本文建立量子极值数在"近似最大混合边缘态"条件下的稳定性理论。通过定义边缘最大混合缺陷D_A，证明了对4m量子比特纯态满足局部稳定性不等式，进而得到8量子比特系统在ε<1/5时稳定性平台Q_ex,ε^D(8,4)=56，并在奇数系统中利用精确禁子超图导出有限误差稳定性半径。
AI.motivation: 绝对最大纠缠态要求所有不超过半数粒子的约化态都是最大混合态，这一条件过于严格，且对于量子比特系统往往不可实现。先前工作引入了量子极值数来最大化恰好最大混合的半体边缘态数量，但精确结果难以推广。本文的核心动机是将这一精确极值问题稳健化——即使边缘态不完全最大混合（存在微小缺陷），量子极值数是否仍保持稳定？这需要建立从精确Turán型障碍到定量鲁棒性陈述的桥梁。
AI.method: 1) 定义边缘最大混合缺陷D_A=2^{|A|}Tr(ρ_A²)-1，并定义Q_ex,ε^D(n,k)为n量子比特纯态中满足D_A≤ε的k体边缘态的最大数目；2) 对4m量子比特纯态证明局部稳定性不等式Σ_{i∈T}D_{T\{i}}≥1 (|T|=2m+1)，从而导出ε<1/(2m+1)时ε-好2m子集的超图是K_{2m+1}^{(2m)}-自由的；3) 组合已知的8量子比特精确构造，得到稳定性平台Q_ex,ε^D(8,4)=56 (0≤ε<1/5)；4) 对2k+1量子比特奇系统，利用精确禁子超图H_k推导显式有限误差稳定性半径，得到Q_ex,ε^D(9,4)≤120 (0≤ε<1/17)。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) 建立4m量子比特系统的局部稳定性不等式，将边缘缺陷的求和下界与1联系起来；(2) 通过超图K_{2m+1}^{(2m)}-自由条件，证明8量子比特系统在ε∈[0,1/5)区间内量子极值数保持为56，形成稳定性平台；(3) 对9量子比特系统，利用精确禁子超图H_k得到上界120，稳定性半径为ε<1/17。这些结果将精确量子Turán障碍转化为定量鲁棒性结论。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了量子极值数在有限误差范围内具有稳定性：当边缘态的缺陷足够小（在特定阈值之内），量子极值数不会因近似而改变。这一发现表明精确量子Turán型构造具有一定的"刚性与稳健性"折中性质，并为近似量子纠缠态的极值问题提供了新的理论工具。

title: Revisiting Energy-based Tabular Anomaly Detection: Energy and Reconstruction are Complementary
comment: This is the author's version of a paper accepted at the 33rd International Conference on Neural Information Processing (ICONIP 2026)
summary: Tabular anomaly detection is dominated by classical density-proxy methods (Isolation Forest, OCSVM, LOF), reconstruction-based detectors (Autoencoders, VAEs), and modern non-parametric scorers (COPOD, ECOD, Deep SVDD), all of which approximate the inlier distribution only indirectly; explicit energy-based models are largely absent. Motivated by the recent revival of EBMs in deep learning (e.g., Energy-Based Transformers, JEPA), we revisit the classical Deep Boltzmann Machine (DBM) for this task and hypothesize that its mean-field energy combines more effectively with a reconstruction-based score than same-lineage pairs do. We evaluate a two-hidden-layer DBM on two tabular benchmarks spanning distinct domains (UCI Bank Marketing and NSL-KDD) against eight classical and modern baselines across twenty random seeds. The DBM mean-field energy matches the strongest baseline (the Autoencoder) on Bank Marketing and statistically beats it on NSL-KDD, while significantly outperforming the remaining seven on both datasets. When fused with the Autoencoder via rank fusion, the DBM energy yields a statistically significant improvement on both datasets (AUROC=+0.014, p<0.01 on Bank Marketing; +0.002, p<0.001 on NSL-KDD); every non-DBM-derived base model instead fails to improve or significantly degrades the AE-paired ensemble. Our position is that classical EBMs, exemplified by the DBM, deserve a place in the tabular anomaly detection toolbox as a non-redundant complementary view to the reconstruction-based scores that dominate current practice.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了经典深度玻尔兹曼机（DBM）在表格异常检测中的应用，发现其均值场能量与重构式检测器（Autoencoder）组合时能产生互补效果，在两个表格基准上显著提升检测性能（AUROC分别提升+0.014和+0.002），而其他非DBM基线模型与AE组合反而无效或退化。作者主张经典能量基模型（EBM）应在表格异常检测工具箱中占有一席之地。
AI.motivation: 当前表格异常检测主要由密度代理方法（Isolation Forest, OCSVM, LOF）、重构式检测器（AE, VAE）和现代非参数评分器（COPOD, ECOD, Deep SVDD）主导，这些方法都只是间接地近似内层（正常）分布，显式的能量基模型（EBM）在该领域基本缺失。受深度学习领域EBM复兴的启发（如Energy-Based Transformers, JEPA），作者希望通过重新审视经典的深度玻尔兹曼机来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 采用两层隐藏层的DBM用于表格异常检测，将其均值场能量作为异常评分。在UCI Bank Marketing和NSL-KDD两个跨域表格基准上，与八个经典/现代基线进行全面比较（20个随机种子）。进一步通过秩融合（rank fusion）将DBM能量与Autoencoder评分组合，检验其互补性。
AI.result: DBM均值场能量在Bank Marketing上与最强基线AE持平，在NSL-KDD上统计显著优于AE，同时在这两个数据集上显著优于其余七个基线。通过秩融合与AE结合后，DBM能量在两个数据集上均取得统计显著提升（Bank Marketing: AUROC+0.014, p进入0.01; NSL-KDD: +0.002, p进入0.001）。所有非DBM衍生的基线与AE配对后要么无法提升要么显著退化。
AI.conclusion: 经典EBM（以DBM为代表）应当被纳入表格异常检测工具箱，作为与当前占主导地位的重构式评分（reconstruction-based scores）互补的非冗余视角，两种方法结合可获得显著的检测性能增益。

title: Skyrmion Fractional Chern Insulator: An Intrinsically Multiband Route to Fractionalization in Rhombohedral Graphene
summary: We propose an unconventional microscopic origin for the fractional quantum anomalous Hall (FQAH) effect in rhombohedral graphene moiré superlattices: skyrmion fractionalization. We view the state at filling $ν<1$ as a metal of skyrmion vacancies, charge $+e$ objects formed by removing layer-pseudospin skyrmions from the interaction-generated skyrmion lattice Chern insulator at $ν=1$. These vacancies are intrinsically multiband degrees of freedom, absent in single Chern band-projected studies. Building on a recently proposed ideal limit, we first develop an effective field theory showing that skyrmion vacancies can themselves fractionalize, thereby inducing charge fractionalization. Focusing on $ν=\frac{2}{3}$, we then construct explicit variational trial wavefunctions for the resulting skyrmion fractional Chern insulator and provide numerical evidence, together with general arguments, showing that this process is energetically favored. Our results establish a realistic route to the FQAH that does not rely on a partially filled Chern band, but instead arises from fractionalization of collective pseudospin textures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种全新的分数量子反常霍尔（FQAH）效应微观起源：skyrmion分数化。在菱面体石墨烯莫尔超晶格中，ν<1填充态被视为skyrmion空穴（电荷+e）的金属态，这些空穴由ν=1的skyrmion晶格陈绝缘体中移除层赝自旋skyrmion形成。这些空穴本质上是多带自由度，能自身分数化从而诱导电荷分数化。作者聚焦ν=2/3，构建了skyrmion分数陈绝缘体的变分试探波函数，并提供数值证据和一般性论证表明该过程在能量上是有利的。
AI.motivation: 传统认为FQAH效应需要部分填充的陈带，而本文旨在探索一种不依赖部分填充陈带的替代微观机制。在菱面体石墨烯莫尔超晶格中，ν=1的skyrmion晶格陈绝缘体态为研究提供了新的起点，作者希望解释ν<1时观察到的FQAH态，并将其归因于集体赝自旋纹理的分数化而非单粒子陈带的分数化。
AI.method: 作者首先基于最近提出的理想极限，建立了一个有效场论框架来描述skyrmion空穴的分数化。随后聚焦于ν=2/3填充因子，构造了skyrmion分数陈绝缘体的显式变分试探波函数，并结合数值计算与一般性论证来验证该分数化过程在能量上的可行性。
AI.result: 数值证据和一般性论证表明，skyrmion空穴的分数化过程是能量上有利的，从而在ν=2/3处可以实现skyrmion分数陈绝缘体态，这为FQAH效应提供了一条现实的实现路径。
AI.conclusion: 该研究确立了通往FQAH态的一条现实路线，该路线不依赖于部分填充的陈带，而是源于集体赝自旋纹理的分数化，为理解菱面体石墨烯莫尔超晶格中的FQAH效应提供了新的物理图像。

title: Maximizing Nonclassicality of Massive Objects via Quantum Zeno Effect
summary: For testing quantum mechanics in the macroscopic domain, a major challenge is to devise effective means for enhancing the observable nonclassical signatures despite the ubiquitous presence of environmental decoherence. Toward this goal, we invoke the Quantum Zeno Effect (QZE) for achieving a tunable amplification of an inherently nonclassical quantum disturbance induced by any measurement. Such an enhancement of otherwise small and decoherence-suppressed nonclassicality can arise from the cumulative quantum disturbances generated by repetitive measurements, with the tunability of amplification controlled by the number of measurements. To evidence this, we formulate a testable loophole-free scheme using a massive oscillator, where the system preparation requires trapping and ground-state cooling of a massive object. The required measurements can be realized through a beam-splitter-type interaction between the mechanical oscillator and an optical field, followed by photon detection. Our analysis shows that such amplification, suitably quantified in terms of a testable witness, remains appreciably observable even in the realistic regimes of optomechanical damping, and for sufficiently large masses, thus enabling the demonstration of QZE in the macroscopic domain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用量子Zeno效应（QZE）通过重复测量产生的累积量子扰动，实现对宏观系统中原本微弱且受退相干抑制的非经典信号的放大幅度和可调谐增强，并结合光机械振荡器方案给出了可检验的无漏洞实验设计。
AI.motivation: 在宏观领域测试量子力学面临的核心挑战是环境退相干会迅速压制非经典特征，使得可观测的非经典信号极其微弱。作者希望通过引入量子Zeno效应来放大由测量诱导的量子扰动，从而在宏观系统中增强可观测的非经典性，推动宏观量子力学检验的可行性。
AI.method: 论文提出利用QZE实现非经典性的可调谐放大：通过重复测量产生的累积量子扰动来增强本征非经典信号，放大幅度由测量次数控制。具体方案为：采用大规模机械振子（需进行捕获和基态冷却），通过分束器型相互作用将机械振子与光场耦合，随后进行光子探测。该方案设计为无漏洞检验，并用量子见证（witness）来量化非经典性的放大程度。
AI.result: 分析表明，该放大方案即使在光机械阻尼的现实参数区间内，且对于足够大的质量，所提出的可检验见证仍然能显著可观测，从而可以在宏观域中演示量子Zeno效应。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实了QZE可以作为宏观量子力学测试中有效放大非经典信号的工具，其放大效果在现实退相干条件下依然保持鲁棒性，为在宏观尺度验证量子力学提供了可行的实验途径。

title: Designing Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Models: A Unified Path-Space View
comment: 29 pages, 9 figures, 4 tables; work in progress
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training provides a direct way to align diffusion models with human preferences and task-specific rewards. However, current RL algorithms for diffusion models remain fragmented: reverse-trajectory methods rely on discretized likelihood ratios, whereas forward-matching methods train on reward-labeled noising versions of the rollout samples. This paper shows that these seemingly different losses arise from a single path-space principle. Starting from the regularized diffusion-RL objective, we use importance sampling between sampling SDEs to obtain an explicit policy-gradient estimator on trajectory space. The estimator contains the stochastic Itô integral underlying Flow-GRPO-type updates; we derive an equivalent variance-reduced value-gradient form that recovers the forward-matching structure of AWM and DiffusionNFT. This identifies the empirical gap between these method families as a variance-reduction effect rather than a difference in RL principle. The derivation yields a unified design space organized by value-gradient estimation, weight functions, and sampling choices. Within this space, we propose a multi-sample KDE value-gradient estimator that reuses rollout groups, together with scale-bounded weight families that retain stable existing recipes while excluding singular ones. Experiments on SD3.5-M and Qwen-Image models validate the variance-reduction explanation and show that the resulting recipe improves over prior diffusion-RL baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文证明扩散模型强化学习中的反向轨迹方法和前向匹配方法源自同一路径空间原理，并将两类方法之间的经验差距归因于方差缩减效应而非强化学习原则差异，进而提出统一的算法设计空间和一个多样本KDE值梯度估计器。
AI.motivation: 当前扩散模型的RL后训练算法分散为两类：反向轨迹方法依赖离散化似然比，前向匹配方法在带奖励标注的加噪样本上训练。两类方法看似不同且缺乏统一的原理框架，阻碍了算法的系统化设计和改进。
AI.method: 从正则化的扩散RL目标出发，通过采样SDE之间的重要性采样获得轨迹空间上的显式策略梯度估计器。该估计器包含Flow-GRPO类型更新的随机Itô积分；进一步推导出等价且方差缩减的值梯度形式，恢复了AWM和DiffusionNFT的前向匹配结构。基于此构建由值梯度估计、权重函数和采样选择组织的统一设计空间，并提出多样本KDE值梯度估计器与有界缩放权重族。
AI.result: 在SD3.5-M和Qwen-Image模型上的实验验证了方差缩减解释，所提出的方法优于现有扩散RL基线。
AI.conclusion: 扩散RL的两类主流方法在原理上统一，经验差异源于方差缩减而非RL原则分歧；统一设计空间与新的KDE估计器能带来性能提升。

title: Neural decoders for subsystem many-hypercube codes
summary: To maximize the potential of quantum error-correcting codes, it is essential to develop high-performance decoders. The subsystem many-hypercube (MHC) codes have been developed to achieve both high encoding rates and low-weight syndrome-measurements, but the introduction of gauge degrees of freedom makes decoding more challenging. In this work, we develop neural-network-based decoders for the subsystem MHC codes in a circuit-level noise model. We demonstrate that even the gauge-measurement information can be utilized for decoding by carefully arranging the syndrome-measurement sequence, improving the decoding performance. We further show that recurrent neural decoders outperform simple fully connected neural decoders, and can decode syndrome-measurement sequences longer than those used during training.

AI.tldr: 本文为子系统多超立方体（MHC）码开发了基于神经网络的解码器，在电路级噪声模型下利用规范测量信息提升解码性能，并证明循环神经网络解码器优于全连接解码器且能泛化到比训练更长的序列。
AI.motivation: 量子纠错码需要高性能解码器才能发挥最大潜力。子系统MHC码兼具高编码率和低权重综合征测量优势，但规范自由度的引入使解码更具挑战性，现有解码方法不足以应对。
AI.method: 针对子系统MHC码设计神经网络解码器，在电路级噪声模型下工作；通过精心安排综合征测量序列使规范测量信息可用于解码；对比全连接神经网络与循环神经网络解码器的性能差异。
AI.result: 规范测量信息经合理排列后可改善解码性能；循环神经网络解码器优于全连接解码器，并且能够解码比训练时更长的综合征测量序列，展现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 神经网络解码器，特别是循环神经网络，适用于子系统MHC码并能充分利用规范自由度信息，为高编码率量子纠错码的实际解码提供了可行方案。

title: Handover of In-Context Learning State Across Session Boundaries
summary: This study investigates the methodological and theoretical properties of session handover in applications that use large language models. A task may continue in a new session when the context reaches the model's input limit, when the application restarts, or when another agent is asked to finish the task. The application must then decide which information from the earlier session to pass on. We formulate handover as the transfer of a task-relative in-context learning (ICL) state and distinguish exact recovery of earlier material from preservation of the target distribution. Under an exogeneity condition, predictive equivalence characterizes the coarsest deterministic sufficient handover and gives a fixed-length bit requirement. The analysis isolates the effects of the memory constraint, the writer, and the continuation procedure, and quantifies the cost of writing before the realized downstream query is known. We propose a three-part record that stores decisions and constraints exactly, uses task-justified statistics for repeated evidence, and retains original observations whose effect is not preserved by those statistics. Gaussian linear regression gives an exact finite-dimensional handover and finite-bit perturbation bounds, while nonparametric regression gives upper and lower bounds that relate memory to squared prediction error. These results provide a theory and method for deciding what a handover must retain and how its memory requirement depends on the continuation task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并研究了大型语言模型应用中会话交接（session handover）的方法论与理论特性，将会话交接形式化为任务相关上下文学习（ICL）状态的迁移，确立了精确恢复与目标分布保持之间的区分，并在外生性条件下推导出预测等价性、最粗确定性充分交接及固定长度比特需求，提出了三部分记录机制，并在高斯线性回归与非参数回归中给出了精确的上界与下界。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型应用在会话交接时缺乏统一的理论框架来回答"哪些信息必须从前一会话传递"这一核心问题。由于上下文长度限制、应用重启或多代理协作等原因，任务需要在不同会话间延续，但如何决定传递哪些信息、记忆需求如何随后续任务变化，此前缺乏严谨的数学刻画。
AI.method: 本文将交接形式化为任务相关ICL状态的传递，区分精确恢复与目标分布保持两个目标。在外生性条件下利用预测等价性刻画最粗确定性充分交接并导出固定长度比特需求。提出三部分记录结构：(1)精确存储决策与约束；(2)对重复证据使用任务证明合理的统计量；(3)保留未被统计量保留效果的原始观测。针对高斯线性回归给出精确有限维交接与有限比特扰动界，针对非参数回归建立记忆与平方预测误差之间的上下界。
AI.result: 在高斯线性回归中实现了精确的有限维交接表示，并给出了有限比特扰动界限；在非参数回归中建立了记忆量与平方预测误差之间的理论上下界。分析隔离了记忆约束、写入者与延续过程各自的效应，并量化了在真实下游查询已知之前进行写入所付出的代价。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为决定会话交接必须保留哪些信息及其记忆需求如何依赖于后续任务提供了完整的理论与方法框架，填补了LLM会话延续在信息论层面的理论空白。

title: Limits of independent and identical measurements for quantum illumination with an unknown return phase
summary: Quantum illumination exploits entanglement between a transmitted signal and a retained idler to improve the error-probability exponent of target detection by roughly a factor of four (6 dB) over that with a coherent state of the same transmitted energy. This advantage presumes a known return phase. In practice, the phase is set by the range to the target and the condition of its surface, and is difficult to know in advance. Whether the advantage survives when this phase is unknown is not obvious. Here, we cast target detection as a composite hypothesis test in which the return phase is an unknown constant common to all trials, and we restrict the receiver to independent and identical measurements on each copy. We bound the worst-case error exponent at low reflectivity for every such measurement and every input state of a single signal mode and an idler of any dimension. We then show that unentangled coherent light with heterodyne detection already saturates this bound, for every value of the phase. Entanglement therefore confers no advantage in this setting. The class of independent and identical measurements contains many implementable quantum-illumination receivers, including the optical parametric amplifier and phase-conjugate receivers. Our result shows that none of them can offer a quantum advantage in the worst case over the phase, to leading order in the reflectivity.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究未知返回相位条件下的量子照明目标检测问题。作者将目标检测建模为复合假设检验，其中返回相位是未知常数，并将接收机限制为对每个副本的独立同分布测量。他们证明了在低反射率条件下，纠缠并不带来优势：无纠缠的相干光配合零差探测已能达到最坏情况下的错误指数界，相位对相干零差接收机无不利影响。因此，在该设定下纠缠不提供量子优势。
AI.motivation: 量子照明利用信号与保留闲置光束之间的纠缠，在已知返回相位时可显著提升目标检测性能（错误指数提升约6 dB）。然而实际应用中，返回相位由目标距离及表面条件决定，难以事先获知。作者希望探究当相位未知时，量子照明的优势是否依然存在，从而填补这一关键理论空白。
AI.method: 本文将目标检测视为复合假设检验问题，其中返回相位是所有试验共有的未知常数。作者将接收机限制为对每个副本进行独立同分布（iid）测量，并在低反射率条件下推导出每个此类测量及每个输入态（单信号模式加任意维数闲置态）的最坏情况错误指数界。通过数学分析，作者证明无纠缠的相干光配零差探测即可饱和该界。
AI.result: 在未知返回相位的设定下，纠缠不提供任何优势。相干光配零差探测对每个相位值都能达到最坏情况错误指数界。由于独立同分布测量类包含许多可实现的量子照明接收机（如光参量放大器和相位共轭接收机），结果表明这些接收机均无法在反射率一阶项上实现对相位的量子优势。
AI.conclusion: 量子照明的纠缠优势依赖已知返回相位这一前提条件。当相位未知时（实际应用中常见），采用独立同分布测量的所有量子照明接收机在最坏相位情况下均无量子优势。相干光配零差探测已达到最优性能，这为实际目标检测系统的设计提供了重要指导。

title: Generation-Powered Inference for Distribution-Valued Outcomes
summary: Modern generative models increasingly produce distribution-valued outputs, such as predicted cellular responses to genetic perturbations in single-cell genomics. While these models provide valuable auxiliary information, they are inherently imperfect, creating a need for statistical methods that leverage their predictions without relying on their correctness. We propose generation-powered inference (GPI), a general framework for improving inference on distribution-valued parameters using auxiliary generative models. Focusing on Wasserstein barycenters and related distributional functionals, we introduce a function-valued bridge representation that transforms inference in the nonlinear Wasserstein space into estimation of a mean function in a Hilbert space, enabling an augmented estimation framework analogous to prediction-powered inference. We develop a family of GPI estimators with optimal information borrowing, establish consistency, asymptotic normality, and simultaneous confidence bands, and derive valid inference for linear functionals and Wasserstein distances. Simulation studies demonstrate efficiency gains over labeled-data-only methods and robust performance under generative model misspecification. We illustrate the proposed framework using a Perturb-seq study of K562 cells, where synthetic perturbation responses generated by the State foundation model are used to improve inference for pathway-level consensus gene expression distributions associated with perturbations of the 40S ribosome module.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"生成驱动推断"(GPI)框架，利用辅助生成模型的预测结果(如单细胞基因组学中基因扰动的细胞响应)来改进分布值参数的统计推断，同时不依赖生成模型的正确性。该方法通过函数值桥表示将非线性Wasserstein空间中的推断转化为希尔伯特空间中的均值函数估计，实现类似预测驱动推断的增强估计框架。
AI.motivation: 现代生成模型越来越多地产生分布值输出(如单细胞基因组学中预测的基因扰动细胞响应)，这些预测虽提供有价值的辅助信息但本质上不完全准确。需要一种统计方法，既能利用这些预测来提升推断效率，又不过度依赖其正确性。
AI.method: 提出GPI框架，聚焦Wasserstein重心及相关分布泛函。核心创新是函数值桥表示，将非线性Wasserstein空间中的推断转化为希尔伯特空间中的均值函数估计，从而构建类似预测驱动推断的增强估计结构。开发了一族具有最优信息借用能力的GPI估计量，并建立了相合性、渐近正态性和同时置信带等理论基础。
AI.result: 通过模拟研究证明了GPI相对于仅使用标注数据方法具有效率提升，且在生成模型误设定下表现稳健。在K562细胞的Perturb-seq实际研究中，利用State基础模型生成的合成扰动响应改进了40S核糖体模块扰动相关的通路级共识基因表达分布推断。
AI.conclusion: GPI是一个通用且有效的框架，能够在生成模型不完美的情况下，利用其分布值预测来增强Wasserstein重心及相关分布泛函的统计推断，在效率上优于仅依靠标注数据的方法，并具有扎实的理论保证和实际应用价值。

title: Circuit Depth Compression via Spectral Gap Amplification in Quantum Phase Estimation
summary: We show that quantum phase estimation (QPE) circuits can be significantly compressed in depth by preprocessing the input operator with a sigmoid spectral filter before estimation. For systems with small spectral gaps Delta_lambda, standard QPE requires m = ceil(log2(1/Delta_lambda)) precision qubits and depth Theta(2^m). Applying a soft-step transformation f(lambda; tau,w) amplifies the effective gap to Delta_f > Delta_lambda (for w < 1/4), reducing the required precision to m_f = ceil(log2(1/Delta_f)) and compressing circuit depth by 2^(alpha Delta_m), where alpha = 1 for the LMR density-matrix exponentiation framework and alpha is in [0.11,0.42] for controlled-phase-gate circuits. We prove that this compression is exact, bounded above by log2(1/(4w Delta_lambda)) + 1, and impossible for exactly degenerate spectra. We further show that the threshold parameter tau requires only O(w) accuracy, so classical preprocessing such as covariance diagonalisation or CASSCF avoids circularity. A net resource advantage occurs when 4w^2(2^Delta_m - 1) > Delta_lambda log(1/epsilon). Validation on LiH and BeH2 bond-stretch calculations, classical covariance datasets, and synthetic near-degenerate cases demonstrates depth reductions of up to 27x and CX-gate reductions of up to 21x. For LiH, QPE output fidelity improves from 0.66 to 0.98 at a 1% hardware error rate. The method preserves the principal subspace to machine precision, requires no modification of QPE, and can be combined with readout-stage and state-preparation filtering. Negative-control tests establish the benefit condition: m_raw >= 2 and Delta_lambda > 0.

AI.tldr: 通过在使用量子相位估计（QPE）前对输入算子施加sigmoid谱滤波器进行预处理，可显著压缩QPE电路的深度。软阶梯变换放大了有效能隙，减少了所需精度量子比特数，实现了高达27倍的深度缩减和21倍的CX门缩减，并在LiH分子中使QPE输出保真度从0.66提升至0.98。
AI.motivation: 标准量子相位估计（QPE）对于具有小谱间隙的系统需要大量精度量子比特和指数级电路深度，这对含噪声中等规模量子（NISQ）硬件构成沉重负担。作者试图通过谱域预处理来放大有效能隙，从而在不修改QPE本身的前提下压缩电路深度。
AI.method: 在QPE施加之前，对输入算子应用参数化的sigmoid软阶梯谱变换f(λ; τ, w)。该变换可放大有效谱间隙（当w<1/4时Δ_f>Δ_λ），从而将所需精度量子比特从m减少到m_f=ceil(log2(1/Δ_f))。作者证明压缩深度上界为log2(1/(4wΔ_λ))+1，并要求阈值参数τ仅需O(w)精度即可避免经典预处理（如协方差对角化或CASSCF）的循环性。作者还给出了净资源优势的条件不等式以及负对照测试条件。
AI.result: 在LiH和BeH2键拉伸计算、经典协方差数据集和合成近简并案例上验证：深度缩减最高27倍，CX门缩减最高21倍。LiH在1%硬件错误率下QPE输出保真度从0.66提升到0.98。方法将主子空间保持到机器精度，负对照测试确定优势条件为m_raw≥2且Δ_λ>0。
AI.conclusion: 谱滤波器预处理的QPE压缩方法在理论上被证明是精确的（非简并谱），具有严格的可证明的深度压缩上界，并与现有量子化学工作流兼容。该方法不修改QPE本身，可与读出级和态制备级滤波组合使用，为近端量子硬件上的量子化学模拟提供了实用性改进。

title: Non-Abelian geometry and globally inequivalent symmetry reductions of the cylindrical Dirac doublet
summary: Different exact cylindrical Dirac constructions are locally related within the same two-dimensional positive-energy sector, suggesting that they might be merely alternative choices of basis. We show that this equivalence can fail globally. Treating the cylindrical Dirac doublet as a rank-two bundle over momentum space, we identify transverse helicity, a mass-dressed transverse integral, and helicity as distinct symmetry-selected rank-one reductions, whose normalized restrictions organize the internal doublet through a Pauli algebra. The positive-energy Dirac $SU(2)$ connection Abelianizes exactly on fixed-azimuth meridians in the transverse-helicity basis, while its full three-dimensional curvature remains genuinely non-Abelian for nonzero mass. We derive the corresponding azimuthal Wilson-loop spectrum in closed form. The three reductions then display sharply different global structures: the transverse-helicity splitting terminates on the momentum axis, the mass-dressed splitting extends smoothly and is Chern trivial for $m>0$, whereas helicity defines line bundles with opposite unit Chern numbers. Thus a single Dirac doublet admits symmetry resolutions that are locally equivalent but globally inequivalent.

AI.tldr: 本文研究圆柱Dirac二重态在动量空间上的全局几何结构，证明不同Dirac构造（横向螺旋度、质量修饰横向积分、螺旋度）虽然是局部等价的不同基选择，但在全局上不等价——它们具有截然不同的拓扑性质（Chern数等），表明单个Dirac二重态的光滑分解在全局层面是唯一的。
AI.motivation: 已有工作表明不同的精确圆柱Dirac构造在同一个二维正能量扇区内局部等价，可能仅被视为基的选择差异。作者希望探究这种局部等价性是否能在全局成立，即这些构造是否在拓扑意义上是真正等价的。
AI.method: 将圆柱Dirac二重态视为动量空间上的秩二向量丛；识别三种不同的对称选择性秩一约化（横向螺旋度、质量修饰横向积分、螺旋度）；利用Pauli代数组织内部二重态的归一化限制；分析正能量Dirac SU(2)联络在不同基下的Abel化性质及其三维曲率；以闭合形式推导方位角Wilson圈谱；通过Chern数等拓扑不变量比较三种约化的全局结构。
AI.result: 正能量Dirac SU(2)联络在横向螺旋度基下于固定方位角子午线上精确Abel化，但其完整三维曲率对非零质量保持真实的非Abel性。三种约化的全局结构截然不同：横向螺旋度分裂在动量轴上终止；质量修饰分裂光滑延拓且对m>0是Chern平凡；螺旋度则定义具有相反单位Chern数的线丛。
AI.conclusion: 单个Dirac二重态允许多种局部等价但全局不等价的对称性分解，这揭示了局部等价性不能保证全局等价性，Dirac结构的对称性约化必须考虑其全局拓扑性质。

title: Information-Calibrated Quantum Diffusion: Aligning Forward Noise with Reverse Recoverability
summary: Quantum diffusion models typically parameterize forward corruption by raw channel strength, even though equal parameter increments need not erase equal information or induce comparable inverse problems.
